avo-eggs: Toast the bread until it turns golden.
Boil or scramble the eggs the way you like.
Mash the avocado with lemon juice and a pinch of salt.
Spread the avocado on the toast. Add the egg and chilli flakes.
greek-yogurt-bowl: Spoon the yogurt into two bowls.
Wash the berries and pat them dry.
Add the berries and granola on top of the yogurt.
Drizzle the honey over it and scatter the chia seeds on top.
spinach-omelette: Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Cook the spinach in olive oil for 2 minutes, until it is soft.
Pour in the eggs and cook them gently.
Add the chopped tomato and crumbled feta.
Fold it over, let it rest for 1 minute, then serve.
oat-bowls: Put the oats and milk in a pot over medium heat.
Stir for 5 to 7 minutes, until the mixture thickens.
Add the sliced banana, peanut butter, and cinnamon on top.
pancakes: Mix the flour and baking powder in a big bowl.
Whisk the milk and eggs in a second bowl, then combine the two mixtures. Let the batter rest for 5 minutes.
Cook small ladles of batter for 2 minutes on each side.
Stack the pancakes. Add the berries and maple syrup on top.
shakshuka: Cook the onion and capsicum in a pan for 5 minutes.
Add the cumin and crushed tomato. Let it simmer for 8 minutes.
Make 4 spaces in the mixture and crack an egg into each one.
Cover the pan and cook for 6 minutes, until the egg whites are set.
smoothie-green: Put the banana, spinach, yogurt, and milk in a blender.
Toast the bread and cut it into strips.
Pour the smoothie and serve it right away.
chicken-wrap: Season the chicken and grill it for 6 to 7 minutes on each side.
Let it rest for 5 minutes, then slice it.
Fill them with lettuce, tomato, chicken, and mayonnaise.
Roll them up, cut them in half, and serve.
greek-salad: Cut the cucumber, tomato, and red onion into chunks.
Add the olives, olive oil, and lemon juice. Toss everything well.
Fry the halloumi slices for 2 minutes on each side, until golden.
Place the halloumi over the salad and serve.
tuna-rice: Cook the rice, then let it rest for 5 minutes.
Put the rice, tuna, corn, and chopped cucumber into bowls.
Pour soy sauce over the top and serve.
quesadillas: Mash half of the beans with a fork.
Spread the beans on the tortillas. Add the cheese and corn.
Fold the tortillas and toast them in a dry pan for 3 minutes on each side.
Cut them into wedges and serve with salsa.
falafel-pita: Bake the falafel as the pack says, for about 15 minutes.
Grate the cucumber, squeeze it dry, and mix it with yogurt.
Fill the pitas with lettuce, tomato, falafel, and tzatziki.
pasta-salad: Cook the pasta, drain it, and cool it under cold water.
Cut the cherry tomatoes in half and tear the mozzarella into pieces.
Mix the pasta with tomato, mozzarella, salami, and basil.
Add olive oil, let it rest for 10 minutes, then serve.
fried-rice: Cook the rice ahead of time and chill it if you can. Cold rice fries best.
Scramble the eggs in a hot pan, then set them aside.
Fry the diced carrot and peas for 4 minutes.
Add the rice and soy sauce. Toss everything for 3 minutes.
Fold in the egg and spring onion. Serve it hot.
tacos: Brown the mince in a hot pan, breaking it into pieces as it cooks.
Add the taco seasoning and a splash of water. Let it simmer for 5 minutes.
Shred the cabbage and mix it with lime juice.
Fill the shells with mince, slaw, cheese, and sour cream.
sheet-chicken: Cut the potato into chunks and the zucchini into thick slices.
Toss everything on a tray with oil, oregano, and lemon.
Bake for 35 to 40 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through.
Let it rest for 5 minutes and serve.
salmon-greens: Pan fry the salmon skin side down for 6 minutes, then cook it for 2 minutes more.
Add the garlic, soy sauce, and lemon to the pan.
Serve the salmon over rice with greens.
spaghetti-bol: Cook the onion, carrot, and garlic for 5 minutes.
Add the mince and brown it well.
Add the crushed tomato and let it simmer for 25 minutes.
Cook the spaghetti in salty water.
Serve the sauce over the spaghetti with parmesan.
curry-chicken: Fry the curry paste for 1 minute, until it smells great.
Add the chicken pieces and coat them well.
Add the coconut milk and sweet potato chunks. Let them simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until it is soft.
stir-fry: Sear the beef in a very hot pan for 3 minutes. Set it aside.
Stir fry the capsicum, broccoli, and ginger for 4 minutes.
Put the beef back in the pan. Add the soy sauce and toss for 1 minute.
lamb-kofta: Mix the lamb with cumin, parsley, and salt. Shape it into logs.
Grill or fry it for 10 to 12 minutes, turning it often.
Pour hot water over the couscous, cover it for 5 minutes, then fluff it.
Mix the yogurt with grated cucumber.
Serve the kofta on couscous with the yogurt.
veggie-chilli: Add the paprika, beans, tomato, and corn.
Let it simmer for 20 minutes, until thick.
fish-chips: Cut the sweet potato into chips and bake them for 25 minutes.
Dip the fish in beaten egg, then coat it with breadcrumbs.
Bake the fish for 12 to 15 minutes.
Serve it with peas and lemon wedges.
butter-chicken-lite: Melt the butter and fry the garam masala for 30 seconds.
Add the chicken and brown it for 6 minutes.
Add the passata and let it simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in the cream and warm it through.
soup-minestrone: Put the stock, tomato, carrot, and zucchini in a big pot.
Add the beans and small pasta. Cook them for 10 minutes more.
satay-noodles: Cook the noodles as the pack says.
Fry the chicken strips for 7 minutes.
Mix the peanut butter, soy sauce, lime juice, and warm water into a sauce.
Toss the noodles, chicken, capsicum, and sauce together.
pack-bacon-eggs-toast: Toast the bread until it turns golden.
Fry the bacon in a pan until the edges are crisp.
Melt the butter in the same pan and fry the eggs the way you like.
Put the bacon and eggs on the toast.
pack-veggie-hash: Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Add egg, capsicum, and potato. Cook for 13 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in the smoked paprika and cook for 2 more minutes.
pack-berry-oat-smoothie: Put the mixed berries, banana, greek yogurt, and milk in a blender.
Add the rolled oats and honey.
Pour it into glasses and serve it cold.
pack-baked-eggs-tomato: Pour the crushed tomato and olive oil into a small oven dish.
Crack the eggs into the dish.
Bake for 12 minutes, until the eggs are just set.
Top with feta and basil. Serve it with the bread.
pack-peanut-banana-toast: Toast the bread until it turns golden.
Spread a thick layer of peanut butter on each slice.
Slice the banana and place it on top.
Sprinkle cinnamon on top, then drizzle with honey.
pack-mushroom-spinach-scramble: Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Heat a pan over medium heat.
Cook the mushroom and spinach for 4 minutes.
Pour in the eggs and cook them gently until just set.
Add the butter and cheese on top, then serve.
pack-ham-cheese-toastie: Butter the outside of each bread slice.
Fill the bread with ham and cheese.
Cook it in a sandwich press or a hot pan for 4 minutes, until the cheese melts.
Let it rest for 1 minute, then cut it in half.
pack-cinnamon-oats: Put the rolled oats and milk in a pot with a little water.
Cook over low heat for 8 minutes, and stir often.
Stir in the cinnamon, honey and chia seeds.
Add the mixed berries on top and serve warm.
pack-bacon-burrito: Cook the bacon until it is done.
Cook the egg the way you like it.
Add salsa, then fold or roll it up.
pack-greek-eggs: Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Heat a pan over medium heat.
Cook the tomato and olives for 4 minutes.
Pour in the eggs and cook them gently until just set.
Add the feta and oregano on top, then serve.
pack-sweet-potato-bacon-hash: Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Add the bacon, egg and sweet potato. Cook for 13 minutes, and stir now and then.
pack-yogurt-granola-cups: Spoon half of the greek yogurt into two glasses.
Add a layer of granola and sliced banana.
Repeat with the rest of the yogurt and granola.
pack-corn-zucchini-fritters: Grate the zucchini and squeeze out the extra water.
Mix the zucchini, corn, egg, flour and chopped spring onion into a batter.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry spoonfuls of batter for 3 minutes on each side, until golden.
pack-ricotta-honey-toast: Toast the bread until it turns golden.
Spread a thick layer of ricotta on each slice.
Squeeze some lemon over the top.
pack-breakfast-fried-rice: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add the egg, ham and frozen peas. Cook for 5 minutes, and stir now and then.
Stir in the soy sauce and cook for 2 more minutes.
pack-potato-cheese-skillet: Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Add the egg and potato. Cook for 13 minutes, and stir now and then.
Put the cheese and butter on top, then serve hot.
pack-tofu-scramble: Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Add the tofu, spinach and tomato. Cook for 5 minutes, and stir now and then.
Stir in the cumin and cook for 2 more minutes.
pack-ricotta-pancakes: Whisk the flour and baking powder in a bowl.
Stir the ricotta, egg and milk into a thick batter.
Melt the butter in a big pan.
Fry small pancakes for 2 minutes on each side, until golden.
pack-banana-chia-pudding: Whisk the chia seeds, milk, greek yogurt, peanut butter and cinnamon in a bowl.
Leave it in the fridge for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Stir well until there are no lumps.
pack-herb-cheese-baked-eggs: Put the spinach in a small oven dish and pour the cream over it.
Crack the eggs over the top.
Scatter the cheese and parsley over the top.
Bake for 12 minutes, until the eggs are just set.
pack-salmon-egg-toast: Cook the salmon until it is done.
Cook the egg the way you like it.
Toast the bread until it turns golden.
Add lemon, then fold or roll it up.
pack-bean-egg-burrito: Cook the egg the way you like it.
Fill it with black beans, capsicum, cheese and sour cream.
pack-berry-chia-oats: Stir the rolled oats, greek yogurt, milk, chia seeds and honey in a bowl.
Cover it and leave it in the fridge overnight, or for at least 4 hours.
Stir well so the chia seeds spread through the mixture.
Add the mixed berries on top.
pack-banana-oat-smoothie: Put the banana, greek yogurt and milk in a blender.
Add the rolled oats, honey and cinnamon.
Pour it into glasses and serve cold.
pack-chicken-caesar-wrap: Cook the chicken breast until it is done.
Fill it with lettuce and parmesan.
Add mayonnaise, then fold or roll it up.
pack-tuna-salad-sandwich: Drain the tuna and put it in a bowl.
Mix the tuna with mayonnaise, chopped celery and a squeeze of lemon.
Fill the bread with lettuce and the tuna mixture.
pack-greek-chicken-pita: Cook the chicken breast until it is done.
Fill it with cucumber, tomato, feta and greek yogurt.
Add oregano and lemon, then fold or roll it up.
pack-chickpea-cucumber-salad: Chop the cucumber, tomato and red onion.
Put the chickpeas and feta in a big bowl.
Add the olive oil, lemon and parsley, then toss well.
pack-tomato-mozzarella-sandwich: Toast the bread until it turns golden.
Layer the mozzarella and tomato slices.
pack-lentil-carrot-soup: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook the onion, garlic and ginger in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the lentils, carrot and cumin, then stir well.
Pour in the vegetable stock and let it simmer for 20 minutes.
Blend until smooth, add a squeeze of lemon and serve hot.
pack-ham-cheese-wrap: Fill it with ham, lettuce, tomato and cheese.
Add mayonnaise, then fold or roll it up.
pack-salmon-rice-bowl: Cook the rice as the pack says, then let it cool.
Cook the salmon until it is done, then let it cool a little.
Chop the cucumber, spring onion and avocado.
Add the soy sauce and lime, then toss well.
pack-falafel-salad-bowl: Chop the lettuce, tomato, cucumber and red onion.
Put the falafel and greek yogurt in a big bowl.
Add the olive oil and lemon, then toss well.
pack-egg-salad-sandwich: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, then cool and peel them.
Mash the eggs with mayonnaise and chopped spring onion.
Fill the bread with lettuce and the egg mixture.
pack-tuna-pasta-salad: Cook the pasta as the pack says. Then let it cool.
Chop the cherry tomato, cucumber, olives, and red onion.
Put the tuna in a big bowl.
Add olive oil and lemon. Toss everything well.
pack-mexican-bean-salad: Chop corn, capsicum, red onion, and avocado.
Put the black beans in a big bowl.
Add olive oil, cumin, and lime. Toss everything well.
pack-halloumi-beetroot-salad: Put the halloumi in a big bowl.
Add pine nuts, honey, olive oil, and lemon. Toss everything well.
pack-chicken-avocado-sandwich: Cook the chicken breast until done. Then slice it.
Fill with chicken, avocado, lettuce, and tomato.
pack-prawn-avocado-salad: Cook the prawns until done. Then let them cool a little.
Add olive oil, chilli flakes, and lime. Toss everything well.
pack-roast-veg-couscous: Chop zucchini, capsicum, and red onion. Roast them with chickpeas and olive oil for 20 minutes.
Pour hot water over the couscous. Let it rest 5 minutes. Then fluff it with a fork.
Mix the roast veg into the couscous.
Top with feta and a squeeze of lemon. Then serve.
pack-blt-sandwich: Fill with bacon, lettuce, and tomato slices.
pack-tuna-bean-salad: Put the tuna and black beans in a big bowl.
Add olive oil, parsley, and lemon. Toss everything well.
pack-spicy-tuna-wrap: Fill with tuna, cucumber, and lettuce.
Add mayonnaise and chilli flakes. Fold or roll it up.
pack-chicken-greek-salad: Cook the chicken breast until done. Then let it cool a little.
Chop tomato, cucumber, olives, and red onion.
Put the feta in a big bowl.
Add olive oil, oregano, and lemon. Toss everything well.
pack-pumpkin-feta-salad: Cut the pumpkin into cubes. Roast it with olive oil for 20 minutes.
Put the spinach in a big bowl.
Top it with warm pumpkin, feta, and pine nuts.
pack-chilli-noodle-salad: Cook the noodles as the pack says. Then let them cool.
Chop capsicum, carrot, and spring onion.
Add soy sauce, chilli flakes, peanut butter, and lime. Toss everything well.
pack-salami-cheese-sandwich: Fill with salami, cheese, tomato, and lettuce.
Press gently. Then cut the sandwich in half.
pack-curried-egg-wrap: Cook the egg just how you like it.
Add mayonnaise and garam masala. Fold or roll it up.
pack-tomato-bruschetta: Toast the bread until crisp and golden.
Rub the toast with the cut garlic clove.
Chop the tomato. Mix it with basil and olive oil.
Spoon the tomato mix onto the toast.
Top with torn mozzarella. Then serve.
pack-chicken-korma: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion, garlic, and ginger in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add chicken thigh and garam masala. Stir well.
Pour in the coconut milk. Let it simmer for 25 minutes.
Stir in cream. Cook for 2 more minutes.
pack-beef-broccoli-stir-fry: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the garlic and ginger for 3 minutes.
Add beef strips and broccoli. Cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in soy sauce. Cook for 2 more minutes.
pack-garlic-prawn-pasta: Cook the spaghetti in salty water as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Stir in chilli flakes and warm them through.
Drain the spaghetti. Toss everything together.
Top with parsley and lemon. Serve hot.
pack-lamb-kofta-tray: Chop red onion, garlic, and potato into chunks.
Add lamb mince, cumin, and oregano to the tray with the olive oil.
Bake for 32 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Top with greek yogurt and lemon. Serve hot.
pack-chicken-fajitas: Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry chicken breast strips with taco seasoning for 8 minutes.
Add sliced capsicum and onion. Cook for 5 more minutes.
Fill the tortillas with the chicken mix, sour cream, and a squeeze of lime.
pack-vegetable-lasagne: Put garlic, zucchini, capsicum, mushroom, spinach, and pasta in a big oven dish.
Pour crushed tomato and olive oil over them.
Top with ricotta and mozzarella. Serve hot.
pack-salmon-potato-tray: Chop garlic, green beans, and potato into chunks.
Add salmon to the tray with the olive oil.
Bake for 27 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Top with lemon and parsley. Serve hot.
pack-chicken-tikka-skewers: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Mix greek yogurt, garam masala, garlic, and ginger. Coat the chicken thigh pieces with the mix.
Let the chicken rest for 10 minutes to soak up the flavours.
Fry the chicken in a hot pan for 12 minutes until charred at the edges.
Serve over rice with a squeeze of lemon.
pack-tofu-veg-stir-fry: Cook the noodles as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the ginger and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add tofu, broccoli, capsicum, and carrot. Cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in soy sauce. Cook for 2 more minutes.
pack-chicken-parmigiana: Dip the chicken breast in beaten egg, then in breadcrumbs.
Bake the chicken on a tray with potato wedges and olive oil for 20 minutes.
Spoon tomato passata over the chicken. Top with mozzarella and parmesan.
Bake for 10 more minutes until the mozzarella melts and bubbles.
pack-white-fish-curry: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion and ginger in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add white fish, spinach, and curry paste. Stir well.
Pour in the coconut milk. Let it simmer for 20 minutes.
Serve over the rice with a squeeze of lime.
pack-pork-peanut-noodles: Cook the noodles as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add pork mince and capsicum. Cook for 13 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in peanut butter and soy sauce. Cook for 2 more minutes.
Top with lime. Serve over the noodles.
pack-greek-lemon-chicken-tray: Chop red onion, garlic, and potato into chunks.
Add chicken thigh and oregano to the tray with the olive oil.
Bake for 37 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Top with feta and lemon. Serve hot.
pack-beef-chilli-con-carne: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add beef mince, kidney beans, smoked paprika, and cumin. Stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato. Let it simmer for 35 minutes.
Stir in sour cream. Cook for 2 more minutes.
pack-hearty-chicken-soup: Pour the vegetable stock into a big pot. Bring it to a simmer.
Add chicken thigh, carrot, celery, corn, and onion. Cook for 20 minutes.
Take the chicken out. Shred it and put it back.
Add the noodles. Cook for 8 more minutes.
pack-creamy-salmon-pasta: Cook the pasta in salty water, following the pack instructions.
Warm a large pan over medium heat.
Add the salmon and frozen peas. Cook for 13 minutes.
Stir in the cream and heat it through.
Drain the pasta. Toss it with everything else.
Add the parmesan and lemon on top. Serve hot.
pack-creamy-mushroom-pasta: Cook the pasta in salty water, following the pack instructions.
Warm the olive oil in a large pan.
Add the mushroom and spinach. Cook for 13 minutes.
Stir in the cream and heat it through.
Drain the pasta. Toss it with everything else.
Add the parmesan on top. Serve hot.
pack-chicken-schnitzel-mash: Boil the potato until soft. Mash it with the milk and butter.
Dip the chicken breast in flour, then in beaten egg, then in breadcrumbs.
Fry the chicken in a hot pan for 5 minutes each side, until golden.
Steam the green beans for 5 minutes.
Serve the schnitzel with mash, beans and a lemon wedge.
pack-prawn-fried-rice: Cook the rice by following the pack instructions.
Warm the olive oil in a large pan.
Fry the spring onion and ginger for 3 minutes.
Add the prawns, egg and frozen peas. Cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in the soy sauce. Cook for 2 more minutes.
pack-chickpea-spinach-curry: Warm the olive oil in a large pot.
Cook the onion and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the chickpeas, spinach and curry paste. Stir well.
Pour in the coconut milk. Let it simmer for 20 minutes.
pack-tuna-pasta-bake: Cook the pasta by following the pack instructions, then drain it.
Mix the pasta, tuna, corn and cream in a large oven dish.
Bake for 20 minutes, until golden and bubbling.
pack-lamb-feta-tray: Chop the red onion, cherry tomato and potato into chunks.
Put the lamb mince and oregano on the tray with the olive oil.
Bake for 32 minutes, until golden and cooked through.
Top with feta and lemon. Serve hot.
pack-satay-chicken-rice: Heat a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chicken thigh, capsicum, peanut butter and soy sauce. Stir well.
Pour in the coconut milk. Let it simmer for 20 minutes.
Serve with the rice and a squeeze of lime.
pack-beef-pasta-bake: Cook the pasta by following the pack instructions, then drain it.
Fry the beef mince, onion and garlic in olive oil until browned.
Mix the pasta, beef and crushed tomato in a large oven dish. Add the mozzarella and basil on top.
Bake for 20 minutes, until golden and bubbling.
pack-pork-fried-rice: Cook the rice by following the pack instructions.
Warm the olive oil in a large pan.
Fry the ginger and spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add the pork mince, egg, cabbage and carrot. Cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in the soy sauce. Cook for 2 more minutes.
pack-chicken-cacciatore: Warm the olive oil in a large pot.
Cook the onion and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the chicken thigh, capsicum, olives and oregano. Stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato. Let it simmer for 35 minutes.
pack-lentil-bolognese: Warm the olive oil in a large pot.
Cook the onion and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the lentils, carrot and oregano. Stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato. Let it simmer for 25 minutes.
Stir in the parmesan. Cook for 2 more minutes.
pack-prawn-curry: Warm the olive oil in a large pot.
Cook the onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the prawns, spinach and curry paste. Stir well.
Pour in the coconut milk. Let it simmer for 15 minutes.
Serve with the rice and a squeeze of lime.
pack-beef-nachos: Fry the beef mince until browned. Stir in the black beans.
Cut the tortillas into triangles. Bake them for 6 minutes, until crisp.
Put the tortilla chips on a tray. Add the beef mix, capsicum and cheese on top.
Bake for 8 more minutes. Then add the salsa and sour cream on top.
pack-salmon-coconut-curry: Warm the olive oil in a large pot.
Add the salmon, green beans and curry paste. Stir well.
Pour in the coconut milk. Let it simmer for 15 minutes.
Serve with the rice and a squeeze of lime.
pack-halloumi-tray-bake: Chop the red onion, zucchini, capsicum, cherry tomato and potato into chunks.
Add the oregano to the tray with the olive oil.
Bake for 22 minutes, until golden and cooked through.
Top with halloumi and lemon. Serve hot.
pack-chicken-hotpot: Heat a large pot over medium heat.
Cook the onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the chicken thigh, potato, carrot and frozen peas. Stir well.
Pour in the vegetable stock. Let it simmer for 35 minutes.
Mix the flour into the cream. Stir it into the hotpot and cook for 3 more minutes.
Add the parsley on top. Serve hot.
pack-beef-noodle-stir-fry: Cook the noodles by following the pack instructions.
Warm the olive oil in a large pan.
Fry the garlic and ginger for 3 minutes.
Add the beef strips, capsicum and cabbage. Cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in the soy sauce. Cook for 2 more minutes.
pack-mexican-chicken-rice-bowl: Cook the rice by following the pack instructions.
Warm the olive oil in a large pan.
Add the chicken breast, kidney beans, corn and capsicum. Cook for 18 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in the taco seasoning. Cook for 2 more minutes.
Top with cheese and lime. Serve over the rice.
pack-spinach-ricotta-pasta: Cook the pasta in salty water, following the pack instructions.
Warm the olive oil in a large pan.
Add the spinach. Cook for 8 minutes.
Drain the pasta. Toss it with everything else.
Top with ricotta, parmesan and lemon. Serve hot.
pack-honey-soy-pork: Cook the rice by following the pack instructions.
Warm the olive oil in a large pan.
Add the pork mince and green beans. Cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in the honey and soy sauce. Cook for 2 more minutes.
pack-baked-fish-wedges: Cut the potato into wedges. Bake them with olive oil for 20 minutes.
Dip the white fish in beaten egg, then in breadcrumbs.
Add the fish to the tray. Bake for 12 more minutes.
Serve with peas and a lemon wedge.
pack-zucchini-slice: Grate the zucchini. Squeeze out the extra water.
Whisk the eggs and flour in a large bowl.
Stir in the zucchini, bacon, cheese, onion and olive oil.
Pour the mixture into a lined dish. Bake for 30 minutes, until set and golden.
pack-tofu-satay: Cook the rice by following the pack instructions.
Warm the olive oil in a large pan.
Add the tofu and capsicum. Cook for 13 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in the peanut butter, soy sauce and coconut milk. Cook for 2 more minutes.
Top with lime. Serve over the rice.
pack-greek-beef-meatballs: Cook the rice by following the pack instructions.
Mix the beef mince, breadcrumbs, egg, oregano and garlic. Roll the mixture into balls.
Fry the meatballs in olive oil until browned all over.
Pour in the crushed tomato. Let it simmer for 12 minutes.
Serve over rice and add crumbled feta on top.
pack-pesto-chicken-tray: Chop the cherry tomato, green beans and potato into chunks.
Add the chicken breast and pesto to the tray with the olive oil.
Bake for 32 minutes, until golden and cooked through.
pack2-breakfast-tacos: Cook the egg the way you like it.
Add salsa, then fold or roll them up.
pack2-greek-yogurt-toast: Spread a thick layer of greek yogurt on each slice.
Drizzle honey over the slices and sprinkle with cinnamon.
pack2-masala-eggs: Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Warm a pan over medium heat.
Cook the onion, spring onion and tomato for 4 minutes.
Pour in the eggs. Cook gently until just set.
Add the butter and garam masala on top. Serve.
pack2-breakfast-quesadilla: Scramble the eggs in a pan until just set.
Place the egg, ham, cheese and capsicum over one half of each tortilla.
Cook in a dry hot pan for 2 minutes each side, until the cheese melts.
pack2-spinach-feta-egg-cups: Whisk the eggs and milk together in a jug.
Mix in spinach, chopped tomato, and crumbled feta.
Pour the mixture into a greased muffin tray.
Bake for 15 minutes, until set and golden.
pack2-carrot-cake-oats: Put rolled oats and milk in a pot with a little water.
Cook on low for 11 minutes. Stir often.
Mix in cinnamon, honey, sugar, and carrot.
Spoon greek yogurt on top and serve warm.
pack2-eggs-spicy-beans: Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Cook onion for 3 minutes. Then add black beans, crushed tomato, and chilli flakes.
Let it simmer for 8 minutes, until thick.
Make small wells and crack the eggs into them.
Cover and cook for 5 minutes, then serve on toasted bread.
pack2-berry-smoothie-bowl: Blend most of the mixed berries with banana, milk, peanut butter, rolled oats, and honey until thick and smooth.
Spoon the mixture into two bowls.
Add the rest of the mixed berries on top.
pack2-tofu-spinach-wrap: Fill it with spinach and tomato.
Add mayonnaise, then fold or roll it up.
pack2-greek-village-omelette: Heat the olive oil in a pan.
Fry the thin potato slices for 6 minutes, until soft.
Whisk the eggs, then pour them over the potato.
Add tomato and olives. Cook gently until just set.
Add feta and oregano on top, then serve.
pack2-feta-tomato-toast: Add tomato slices and olives on top.
Drizzle with olive oil, then sprinkle oregano over it.
pack2-french-toast-berries: Whisk egg, milk, and cinnamon in a shallow bowl.
Dip the bread slices in the mixture until soaked.
Melt the butter in a big pan. Fry the bread for 2 minutes on each side.
pack2-spiced-potato-egg-fry: Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Add egg and potato. Cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Mix in cumin and chilli flakes. Cook for 2 more minutes.
Add parsley on top and serve hot.
pack2-salmon-scramble-toast: Melt the butter in a pan and gently scramble the eggs.
Flake the salmon into the pan and warm it through for 1 minute.
Pile the eggs onto the toast.
Top with spring onion and a squeeze of lemon.
pack2-chilaquiles-eggs: Cut the tortillas into triangles. Fry them in a dry, hot pan until crisp.
Pour the salsa into the pan and warm it through.
Scramble the eggs in a second pan.
Mix the eggs into the salsa and tortilla crisps with the onion.
Top with cheese and sour cream and serve.
pack2-green-breakfast-smoothie: Put banana, avocado, and milk in a blender.
Add honey, chia seeds, and spinach.
Pour into glasses and serve cold.
pack2-denver-omelette: Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Heat a pan over medium heat.
Cook onion, capsicum, and ham for 4 minutes.
Pour in the eggs. Cook gently until just set.
Top with cheese and butter, then serve.
pack2-cauliflower-breakfast-hash: Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Add egg and cauliflower. Cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Mix in smoked paprika and cook for 2 more minutes.
Add parsley on top and serve hot.
pack2-baked-beans-eggs: Mix kidney beans, crushed tomato, oregano, and olive oil in an oven dish.
Make small wells and crack the eggs into them.
Bake for 15 minutes, until the eggs are just set.
Add feta on top and serve with the bread.
pack2-sweet-rice-porridge: Put rice and milk in a pot with a little water.
Cook on low for 16 minutes. Stir often.
Add banana on top and serve warm.
pack2-zucchini-herb-frittata: Put zucchini and egg in a big oven dish.
Pour milk and olive oil over them.
Cover the dish and bake for 12 minutes.
Top with feta and parsley and serve hot.
pack2-greek-meze-plate: Warm the pita bread and falafel as the pack says.
Cut cucumber and tomato into chunks.
Put falafel, feta, olives, cucumber, and tomato on two plates.
Add a big spoon of greek yogurt to each plate.
Serve with the pita bread and a squeeze of lemon.
pack2-chicken-tikka-wrap: Mix half the greek yogurt with garam masala. Coat the chicken breast in the mixture.
Fry the chicken until cooked through, then slice it.
Fill them with chicken, lettuce, tomato, and cucumber.
Add the rest of the greek yogurt. Roll up and serve.
pack2-smoky-chicken-sandwich: Cook the chicken breast until done, then slice it.
Mix the mayonnaise with smoked paprika.
Fill the bread with chicken, cheese, lettuce, and tomato.
pack2-warm-lentil-salad: Cook lentils until done, then let them cool a little.
Put feta in a big bowl.
Add olive oil, parsley, and lemon. Toss well.
pack2-chicken-taco-bowl: Cook the rice as the pack says, then let it cool.
Cook chicken breast until done, then let it cool a little.
Put black beans in a big bowl.
Add salsa and lime. Toss well.
pack2-corn-chowder: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook onion and celery in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add bacon, corn, and potato. Stir well.
Pour in the milk and simmer for 20 minutes.
Mix in cream and butter. Cook for 2 more minutes.
Serve hot with parsley on top.
pack2-prawn-tacos: Add mayonnaise, chilli flakes, and lime. Fold or roll up.
pack2-caprese-salad: Put mozzarella in a big bowl.
Add olive oil and basil. Toss well.
pack2-greek-pasta-salad: Cook the pasta as the pack says, then let it cool.
Chop cucumber, cherry tomato, olives, and red onion.
Put feta in a big bowl.
Add olive oil, oregano, and lemon. Toss well.
pack2-tuna-melt: Drain the tuna. Mix it with mayonnaise and chopped spring onion.
Top the bread with tuna mixture and tomato slices.
Grill or bake for 4 minutes, until the cheese melts.
pack2-chicken-noodle-salad: Cook the noodles as the pack says, then let them cool.
Cook chicken breast until done, then let it cool a little.
Chop capsicum, carrot, and spring onion.
Add soy sauce and lime. Toss well.
pack2-chickpea-smash-sandwich: Drain the chickpeas and mash them roughly with a fork.
Mix chickpeas with avocado, a squeeze of lemon, and chilli flakes.
Fill with lettuce and the chickpea smash.
pack2-spiced-lentil-tomato-soup: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook onion and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add lentils and garam masala. Stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato, vegetable stock, and coconut milk. Simmer for 20 minutes.
Serve hot with a squeeze of lime.
pack2-blt-wrap: Cook the bacon until it is done.
Fill it with lettuce and tomato.
Add mayonnaise, then fold or roll it up.
pack2-tzatziki-pita-plate: Grate the cucumber, then squeeze out the extra water.
Mix the cucumber with greek yogurt, crushed garlic, a squeeze of lemon and olive oil.
Chop the tomato and lettuce into a small salad.
Serve the pita bread with the yogurt mix and salad.
pack2-tuna-poke-bowl: Cook the rice as the pack says, then let it cool.
Chop the cucumber, spring onion and avocado.
Put the tuna in a big bowl.
Add the soy sauce, chilli flakes and lime, then toss everything well.
pack2-chicken-couscous-salad: Cook the couscous as the pack says, then let it cool.
Cook the chicken breast until it is done, then let it cool a little.
Chop the cucumber and cherry tomato.
Add the olive oil, parsley and lemon, then toss everything well.
pack2-turkish-style-eggs: Mix the greek yogurt with crushed garlic and spread it on two plates.
Melt the butter with the chilli flakes until it foams.
Poach or fry the eggs how you like them.
Put the eggs on the yogurt and pour the hot butter over them.
pack2-beef-taco-salad: Cook the beef mince until it is done, then let it cool a little.
Chop the lettuce, tomato and corn.
Put the black beans and cheese in a big bowl.
Add the salsa and lime, then toss everything well.
pack2-ham-potato-salad: Boil the potato until it is just soft, then let it cool a little.
Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, then peel and chop them.
Mix the potato, ham, egg and spring onion in a big bowl.
Add the mayonnaise and parsley, then toss everything well.
pack2-pesto-chicken-pasta-salad: Cook the pasta as the pack says, then let it cool.
Cook the chicken breast until it is done, then let it cool a little.
Chop the cherry tomato and spinach.
Put the parmesan in a big bowl.
Add the pesto and toss everything well.
pack2-cauliflower-fritters: Chop the cauliflower into small pieces, then steam or boil it for 5 minutes until soft.
Mix the cauliflower with the egg, flour, garam masala and chopped spring onion.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry spoonfuls of the mix for 3 minutes each side until golden.
pack2-mexican-corn-salad: Chop the corn, capsicum and red onion.
Put the black beans and feta in a big bowl.
Add the olive oil and lime, then toss everything well.
pack2-salami-pasta-salad: Cook the pasta as the pack says, then let it cool.
Chop the cherry tomato, cucumber and olives.
Put the salami and mozzarella in a big bowl.
Add the olive oil and basil, then toss everything well.
pack2-chicken-avocado-wrap: Cook the chicken breast until it is done.
Fill it with lettuce, tomato, avocado and sour cream.
pack2-moussaka: Fry the beef mince, onion and garlic in olive oil until brown, then stir in the crushed tomato and cinnamon.
Whisk the flour into the milk, heat it until thick, then stir in half the cheese.
Layer the potato slices and beef mix in an oven dish, pour the sauce over them and top with the rest of the cheese.
pack2-chicken-biryani: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Fry the onion, garlic and ginger for 5 minutes.
Add the chicken thigh and garam masala, then cook for 8 minutes.
Stir in the rice, greek yogurt and frozen peas with 500 ml water.
Cover the pot and cook on low for 20 minutes until the rice is soft.
Let it rest for 5 minutes, fluff it and serve it hot.
pack2-chicken-tacos: Fry the chicken breast with the taco seasoning until cooked through, then slice it.
Warm the taco shells as the pack says.
Fill the shells with chicken, lettuce and tomato.
Top them with cheese and sour cream.
pack2-lamb-curry: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook the onion, garlic and ginger in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the lamb mince and garam masala, then stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and let it simmer for 40 minutes.
Stir in the greek yogurt and cook for 2 more minutes.
pack2-greek-pork-skewers: Mix the pork mince with oregano and garlic, then shape it onto skewers or into long patties.
Fry it in olive oil for 12 minutes, turning it until cooked through.
Chop the cucumber, tomato and red onion into a salad.
Serve the skewers in pita bread with salad, greek yogurt and a squeeze of lemon.
pack2-smoky-beef-meatballs: Mix the beef mince, breadcrumbs, egg and smoked paprika, then roll the mix into balls.
Fry the meatballs in olive oil until brown all over.
Pour in the tomato passata and honey, then let it simmer for 12 minutes.
Boil the potato until soft, then mash it with butter and milk.
Serve the meatballs and sauce over the mash.
pack2-chicken-alfredo-pasta: Cook the pasta in salty water as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Add the chicken breast and cook for 13 minutes.
Stir in the cream and warm it through.
Drain the pasta and toss everything together.
Top it with parmesan, butter and parsley, then serve it hot.
pack2-beef-kofta-curry: Mix the beef mince, breadcrumbs, egg and half the garam masala, then roll the mix into balls.
Fry the kofta in olive oil until brown all over.
Add the onion and cook for 3 minutes.
Pour in the crushed tomato and coconut milk with the rest of the garam masala, then let it simmer for 15 minutes.
pack2-fish-tacos: Fry the white fish until golden and flaky.
Warm the taco shells as the pack says.
Mix the mayonnaise with chilli flakes and a squeeze of lime.
Fill the shells with fish, cabbage and corn.
Drizzle the sauce over them and serve.
pack2-greek-baked-salmon: Put the cherry tomato, olives, salmon and potato in a big oven dish.
Pour the oregano and olive oil over them.
Cover the dish and bake for 17 minutes.
Top it with feta and lemon, then serve it hot.
pack2-chicken-shawarma-plate: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Coat the chicken thigh with cumin, smoked paprika and olive oil.
Fry the chicken for 12 minutes until charred at the edges, then slice it.
Chop the cucumber and tomato into a salad.
Serve the chicken over rice with salad, greek yogurt, pita bread and a squeeze of lemon.
pack2-beef-mushroom-stew: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook the onion and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the beef strips, mushroom, carrot and potato, then stir well.
Pour in the vegetable stock and let it simmer for 45 minutes.
Stir in the butter and cook for 2 more minutes.
Serve it with the flour and top it with parsley.
pack2-prawn-salami-rice: Heat the olive oil in a big, wide pan or pot.
Fry the salami and capsicum for 3 minutes.
Add the rice, crushed tomato, smoked paprika and vegetable stock, then stir well.
Cover the pan and let it simmer for 15 minutes.
Lay the prawns and frozen peas on top, cover the pan and cook for 6 more minutes.
Let it rest for 5 minutes, then serve it with a squeeze of lemon.
pack2-peanut-chicken-curry: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Add the chicken thigh, capsicum, peanut butter and curry paste, then stir well.
Pour in the coconut milk and let it simmer for 20 minutes.
Serve it with the rice and a squeeze of lime.
pack2-lamb-tacos: Fry the lamb mince with the taco seasoning until brown and crisp at the edges.
Warm the taco shells as the pack says.
Fill the shells with lamb, lettuce and tomato.
Top them with feta and greek yogurt.
pack2-vegetable-biryani: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Fry the onion, garlic and ginger for 5 minutes.
Add the cauliflower, carrot and garam masala, then cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the rice, frozen peas and 500 ml water.
Cover the pot and cook on low for 18 minutes until the rice is soft.
Let it rest for 5 minutes and serve it with greek yogurt.
pack2-chicken-salami-tray: Chop the red onion, capsicum, cherry tomato and potato into chunks.
Add the chicken thigh, salami and oregano to the tray with the olive oil.
Bake for 32 minutes until golden and cooked through.
pack2-beef-noodle-soup: Pour the vegetable stock into a big pot and bring it to a simmer.
Add the beef strips, carrot, ginger, garlic and soy sauce, then cook for 10 minutes.
Add the noodles and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until it wilts.
Top with spring onion and serve it hot.
pack2-salmon-fish-cakes: Boil the potato until soft, then mash it roughly.
Flake the salmon. Mix it with potato, egg, breadcrumbs and chopped spring onion.
Fry the cakes in olive oil for 4 minutes each side, until golden.
Serve with lettuce, mayonnaise and a wedge of lemon.
pack2-pork-meatball-noodle-soup: Mix pork mince with the egg, ginger and garlic. Roll the mixture into small balls.
Pour the vegetable stock into a big pot. Bring it to a simmer.
Add the meatballs and cook for 8 minutes.
Add the noodles and spinach. Cook 4 more minutes.
Add soy sauce. Top with spring onion and serve hot.
pack2-chicken-enchiladas: Fry the chicken breast with onion and taco seasoning. Then shred it.
Fill the tortillas with chicken and black beans, then roll them up in an oven dish.
Pour crushed tomato over them and scatter cheese on top.
Bake for 20 minutes and serve with sour cream.
pack2-garlic-butter-prawns: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Add prawns. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in chilli flakes. Cook 2 more minutes.
Top with butter, parsley and lemon. Serve over the rice.
pack2-beef-potato-curry: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add beef strips, potato, curry paste and peanut butter. Stir well.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer for 35 minutes.
pack2-chicken-ham-bake: Put chicken breast, ham and broccoli in a big oven dish.
Pour the cream over them and scatter garlic through the dish.
Bake for 25 minutes, until golden and cooked through.
pack2-bean-corn-tacos: Warm the black beans in a pot with cumin. Mash a few with a fork.
Warm the taco shells as the pack says.
Fill the shells with beans, corn and capsicum.
Top with avocado, salsa and cheese.
Serve with a squeeze of lime.
pack2-honey-soy-salmon: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the garlic and spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add salmon and broccoli. Cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in honey and soy sauce. Cook 2 more minutes.
pack2-lamb-lentil-stew: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook celery, onion and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add lamb mince, lentils, carrot and oregano. Stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and vegetable stock. Simmer for 40 minutes.
pack2-chicken-gyros: Coat the chicken thigh with oregano and olive oil.
Fry the chicken for 12 minutes until cooked through, then slice it.
Chop the cucumber, tomato and red onion.
Fill the pita bread with chicken and salad. Add greek yogurt and a squeeze of lemon.
pack2-beef-stroganoff: Cook the pasta in salty water as the pack says.
Melt the butter in a big pan. Fry onion, garlic and mushroom for 5 minutes.
Add beef strips and smoked paprika. Cook for 6 minutes.
Stir in sour cream and warm it through gently. Do not boil.
Serve over the pasta and top with parsley.
pack2-prawn-tomato-pasta: Cook the pasta in salty water as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Add prawns and cook for 13 minutes.
Stir in chilli flakes and crushed tomato. Warm through.
Drain the pasta and toss everything together.
Top with basil and serve hot.
pack2-herb-crumb-chicken: Mix breadcrumbs with parmesan, parsley and garlic.
Dip the chicken breast in beaten egg, then in the crumb mix.
Bake the chicken with potato wedges, green beans and olive oil for 22 minutes.
Serve with a wedge of lemon.
pack2-falafel-plate-rice: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Warm the falafel as the pack says.
Chop the cucumber, tomato and lettuce into a salad.
Serve falafel over rice with salad, greek yogurt, pita bread and a squeeze of lemon.
pack2-beef-kebab-plate: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Mix beef mince with cumin, smoked paprika and garlic. Shape it into thick patties.
Fry the patties in olive oil for 10 minutes until cooked through.
Chop cucumber and tomato into a salad.
Serve the kebabs over rice with salad, greek yogurt and a squeeze of lemon.
pack2-sticky-chicken-tray: Chop garlic, broccoli and sweet potato into chunks.
Add chicken thigh, honey and soy sauce to the tray.
Bake for 32 minutes until golden and cooked through.
pack2-vegetable-paella: Heat the olive oil in a big, wide pan.
Fry capsicum, zucchini and garlic for 5 minutes.
Add rice, crushed tomato, smoked paprika and vegetable stock. Stir well.
Scatter frozen peas on top. Cover and let it rest 5 minutes.
Serve with a squeeze of lemon.
pack2-creamy-tuna-rice: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add tuna, frozen peas and corn. Cook for 13 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in cream and cook 2 more minutes.
Top with cheese and lemon. Serve over the rice.
pack2-pork-cabbage-stir-fry: Cook the noodles as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the garlic and ginger for 3 minutes.
Add pork mince, cabbage and carrot. Cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in soy sauce and cook 2 more minutes.
pack2-creamy-chicken-mushroom-rice: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the garlic and onion for 3 minutes.
Add chicken breast and mushroom. Cook for 18 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in cream and cook 2 more minutes.
Top with parsley and serve over the rice.
pack2-sweet-soy-beef-bowl: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Fry beef mince with garlic and ginger until browned.
Add honey and soy sauce. Cook 2 more minutes until glossy.
Serve beef over rice with carrot and cucumber on top.
Scatter spring onion over and serve.
pack2-greek-chicken-pasta-bake: Cook the pasta as the pack says, then drain it.
Fry chicken thigh and garlic in olive oil until golden.
Mix pasta, chicken, crushed tomato and olives in an oven dish.
Top with feta and oregano. Bake for 20 minutes.
pack2-lentil-cottage-pie: Cook the lentils in vegetable stock for 20 minutes until soft.
Fry onion and carrot, then stir in lentils, crushed tomato and frozen peas.
Boil the potato and mash it with milk and butter.
Put the lentil mix in an oven dish. Top with mash and cheese.
Bake at 180 degrees for 20 minutes until golden.
pack2-chicken-noodle-stir-fry: Cook the noodles as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Add chicken breast, capsicum, cabbage and carrot. Cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in soy sauce and cook 2 more minutes.
pack2-crumbed-fish-salad: Dip the white fish in flour, then beaten egg, then breadcrumbs.
Fry the fish in olive oil for 4 minutes each side until golden.
Chop lettuce, tomato and cucumber into a salad.
Serve the fish with salad and mayonnaise.
pack2-mexican-lasagne: Fry beef mince and onion with taco seasoning until browned.
Stir in black beans, corn and half the crushed tomato.
Layer tortillas and beef mix in an oven dish, like a lasagne.
Pour the rest of the crushed tomato over. Top with cheese and bake for 25 minutes.
pack3-italian-herb-frittata: Put cherry tomato and egg in a big oven dish.
Pour over milk and olive oil.
Top with mozzarella and basil. Serve hot.
pack3-masala-egg-fried-rice: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Add egg and frozen peas. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in cumin and chilli flakes. Cook 2 more minutes.
pack3-spinach-ricotta-toast: Wilt the spinach in a hot pan with the garlic for 2 minutes.
Spread ricotta thickly on each slice.
Top with spinach, a squeeze of lemon and chilli flakes.
pack3-banana-bircher-oats: Stir rolled oats, greek yogurt and milk in a bowl.
Cover and let it rest in the fridge overnight, or at least 4 hours.
Top with sliced banana, peanut butter and honey.
pack3-egg-bhurji: Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Heat a pan over medium heat.
Cook the onion, ginger, spring onion, and tomato for 4 minutes.
Pour in the eggs. Cook gently until they are just set.
Top with butter, chilli flakes, and cumin. Serve.
pack3-halloumi-egg-plate: Fry the halloumi in olive oil for 2 minutes each side, until golden.
Fry the eggs how you like them.
Chop the tomato and cucumber. Mix them with the olives to make a salad.
Serve the halloumi and eggs with the salad and bread.
pack3-cinnamon-french-toast: Whisk egg, milk, cinnamon, and sugar in a shallow bowl.
Dip the bread slices in the mix until they are soaked.
Melt the butter in a big pan. Fry the bread for 2 minutes each side.
Cut into sticks if you like.
Serve warm with banana and maple syrup.
pack3-tofu-breakfast-bowl: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add tofu, egg, and spinach. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in soy sauce. Cook for 2 more minutes.
pack3-greek-milk-pie: Whisk milk, egg, sugar, and flour into a smooth batter.
Pour it into an oven dish greased with the butter.
Bake for 30 minutes, until set with golden spots.
Dust with cinnamon. Add a squeeze of lemon.
pack3-mexican-scrambled-eggs: Melt the butter in a pan.
Fry onion, capsicum, and tomato for 4 minutes.
Whisk the eggs. Pour them in with the chilli flakes.
Stir gently until the eggs are just set.
pack3-oat-pancakes: Grind rolled oats into a rough flour.
Whisk oat flour, flour, baking powder, egg, milk, and mashed banana into a batter.
Melt the butter in a big pan.
Fry small pancakes for 2 minutes each side, until golden.
pack3-hash-browns-eggs: Grate the potato and onion. Squeeze out the extra water.
Mix them with flour. Shape them into flat cakes.
Fry them in butter for 5 minutes each side, until crisp and golden.
Fry the eggs how you like them.
Serve the hash browns with eggs and spring onion on top.
pack3-garden-veggie-omelette: Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Heat a pan over medium heat.
Cook spring onion, zucchini, capsicum, and mushroom for 4 minutes.
Pour in the eggs. Cook gently until they are just set.
Top with cheese and butter. Serve.
pack3-warm-chia-oats: Put rolled oats and milk in a pot with a little water.
Cook on low for 8 minutes. Stir often.
Stir in chia seeds, cinnamon, and honey.
pack3-spiced-chickpeas-egg: Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry onion and ginger for 3 minutes.
Add chickpeas, crushed tomato, and garam masala. Simmer for 8 minutes.
Fry the eggs in a second pan.
Serve the chickpeas on toasted bread with an egg on top.
pack3-breakfast-salad-bowl: Cook the egg and bacon until done. Let them cool a little.
Chop spinach, cherry tomato, and avocado.
Add olive oil and lemon. Toss well.
pack3-coconut-rice-pudding: Put rice and coconut milk in a pot with a little water.
Cook on low for 21 minutes. Stir often.
Top with mixed berries. Serve warm.
pack3-cheese-tomato-omelette: Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Heat a pan over medium heat.
Pour in the eggs. Cook gently until they are just set.
Top with cheese, butter, and parsley. Serve.
pack3-baked-berry-oats: Mix rolled oats, milk, egg, honey, baking powder, and cinnamon in an oven dish.
Bake for 22 minutes, until set and golden on top.
pack3-spanish-style-eggs: Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry onion, capsicum, and zucchini for 6 minutes.
Add chopped tomato and smoked paprika. Cook for 4 more minutes.
Make little wells. Crack the eggs into them.
Cover and cook for 5 minutes. Serve with toasted bread.
pack3-pasta-frittata: Put frozen peas, egg, ham, and pasta in a big oven dish.
pack3-spiced-lentil-wraps: Cook lentils until they are done.
Fill with spinach, cucumber, and greek yogurt.
Add garam masala. Fold or roll it up.
pack3-tuna-corn-fritters: Mix tuna, corn, egg, flour, and chopped spring onion into a batter.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry spoonfuls of batter for 3 minutes each side, until golden.
Serve with mayonnaise and a squeeze of lemon.
pack3-caprese-pasta: Cook the pasta in salty water as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Add cherry tomato. Cook for 6 minutes.
Drain the pasta. Toss everything together.
Top with mozzarella and basil. Serve hot.
pack3-crumbed-chicken-sandwich: Dip the chicken breast in beaten egg. Then coat it in breadcrumbs.
Fry until golden and cooked through. Then slice.
Fill with chicken, lettuce, and tomato.
pack3-beetroot-feta-pasta: Cook the pasta in salty water as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Drain the pasta. Toss everything together.
Top with feta, parsley, and lemon. Serve hot.
pack3-indian-chickpea-salad: Chop tomato, cucumber, and red onion.
Put chickpeas in a big bowl.
Add cumin, chilli flakes, olive oil, and lemon. Toss well.
pack3-salmon-cucumber-sandwich: Cook the salmon until just done. Flake it.
Fill with salmon, cucumber, and spring onion.
pack3-chicken-corn-quesadillas: Fry the chicken breast until cooked through. Slice it thinly.
Lay chicken and corn over one half of each tortilla.
Fold each tortilla. Cook in a dry, hot pan for 3 minutes each side, until the cheese melts.
pack3-lemon-pasta-salad: Cook the pasta as the pack says. Then let it cool.
Put feta in a big bowl.
Add olive oil, lemon, and parsley. Toss well.
pack3-falafel-couscous-salad: Warm the falafel as the pack says.
Pour hot water over the couscous. Let it rest 5 minutes, then fluff it with a fork.
Toss couscous with the salad, olive oil, and a squeeze of lemon.
pack3-herb-chicken-wrap: Fill with lettuce, tomato, and cheese.
Add mayonnaise and parsley. Fold or roll it up.
pack3-tuna-mornay: Cook the pasta as the pack says. Drain it.
Whisk flour into the milk. Heat until thick, then stir in half the cheese.
Mix pasta, tuna, corn, and sauce in an oven dish.
Top with breadcrumbs and the rest of the cheese. Bake for 15 minutes.
pack3-pork-slaw-sandwich: Shape pork mince into two patties with the smoked paprika.
Fry the patties until cooked through.
Mix cabbage with mayonnaise to make a slaw.
Fill with patties, cheese, and slaw. Serve.
pack3-simple-dal-rice: Warm the olive oil in a large pot.
Cook the onion, garlic, and ginger in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the lentils and cumin. Stir well.
Add the crushed tomato and coconut milk. Let them simmer for 20 minutes.
Serve with the rice and squeeze some lime over it.
pack3-chicken-caesar-salad: Fry the bacon until crisp, and boil the eggs for 9 minutes.
Cook the chicken breast until done, then slice it.
Toast the bread, then cut it into croutons.
Put the lettuce, chicken, bacon, egg, and croutons in a large bowl.
Add mayonnaise, a squeeze of lemon, and parmesan. Toss well.
pack3-beetroot-bean-burger: Use a fork to mash the black beans roughly.
Mix the beans with grated beetroot, breadcrumbs, and egg. Shape the mix into patties.
Fry the patties in olive oil for 4 minutes each side, until crisp.
Fill the bread with patties, lettuce, tomato, and mayonnaise. Serve.
pack3-spanish-potato-omelette: Fry the thin potato slices and onion in olive oil for 12 minutes, until soft.
Whisk the eggs, then pour them over the potato.
Cook gently for 6 minutes, until nearly set.
Flip it carefully, or finish cooking it under a hot grill for 2 minutes.
Let it rest for 5 minutes, then serve it warm.
pack3-greek-tuna-salad: Chop the tomato, cucumber, olives, and red onion.
Put the tuna and feta in a large bowl.
Add olive oil and lemon. Toss well.
pack3-mushroom-pea-rice: Melt the butter in a large pot. Fry the onion, garlic, and mushroom for 5 minutes.
Add the rice. Stir for 1 minute.
Add the vegetable stock one ladle at a time. Keep stirring until the rice is soft, about 18 minutes.
Stir in frozen peas and parmesan.
Let it rest for 2 minutes, then serve.
pack3-prawn-cocktail-salad: Cook the prawns until pink, then let them cool a little.
Mix mayonnaise with a squeeze of lemon and chilli flakes.
Put lettuce and chopped tomato in two glasses or bowls.
Put the prawns and sauce on top.
pack3-beef-lasagne: Fry beef mince, onion, and garlic in olive oil until brown. Stir in crushed tomato and let it simmer for 10 minutes.
Whisk flour into the milk. Heat it until thick, then stir in half the cheese.
Layer pasta sheets and beef mix in an oven dish. Pour the sauce over them.
Put the rest of the cheese on top and bake for 30 minutes.
pack3-japanese-chicken-curry: Warm the olive oil in a large pot.
Cook the onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add chicken thigh, carrot, frozen peas, potato, and curry paste. Stir well.
Add the coconut milk and let it simmer for 30 minutes.
pack3-spicy-pork-curry: Warm the olive oil in a large pot.
Cook the onion, garlic, and ginger in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add pork mince, garam masala, and chilli flakes. Stir well.
Add the crushed tomato and let it simmer for 35 minutes.
pack3-lamb-shawarma-plate: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Fry lamb mince with cumin and smoked paprika in olive oil until the edges are crisp.
Chop the tomato and red onion for a salad.
Serve the lamb over rice with salad, greek yogurt, pita bread, and a squeeze of lemon.
pack3-country-beef-pie: Fry beef mince, onion, and carrot until brown. Stir in frozen peas and vegetable stock, then let it simmer for 10 minutes.
Rub butter into the flour. Add cold water and roll out the pastry.
Fill a pie dish with the beef mix and cover it with pastry.
Bake at 180 degrees for 30 minutes, until golden.
pack3-fish-pie: Boil the potato until soft. Mash it with half the milk and half the butter.
Whisk flour into the rest of the milk. Heat it until thick.
Flake the white fish and salmon into the sauce with frozen peas and parsley.
Put the mixture in an oven dish. Cover it with mash and cheese.
Bake at 180 degrees for 20 minutes, until golden.
pack3-tandoori-chicken: Mix half the greek yogurt with garam masala, smoked paprika, garlic, and ginger. Coat the chicken thigh with it.
Let the chicken rest for 15 minutes, or overnight if you can.
Bake at 200 degrees for 25 minutes, until the edges are charred.
Cook the rice as the pack says.
Serve chicken over rice with cucumber, the rest of the greek yogurt, and a squeeze of lemon.
pack3-salmon-soy-ginger: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a large pan.
Fry the ginger, garlic, and spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add salmon and green beans. Cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in soy sauce and honey. Cook for 2 more minutes.
pack3-spinach-ricotta-cannelloni: Mix spinach, ricotta, and garlic in a bowl.
Fill the pasta tubes with the mix and lay them in an oven dish.
Pour crushed tomato over them and drizzle with olive oil.
Put mozzarella on top and bake for 30 minutes.
pack3-lamb-keema-peas: Warm the olive oil in a large pot.
Cook the onion and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add lamb mince, frozen peas, potato, cumin, and garam masala. Stir well.
Add the tomato passata and let it simmer for 25 minutes.
pack3-chicken-fried-rice: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a large pan.
Fry the ginger and spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add chicken breast, egg, frozen peas, and carrot. Cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in soy sauce and cook for 2 more minutes.
pack3-prawn-noodle-stir-fry: Cook the noodles as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a large pan.
Fry the spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add prawns and egg. Cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in peanut butter, soy sauce, and honey. Cook for 2 more minutes.
Top with lime and serve over the noodles.
pack3-slow-beef-casserole: Heat a large pot over medium heat.
Cook the onion and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add beef strips, mushroom, carrot, and sweet potato. Stir well.
Add the tomato passata and vegetable stock. Let them simmer for 50 minutes.
Stir in butter and cook for 2 more minutes.
Serve hot, with parsley on top.
pack3-chicken-pot-pie: Fry chicken thigh, onion, and carrot until golden. Stir in frozen peas, milk, and vegetable stock, then let them simmer for 10 minutes.
Rub butter into the flour. Add cold water and roll out the pastry.
Fill a pie dish with the chicken mix and cover it with pastry.
Bake at 180 degrees for 30 minutes, until golden.
pack3-tofu-green-bean-curry: Warm the olive oil in a large pot.
Cook the ginger in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add tofu, green beans, and curry paste. Stir well.
Add the coconut milk and let it simmer for 15 minutes.
Serve with the rice and squeeze some lime over it.
pack3-salmon-burgers: Flake the salmon and mix it with breadcrumbs, egg, and chopped spring onion.
Fry the patties in olive oil for 4 minutes each side, until golden.
Fill the pita bread with patties, cucumber, and tomato. Add greek yogurt and a squeeze of lemon.
pack3-crumbed-pork-patties: Shape the pork mince into 8 patties.
Dip the patties in flour, then beaten egg, then breadcrumbs.
Fry them in olive oil for 5 minutes each side, until golden and cooked through.
Mix cabbage and carrot with mayonnaise and a squeeze of lemon to make a slaw.
Serve the patties with the slaw.
pack3-three-bean-chilli: Warm the olive oil in a large pot.
Cook the onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add black beans, kidney beans, chickpeas, corn, and smoked paprika. Stir well.
Add the crushed tomato and let it simmer for 30 minutes.
Serve with the rice and put avocado on top.
pack3-tomato-basil-chicken-pasta: Cook the pasta in salty water as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a large pan.
Add chicken breast and cook for 13 minutes.
Stir in crushed tomato and warm it through.
Drain the pasta and toss everything together.
Put mozzarella and basil on top. Serve hot.
pack3-taco-pie: Fry beef mince with taco seasoning until brown.
Stir in black beans and corn.
Layer tortillas and beef mix in a pie dish.
Put salsa and cheese on top. Bake for 20 minutes.
pack3-fish-prawn-curry: Warm the olive oil in a large pot.
Add white fish, prawns, spinach, and curry paste. Stir well.
Add the coconut milk and let it simmer for 15 minutes.
Serve with the rice and squeeze some lime over it.
pack3-lamb-pita-pockets: Fry lamb mince with cumin in olive oil until the edges are crisp.
Chop cucumber, tomato, and red onion for a salad.
Fill the pita bread with lamb and salad.
Add greek yogurt and a squeeze of lemon. Serve.
pack3-pork-cabbage-dumplings: Mix flour with warm water to make dough. Let it rest for 20 minutes, then roll out small circles.
Mix pork mince with finely chopped cabbage, ginger, garlic, and spring onion.
Fill each circle, fold it, and pinch the edges closed.
Fry in olive oil for 3 minutes. Add a splash of water, cover, and steam for 5 minutes.
pack3-beef-capsicum-stir-fry: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a large pan.
Fry the onion and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add the beef strips and capsicum. Cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Add the soy sauce and honey. Stir, then cook for 2 more minutes.
Serve the beef over the rice.
pack3-sweet-chilli-chicken: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a large pan.
Add the chicken thigh and broccoli. Cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Add the honey, chilli flakes and soy sauce. Stir, then cook for 2 more minutes.
Serve the chicken over the rice.
pack3-prawn-paella: Heat the olive oil in a large, wide pan.
Fry the onion, capsicum and garlic for 5 minutes.
Add the rice, smoked paprika and vegetable stock. Stir well.
Cover the pan and simmer for 15 minutes.
Put the prawns and green beans on top. Cover and cook for 6 more minutes.
Let it rest for 5 minutes, then serve with a squeeze of lemon.
pack3-tuna-olive-pasta: Cook the pasta in salty water as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a large pan.
Add the tuna, olives and cherry tomato. Cook for 8 minutes.
Drain the pasta, then toss everything together.
Top with lemon and parsley. Serve hot.
pack3-pork-meatball-sandwich: Mix the pork mince, breadcrumbs, egg and garlic. Roll the mix into balls.
Fry the meatballs until brown all over.
Pour in the tomato passata and simmer for 10 minutes.
Fill the bread with meatballs and sauce. Top with mozzarella and basil, then serve.
pack3-roast-chicken-veg: Cut the onion, garlic, carrot and potato into chunks.
Put the chicken thigh and oregano in the tray with the olive oil.
Bake for 42 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Top with lemon and serve hot.
pack3-beef-spinach-curry: Heat the olive oil in a large pot.
Cook the onion and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the beef strips, spinach and curry paste. Stir well.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer for 25 minutes.
pack3-salmon-chowder: Heat a large pot over medium heat.
Cook the onion and celery in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the salmon, corn and potato. Stir well.
Pour in the milk and simmer for 25 minutes.
Stir in the butter and cook for 2 more minutes.
Serve with the bread and top with parsley.
pack3-chicken-fajita-tray: Put the chicken breast strips, capsicum and red onion on a tray with the taco seasoning and olive oil.
Bake for 22 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Fill the tortillas with the chicken mix. Top with sour cream, avocado and a squeeze of lime.
pack3-fish-tikka: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Mix the greek yogurt, garam masala, garlic and ginger. Coat the white fish with the mix.
Let the fish rest for 10 minutes.
If you like, fry the fish on a bed of spinach for 8 minutes, until golden.
Serve the fish over rice with a squeeze of lemon and the spinach wilted through.
pack3-slow-beef-ragu: Heat the olive oil in a large pot.
Cook the red onion, celery and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the beef strips and carrot. Stir well.
Pour in the tomato passata and simmer for 45 minutes.
Stir in the parmesan and cook for 2 more minutes.
pack3-greek-chicken-rice: Heat the olive oil in a large pot.
Fry the chicken thigh and garlic until golden.
Add the rice, oregano and vegetable stock. Stir well.
Cover the pot and simmer for 18 minutes until the rice is soft.
Stir in the spinach and feta. Add a squeeze of lemon and serve.
pack3-prawn-zucchini-pasta: Cook the pasta in salty water as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a large pan.
Add the prawns and zucchini. Cook for 8 minutes.
Stir in the chilli flakes and warm through.
Drain the pasta, then toss everything together.
Top with lemon and parsley. Serve hot.
pack3-tofu-laksa-soup: Pour the vegetable stock and coconut milk into a large pot. Bring them to a simmer.
Stir in the curry paste and ginger.
Add the tofu and capsicum. Cook for 6 minutes.
Add the noodles and cook for 4 minutes.
Top with spring onion and a squeeze of lime. Serve hot.
pack3-pork-ragu-pasta: Heat the olive oil in a large pot.
Cook the onion and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the pork mince and stir well.
Pour in the tomato passata and simmer for 30 minutes.
Stir in the parmesan and cook for 2 more minutes.
Serve with the pasta and top with basil.
pack3-mexican-chicken-soup: Heat a large pot over medium heat.
Cook the onion and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the chicken thigh, black beans, corn and cumin. Stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and vegetable stock. Simmer for 30 minutes.
Serve hot with avocado on top and a squeeze of lime.
pack3-lamb-feta-pasta: Cook the pasta in salty water as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a large pan.
Add the lamb mince, cherry tomato and spinach. Cook for 13 minutes.
Stir in the oregano and warm through.
Drain the pasta, then toss everything together.
Top with feta and serve hot.
pack3-beef-pilaf: Heat the olive oil in a large pot.
Fry the beef mince and onion until brown.
Add the rice, carrot, frozen peas, cumin and vegetable stock. Stir well.
Cover and simmer for 18 minutes until the rice is soft.
Let it rest for 5 minutes, then serve with greek yogurt.
pack3-herb-crumb-salmon: Press the crumb mix onto the salmon.
Bake the salmon with sweet potato wedges and olive oil for 18 minutes. Add the spinach for the last 3 minutes.
Serve with a wedge of lemon.
pack3-chicken-gumbo-stew: Heat the olive oil in a large pot.
Cook the celery and onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the chicken thigh, capsicum and smoked paprika. Stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and vegetable stock. Simmer for 35 minutes.
Serve with the flour and rice.
pack3-vegetable-korma: Heat the olive oil in a large pot.
Cook the onion, garlic and ginger in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the cauliflower, frozen peas, potato and garam masala. Stir well.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer for 25 minutes.
pack4-menemen-eggs: Heat the olive oil in a pan.
Fry the onion and capsicum for 4 minutes.
Add the chopped tomato. Cook for 4 minutes until soft.
Whisk the eggs, then gently stir them through until just set.
pack4-granola-crunch-bowl: Spoon the granola into two bowls.
Add the greek yogurt on top.
Top with sliced banana and mixed berries.
Pour a little milk over each bowl.
pack4-avocado-feta-toast: Mash the avocado with a squeeze of lemon.
Spread the avocado thickly on each slice.
Top with cherry tomato, feta and chilli flakes.
pack4-cinnamon-roll-oats: Put the rolled oats and milk into a pot.
Cook on low heat for 5 minutes, stirring often, until thick and creamy.
Stir in the cinnamon and sugar.
Top with sliced banana and a small knob of butter, then serve.
pack4-egg-drop-soup: Pour the vegetable stock into a pot and bring it to a simmer.
Add the corn, ginger and soy sauce. Cook for 5 minutes.
Slowly pour in the beaten egg as you stir, so it forms ribbons.
Top with spring onion and serve hot.
pack4-churros-sticks: Heat 150 ml water and the butter in a pot until the butter melts.
Stir in the flour until a smooth dough ball forms, then let it cool a little.
Beat in the egg. Pipe or spoon the dough into long sticks.
Fry in a hot pan for 3 minutes, turning until golden all over.
Roll in sugar and cinnamon. Serve warm.
pack4-green-eggs-ham: Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Heat a pan over medium heat.
Cook the spinach and ham for 4 minutes.
Pour in the eggs and cook gently until just set.
Top with cheese and butter, then serve.
pack4-banana-coconut-smoothie: Put the banana, greek yogurt and coconut milk in a blender.
Pour into glasses and serve cold.
pack4-ricotta-berry-toast: Spread the ricotta thickly on each slice.
Drizzle with honey and scatter basil over it.
pack4-masala-omelette: Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Warm a pan over medium heat.
Cook the onion, capsicum and mushroom for 4 minutes.
Pour in the eggs and cook gently until they are just set.
Add butter and garam masala on top, then serve.
pack4-savoury-breakfast-couscous: Prepare the couscous as the pack says.
Warm the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the spring onion in the pan for 3 minutes.
Add egg and capsicum. Cook for 5 minutes and stir now and then.
Top it with feta, then serve it over the couscous.
pack4-bacon-egg-cups: Push the bread into a muffin tray to make cups.
Crack an egg into each cup. Add cheese and spring onion over them.
Bake for 14 minutes until the eggs are just set.
pack4-classic-french-omelette: Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Warm a pan over medium heat.
Pour in the eggs and cook gently until they are just set.
Add butter, cheese, parsley and bread on top, then serve.
pack4-sweet-potato-toast: Cut the sweet potato into thick planks. Bake or toast them until soft.
Fry the eggs as you like them.
Mash the avocado with a squeeze of lemon.
Put avocado and an egg on top of the sweet potato planks.
Sprinkle chilli flakes on top and serve.
pack4-banana-berry-parfait: Add greek yogurt in layers to two glasses or bowls.
Add mixed berries and sliced banana.
Sprinkle chia seeds over each layer.
Pour maple syrup over the top and serve.
pack4-breakfast-ramen: Pour the vegetable stock into a pot and heat it until it simmers.
Fry the bacon until crisp, then set it aside.
Cook the noodles in the stock for 4 minutes with the spinach.
Soft boil the eggs for 6 minutes. Peel and halve them.
Serve the noodles in bowls with bacon, egg, spring onion and soy sauce.
pack4-bubble-and-squeak: Boil the potato until soft, then mash it roughly.
Mix the potato with chopped cabbage, flour and beaten egg.
Fry the bacon until crisp, then set it aside.
Fry spoonfuls of the potato mix in butter for 4 minutes each side.
Serve with the bacon on top.
pack4-omelette-wrap: Beat the eggs, then cook a thin omelette in a big pan.
Place ham, cheese, spinach and tomato down the middle.
Cook for 1 more minute until the cheese starts to melt.
Roll the omelette up like a wrap.
Cut it in half and serve.
pack4-warm-berry-oats: Put rolled oats and milk in a pot with a little water.
Cook on low for 8 minutes and stir often.
Add mixed berries and banana on top, then serve warm.
pack4-greek-lamb-wrap: Cook lamb mince until it is done.
Put cucumber, tomato, feta and greek yogurt inside.
Add oregano and lemon, then fold or roll it up.
pack4-pasta-primavera: Cook the pasta in salty water as the pack says.
Warm the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the garlic in the pan for 3 minutes.
Add zucchini, capsicum, cherry tomato and frozen peas. Cook for 8 minutes.
Drain the pasta and mix it with everything.
Add parmesan on top and serve hot.
pack4-chicken-shawarma-wrap: Cover the chicken thigh with cumin and smoked paprika.
Fry the chicken for 10 minutes until cooked through, then cut it into slices.
Put chicken, cucumber and tomato inside.
Add greek yogurt and a squeeze of lemon. Roll up and serve.
pack4-tuna-chickpea-salad: Put tuna and chickpeas in a big bowl.
Add olive oil, parsley and lemon. Mix everything well.
pack4-blt-pasta-salad: Cook the pasta as the pack says, then let it cool.
Cook the bacon until done, then let it cool a little.
Chop lettuce, tomato and spring onion.
Add mayonnaise and mix everything well.
pack4-asian-chicken-noodle-soup: Pour the vegetable stock into a big pot. Heat it until it simmers.
Add chicken thigh, corn and ginger. Cook for 12 minutes.
Take the chicken out, pull it into pieces and put it back.
Add the noodles and spinach. Cook for 4 more minutes.
Add spring onion on top and serve hot.
pack4-falafel-burger: Warm the falafel as the pack says.
Put falafel, tomato and lettuce inside.
Add greek yogurt and a squeeze of lemon.
pack4-caprese-couscous-salad: Cook the couscous as the pack says, then let it cool.
Put mozzarella in a big bowl.
Add olive oil and basil. Mix everything well.
pack4-baked-samosas: Boil the potato until soft. Mash it roughly with frozen peas, onion, cumin and garam masala.
Mix flour with olive oil and warm water to make dough. Roll it into circles.
Put potato mix in each circle. Fold them and pinch the edges together.
Bake at 190 degrees for 20 minutes until crisp and golden.
pack4-veggie-quesadillas: Fry the capsicum and zucchini for 4 minutes until soft.
Place capsicum, zucchini, corn, black beans and cheese over one half of each tortilla.
Cook in a dry hot pan for 3 minutes each side until the cheese melts.
pack4-lentil-carrot-patties: Cook the lentils in water until soft, about 15 minutes, then drain them well.
Mix lentils with grated carrot, breadcrumbs, egg, cumin and flour. Shape the mix into patties.
Fry the patties for 4 minutes each side until crisp.
pack4-tomato-cheese-tart: Rub butter into the flour. Add cold water and roll out a pastry base.
Put sliced tomato and mozzarella on top.
Bake for 20 minutes until the pastry is crisp.
Sprinkle basil on top and brush the edge with beaten egg, then serve.
pack4-prawn-noodle-salad: Cook the noodles as the pack says, then let them cool.
Cook the prawns until done, then let them cool a little.
Chop cucumber, carrot and spring onion.
Add soy sauce, chilli flakes and lime. Mix everything well.
pack4-chicken-laksa: Pour the vegetable stock and coconut milk into a pot. Heat it until it simmers.
Mix in curry paste. Add chicken breast and capsicum, then cook for 8 minutes.
Take the chicken out, slice it and put it back.
Add the noodles and cook for 4 minutes.
Add spring onion and a squeeze of lime on top.
pack4-greek-meatball-soup: Mix beef mince with rice, half the beaten egg, onion and parsley. Roll the mix into small meatballs.
Pour the vegetable stock into a big pot and heat it until it simmers.
Drop in the meatballs and simmer them for 20 minutes.
Whisk the rest of the egg with lemon juice. Stir in a ladle of hot stock, then stir it back into the pot.
Serve hot, after it stops boiling, so the sauce stays silky.
pack4-curried-chickpea-wrap: Warm the chickpeas in a pan with the curry paste for 4 minutes.
Put chickpeas, spinach and cucumber inside.
Add greek yogurt, roll up and serve.
pack4-german-potato-salad: Boil the potato until just soft, then cut it into thick slices.
Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, peel them and chop them.
Mix the warm potato with mayonnaise, bacon and egg.
Add spring onion and parsley on top, then serve.
pack4-greek-lemon-potatoes: Chop garlic and potato into chunks.
Add oregano to the tray with the olive oil.
Pour the vegetable stock over everything.
Bake for 27 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Add feta and lemon on top, then serve hot.
pack4-chicken-satay-wraps: Fry the chicken breast until cooked through, then cut it into slices.
Mix peanut butter with soy sauce and a squeeze of lime to make a sauce.
Put chicken, cucumber, carrot and lettuce inside.
Pour the satay sauce over the top, roll up and serve.
pack4-sweetcorn-zucchini-cakes: Mix corn, grated zucchini, beaten egg, flour and spring onion to make a batter.
Fry spoonfuls in olive oil for 3 minutes each side until golden.
pack4-antipasto-plate: Lightly toast the bread, then spread pesto on it.
Place the salami, mozzarella, olives and sliced tomato on a large plate.
Serve the pesto toast with the plate.
pack4-chicken-madras: Warm the olive oil in a large pot.
Cook the onion, garlic and ginger in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the chicken thigh, garam masala and chilli flakes. Stir well.
Add the crushed tomato and coconut milk. Let it simmer for 30 minutes.
pack4-beef-tomato-curry: Warm the olive oil in a large pot.
Cook the onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the beef strips, green beans, capsicum and curry paste. Stir well.
Add the crushed tomato and let it simmer for 30 minutes.
pack4-shepherds-pie: Fry the lamb mince, onion, carrot and celery until brown. Add the frozen peas, flour and vegetable stock, then let it simmer for 10 minutes.
Boil the potato until soft. Mash it with the milk and butter.
Put the lamb mix in an oven dish and cover it with the mash.
Bake for 25 minutes until the top is golden.
pack4-pork-goulash: Warm the olive oil in a large pot.
Cook the onion and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the pork mince, capsicum and smoked paprika. Stir well.
Add the crushed tomato and let it simmer for 30 minutes.
Mix in the sour cream and cook for 2 more minutes.
pack4-fish-korma: Warm the olive oil in a large pot.
Cook the onion, garlic and ginger in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the white fish, spinach and garam masala. Stir well.
Add the coconut milk and let it simmer for 15 minutes.
pack4-chicken-jambalaya: Heat a large pot. Fry the chicken thigh, onion and capsicum for 6 minutes.
Add the rice, smoked paprika, chilli flakes and vegetable stock. Stir well.
Mix in the corn and kidney beans.
Cover the pot and let it simmer for 18 minutes until the rice is soft.
Place the prawns on top. Cover the pot and cook for 4 more minutes.
pack4-beef-broccoli-noodles: Cook the noodles as the pack says.
Warm the olive oil in a large pan.
Fry the garlic and spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add the beef strips and broccoli. Cook for 8 minutes, and stir now and then.
Mix in the soy sauce and honey. Cook for 2 more minutes.
pack4-salmon-broccoli-bake: Cook the pasta as the pack says, then drain it.
In an oven dish, mix the pasta with the salmon chunks, broccoli, cream and garlic.
Bake for 20 minutes. Serve with a wedge of lemon.
pack4-crumbed-tofu-rice: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Coat the tofu slices in flour, then beaten egg, then breadcrumbs.
Fry for 4 minutes on each side until crisp and golden.
Mix the cabbage with the mayonnaise to make a slaw.
Serve the tofu over the rice with the slaw and soy sauce.
pack4-lamb-kofta-plate: Mix the lamb mince with the cumin and oregano. Shape it into small kofta.
Fry the kofta in olive oil for 10 minutes. Turn them until they are brown and cooked through.
Pour hot water over the couscous and leave it for 5 minutes. Fluff it with a fork.
Serve the kofta over the couscous with the feta and olives.
Scatter the parsley on top and add a squeeze of lemon.
