pack4-prawn-bisque-soup: Heat a large pot over medium heat.
Cook the onion and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the prawns and stir well.
Add the tomato passata and vegetable stock. Let it simmer for 20 minutes.
Mix in the cream and butter. Cook for 2 more minutes.
Serve with the bread and parsley on top.
pack4-chicken-dumpling-stew: Heat the butter in a large pot. Fry the chicken thigh, onion, carrot and celery for 6 minutes.
Add the vegetable stock and frozen peas. Let it simmer for 15 minutes.
Mix the flour and milk to make a soft dough. Drop spoonfuls on top of the stew.
Cover the pot and cook for 12 more minutes until the dumplings puff up.
Add the parsley on top and serve hot.
pack4-beef-sweet-potato-tagine: Warm the olive oil in a large pot.
Cook the onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the beef strips, chickpeas, sweet potato, cinnamon and cumin. Stir well.
Add the crushed tomato and let it simmer for 35 minutes.
pack4-pork-bibimbap-bowl: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Warm the olive oil in a large pan.
Fry the spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add the pork mince, egg, carrot and spinach. Cook for 13 minutes, and stir now and then.
Mix in the soy sauce and chilli flakes. Cook for 2 more minutes.
pack4-fragrant-baked-fish: Put the garlic, ginger, spring onion, broccoli, white fish and rice in a large oven dish.
Pour the chilli flakes and olive oil over the food.
Cover the dish and bake for 17 minutes.
Add the lemon on top and serve hot.
pack4-chicken-paprikash: Cook the pasta as the pack says.
Melt the butter. Fry the chicken thigh, onion and capsicum until golden.
Mix in the smoked paprika and crushed tomato. Let it simmer for 10 minutes.
Take the pot off the heat and mix in the sour cream.
pack4-mushroom-bolognese: Warm the olive oil in a large pot.
Cook the onion, celery and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the mushroom, spinach and oregano. Stir well.
Add the crushed tomato and let it simmer for 20 minutes.
Mix in the parmesan and cook for 2 more minutes.
pack4-salmon-noodle-soup: Pour the vegetable stock into a large pot and bring it to a simmer.
Add the salmon pieces, ginger and garlic. Cook for 6 minutes.
Add the noodles and spinach. Cook for 4 more minutes.
Add the spring onion and a squeeze of lime on top. Serve hot.
pack4-chicken-empanadas: Fry the chicken breast, capsicum and taco seasoning until cooked. Chop the chicken into small pieces, then mix it with the corn and cheese.
Rub the butter into the flour. Add cold water and roll out circles.
Put filling in each circle, fold it over and pinch the edges.
Brush them with a little milk.
Bake at 190 degrees for 20 minutes until golden.
pack4-beef-mushroom-pie: Fry the beef mince, mushroom and onion until brown. Mix in the frozen peas and vegetable stock, then let it simmer for 8 minutes.
Rub the butter into the flour. Add cold water and roll out the pastry.
Put the beef mix in a pie dish and cover it with pastry.
Brush the pastry with beaten egg.
Bake at 180 degrees for 28 minutes until golden.
pack4-tofu-peanut-noodles: Cook the noodles as the pack says.
Warm the olive oil in a large pan.
Add the tofu, broccoli and carrot. Cook for 8 minutes, and stir now and then.
Mix in the peanut butter and soy sauce. Cook for 2 more minutes.
Add the lime on top and serve over the noodles.
pack4-stuffed-capsicums-lamb: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Fry the lamb mince and onion with oregano in olive oil until brown. Mix in the rice and half the crushed tomato.
Fill the capsicum halves with the lamb mix. Add the rest of the crushed tomato and the feta on top.
Bake for 25 minutes until the capsicum is soft.
pack4-chicken-curry-pie: Fry the chicken thigh and onion with the curry paste for 6 minutes. Mix in the coconut milk and frozen peas, then let it simmer for 8 minutes.
Rub the butter into the flour. Add cold water and roll out the pastry.
Put the chicken mix in a pie dish and cover it with pastry.
Brush the pastry with beaten egg.
Bake at 180 degrees for 28 minutes until golden.
pack4-philly-beef-sandwich: Fry the beef strips, capsicum and onion in butter until brown and soft.
Toast the bread and spread mayonnaise on it.
Fill the bread with the beef mix.
Put the cheese on top and let it melt for 1 minute.
pack4-pork-noodle-stir-fry: Cook the noodles as the pack says.
Warm the olive oil in a large pan.
Fry the garlic and ginger for 3 minutes.
Add the pork mince, green beans and capsicum. Cook for 8 minutes, and stir now and then.
Mix in the soy sauce and honey. Cook for 2 more minutes.
pack4-lemon-garlic-chicken-bake: Put the garlic, green beans, chicken breast and potato in a large oven dish.
Cover the dish and bake for 27 minutes.
Add the butter, lemon and parsley on top. Serve hot.
pack4-salmon-rice-tray: Cook the rice until just underdone. Spread it on a tray.
Put the salmon and broccoli on top with the garlic and olive oil.
Bake for 16 minutes until the salmon flakes.
Serve with the spring onion and a squeeze of lemon.
pack4-beef-korma: Warm the olive oil in a large pot.
Cook the onion, garlic and ginger in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the beef strips, green beans and garam masala. Stir well.
Add the coconut milk and let it simmer for 30 minutes.
pack4-prawn-fajitas: Fry the prawns, capsicum and onion with the taco seasoning in olive oil until the prawns are pink.
Fill them with the prawn mix.
Add the sour cream and avocado on top.
Serve with a squeeze of lime.
pack4-tofu-burgers: Mash the tofu with breadcrumbs, beaten egg, flour, and soy sauce. Shape it into patties.
Fry the patties for 5 minutes on each side until crisp.
Fill the bread with patties, lettuce, and tomato.
pack4-irish-lamb-stew: Heat a large pot over medium heat.
Cook the celery and onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the lamb mince, carrot, and potato. Stir them well.
Pour in the vegetable stock. Let it simmer for 40 minutes.
Stir in the butter. Cook for 2 more minutes.
Serve with the flour and parsley on top.
pack4-chicken-pasta-bake-creamy: Cook the pasta as the pack says, then drain it.
Fry the chicken breast and garlic until golden. Stir in the cream and spinach until the spinach wilts.
Mix the pasta and chicken mix in an oven dish.
Add the cheese and breadcrumbs on top. Bake for 18 minutes.
pack4-white-fish-chowder: Heat a large pot over medium heat.
Cook the onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the white fish, bacon, corn, and potato. Stir them well.
Pour in the milk. Let it simmer for 25 minutes.
Stir in the cream. Cook for 2 more minutes.
Serve hot with parsley on top.
pack4-beef-fajita-bowl: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a large pan over medium heat.
Add the beef mince, black beans, and capsicum. Cook for 13 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in the taco seasoning. Cook for 2 more minutes.
Put the cheese, sour cream, and lime on top. Serve over the rice.
pack4-pork-bean-stew: Heat the olive oil in a large pot.
Cook the onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the pork mince, kidney beans, capsicum, and smoked paprika. Stir them well.
Pour in the crushed tomato. Let it simmer for 30 minutes.
Stir in the sour cream. Cook for 2 more minutes.
pack4-chicken-broccoli-pasta-bake: Cook the pasta as the pack says, then drain it.
Fry the chicken thigh and garlic until golden. Stir in the cream and broccoli.
Mix the pasta and chicken mix in an oven dish.
Add the mozzarella and breadcrumbs on top. Bake for 18 minutes.
pack4-soy-glazed-salmon-noodles: Cook the noodles as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a large pan.
Fry the ginger and spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add the salmon and capsicum. Cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in the soy sauce and honey. Cook for 2 more minutes.
pack4-beef-meatloaf: Mix the beef mince, breadcrumbs, beaten egg, and onion. Shape the mix into a loaf.
Spread the tomato passata on top. Bake for 40 minutes.
Boil the potato until soft, then mash it with the butter and milk. Boil the green beans for 5 minutes.
Let the loaf rest for 5 minutes. Slice it and serve with the mash and green beans.
pack4-prawn-skewers-rice: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Put the prawns on skewers, with garlic and chilli flakes rubbed over them.
Fry or grill the skewers in olive oil for 3 minutes on each side until pink.
Chop the cucumber and tomato into a salad.
Serve the skewers over rice with the salad and parsley. Squeeze lemon over them.
pack4-tofu-potato-curry: Heat the olive oil in a large pot.
Cook the onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the tofu, spinach, potato, and curry paste. Stir them well.
Pour in the coconut milk. Let it simmer for 20 minutes.
pack4-lamb-hummus-wraps: Fry the lamb mince until the edges are crisp.
Mash the chickpeas with a squeeze of lemon to make a rough spread.
Warm the tortillas and spread them with the chickpea mix.
Fill them with lamb, cucumber, and tomato.
Add the greek yogurt, roll them up, and serve.
pack4-chicken-stroganoff: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a large pan over medium heat.
Fry the onion and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add the chicken breast, mushroom, and spinach. Cook for 18 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in the smoked paprika. Cook for 2 more minutes.
Put the sour cream and parsley on top. Serve over the rice.
pack4-baked-fish-tomato-olives: Pour hot water over the couscous. Let it rest for 5 minutes, then fluff it with a fork.
Put the white fish and capsicum in an oven dish with the crushed tomato, olives, and garlic. Drizzle with olive oil.
Bake for 16 minutes until the fish flakes.
Scatter the basil on top. Serve over the couscous.
pack5-western-scramble: Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Heat a pan over medium heat.
Cook the onion, capsicum, mushroom, and spinach for 4 minutes.
Pour in the eggs. Cook gently until just set.
Put the cheese and butter on top, then serve.
pack5-pork-egg-sandwich: Shape the pork mince into two thin patties. Fry them until cooked through.
Fry the eggs the way you like them.
Fill the bread with the patties, egg, and cheese.
pack5-toasted-muesli-bowl: Toast the rolled oats in a dry pan for 3 minutes until golden.
Spoon the greek yogurt into two bowls.
Add the oats, sliced banana, and chia seeds on top.
Add a splash of milk and a drizzle of honey.
pack5-breakfast-tostada: Bake or dry fry the tortillas until crisp.
Mash the black beans and warm them through.
Fry the eggs the way you like them.
Spread the beans on the tostadas. Add the egg and cheese on top.
Add the salsa and avocado, then serve.
pack5-peanut-overnight-oats: Mix the rolled oats, peanut butter, greek yogurt, and chia seeds in a bowl or jar.
Let the mix rest in the fridge overnight, or for at least 4 hours.
Put the mixed berries on top.
pack5-egg-ham-quesadilla: Scramble the eggs softly with the mushroom and spinach.
Lay the egg and ham over one half of each tortilla.
Add the cheese on top and fold the tortillas in half.
Cook in a dry, hot pan for 2 minutes on each side until the cheese melts.
pack5-banana-peanut-french-toast: Mash the banana. Whisk it with the eggs.
Dip the bread slices in the mix.
Fry them in butter for 2 minutes on each side until golden.
pack5-savoury-oat-bowl: Put the rolled oats and vegetable stock in a pot.
Cook on low heat for 5 minutes. Stir often until thick.
Stir in the spinach and cheese until the spinach wilts.
Top with a soft fried egg and spring onion, then serve.
pack5-veggie-breakfast-burrito: Scramble the eggs with the spinach and black beans.
Fill them with the egg mix and cheese.
Roll them up tight and serve.
pack5-bean-egg-breakfast-pots: Mix the black beans, crushed tomato, corn, and smoked paprika in an oven dish.
Make little wells and crack the eggs into them.
Scatter the cheese over the top.
Bake for 12 minutes. Serve with warm tortilla pieces for dipping.
pack5-oat-banana-slice: Mash the bananas. Mix them with the beaten egg, honey, and cinnamon.
Stir in the rolled oats and flour.
Press the mix into a lined tray. Scatter the mixed berries on top.
Bake for 18 minutes. Let it cool, then cut it into bars.
pack5-baked-custard-oats: Whisk the milk, eggs, sugar, and cinnamon.
Stir in the rolled oats and sliced banana.
Pour the mix into an oven dish.
Bake for 25 minutes until it sets like a soft custard.
pack5-chinese-tomato-eggs: Heat the olive oil in a pan.
Cook the chopped tomato for 4 minutes until it makes a sauce.
Add the soy sauce and sugar.
Pour in the beaten egg. Stir gently until just set.
Put the spring onion on top and serve.
pack5-potato-zucchini-rosti: Grate the potato and zucchini, then squeeze out the extra water.
Mix them with the beaten egg, flour, and spring onion.
Fry flat spoonfuls in olive oil for 4 minutes on each side until crisp.
pack5-breakfast-veggie-loaf: Mix the flour and baking powder in a large bowl.
Stir in the beaten egg, milk, grated zucchini and carrot, ham, and cheese.
Pour the mix into a lined loaf tin.
Bake for 28 minutes until a skewer comes out clean.
pack5-yogurt-custard-toast: Whisk the greek yogurt, egg, honey, and cinnamon.
Press a well into each bread slice. Fill each one with the yogurt mix.
Put the mixed berries on top.
Bake for 12 minutes until the custard is just set.
pack5-creamy-mushroom-toast: Cook the mushrooms and garlic until golden.
Add the cream and simmer for 3 minutes, until thick.
Stir in the spinach until it wilts.
Pile the mushrooms onto the toast and sprinkle parmesan on top.
pack5-halloumi-breakfast-salad: Cook the egg until done, then let it cool a little.
Chop the cherry tomato, cucumber, and lettuce.
Put the halloumi in a big bowl.
Add the olive oil and lemon, then toss it all well.
pack5-carrot-cake-smoothie: Put the banana, greek yogurt, and milk in a blender.
Add the cinnamon, honey, and carrot.
Pour it into glasses and serve it cold.
pack5-eggs-florentine: Cook the spinach in a pan until soft, then put it on the toast.
Poach the eggs in gently simmering water for 3 minutes.
Place the eggs on the spinach.
Melt the butter with a squeeze of lemon and the cheese. Pour it over the eggs, then serve.
pack5-beans-bacon-breakfast-bowl: Cook the potato cubes in butter until crisp and golden.
Cook the bacon and heat the black beans.
Scramble or fry the eggs, then cook the spinach until soft.
Put everything in two bowls and serve.
pack5-chicken-club-wrap: Cook the chicken breast and bacon until done.
Fill it with lettuce, tomato, and cheese.
Add the mayonnaise, then fold or roll it up.
pack5-taco-salad: Cook the beef mince until brown and crisp around the edges.
Bake the tortilla until crisp, then break it into pieces.
Put the lettuce in a big bowl with the beef, tomato, corn, and black beans.
Add the cheese and tortilla pieces.
Add the sour cream and salsa on top, then toss everything well.
pack5-cobb-salad: Cook the chicken breast, egg, and bacon until done, then let them cool a little.
Chop the lettuce, tomato, and avocado.
Put the feta in a big bowl.
Add the olive oil and lemon, then toss it all well.
pack5-buffalo-chicken: Bake the chicken breast strips for 18 minutes, until cooked through.
Melt the butter with the chilli flakes and garlic, then toss the chicken in it.
Mix the greek yogurt with a squeeze of lemon to make a dip.
Serve the chicken with celery sticks and the dip.
pack5-chicken-sweetcorn-soup: Warm a big pot over medium heat.
Cook the onion and celery in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the chicken breast, corn, carrot, and potato, then stir well.
Pour in the milk and simmer for 20 minutes.
Serve it hot with parsley on top.
pack5-mexican-bean-soup: Warm the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook the onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the kidney beans, black beans, capsicum, and cumin, then stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and vegetable stock, then simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the sour cream and cook for 2 more minutes.
pack5-sloppy-joes: Cook the beef mince, onion, and capsicum until brown.
Stir in the tomato passata and honey. Simmer for 8 minutes, until thick.
Pile the beef mixture onto the toast.
Add the cheese on top and let it melt, then serve.
pack5-ranch-chicken-salad: Cook the chicken breast until done, then let it cool a little.
Chop the lettuce, cucumber, and tomato.
Put the greek yogurt in a big bowl.
Add the mayonnaise, parsley, and lemon, then toss it all well.
pack5-loaded-baked-potato: Heat the oven to 200 degrees. Bake the potato for 35 minutes, until soft inside.
Cut open the potato and fluff the inside with butter.
Fill it with bacon, corn, and cheese.
Add the sour cream and spring onion on top, then serve.
pack5-pulled-chicken-sandwich: Cook the chicken thigh in gently simmering water for 15 minutes, then shred it.
Mix the chicken with the honey and smoked paprika, then heat it through.
Mix the cabbage with the mayonnaise to make a slaw.
Fill the bread with chicken, slaw, and cheese, then serve.
pack5-charred-corn-feta-salad: Cook the corn in a dry, hot pan until the edges char.
Tip it into a bowl and let it cool a little.
Stir in the mayonnaise, feta, and chilli flakes.
Add a squeeze of lime and the parsley.
pack5-chimichanga: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Cook the chicken breast until done, then chop it small.
Fill the tortillas with chicken, rice, black beans, and cheese. Roll them up tightly.
Cook them seam side down in olive oil until crisp and golden all over.
Serve them with salsa and sour cream.
pack5-tuna-melt-wrap: Mix the tuna with the mayonnaise, chopped celery, and spring onion.
Fill the tortillas and add the cheese on top.
Cook them in a hot, dry pan for 2 minutes each side, until the cheese melts.
pack5-loaded-potato-soup: Warm a big pot over medium heat.
Cook the onion and spring onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the bacon and potato, then stir well.
Pour in the milk and vegetable stock, then simmer for 25 minutes.
Stir in the cheese and sour cream, then cook for 2 more minutes.
pack5-veggie-nachos: Bake the tortillas until crisp, then break them into chips.
Cook the capsicum, zucchini, and corn for 5 minutes.
Put the chips on a tray with the vegetables, kidney beans, and cheese.
Bake for 6 minutes, until the cheese melts.
Add the salsa and greek yogurt on top, then serve.
pack5-greek-chicken-couscous-bowl: Cook the couscous as the pack says, then let it cool.
Cook the chicken breast until done, then let it cool a little.
Chop the tomato, capsicum, and red onion.
Put the feta in a big bowl.
Add the olive oil, lemon, and parsley, then toss it all well.
pack5-chicken-torta: Cook the chicken breast until cooked through, then slice it.
Mash the black beans and spread them on the bread.
Fill it with chicken, capsicum, lettuce, and tomato.
pack5-corn-bacon-fritters: Warm the olive oil in a big pan.
Cook the spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add the bacon, egg, corn, and flour. Cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Add the cheese on top and serve hot.
pack5-salmon-potato-salad: Cook the salmon and egg until done, then let them cool a little.
Chop the green beans, lettuce, and spring onion.
Put the potato in a big bowl.
Add the mayonnaise and lemon, then toss it all well.
pack5-egg-salad-wrap: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, peel them, and chop them.
Mix the egg with the mayonnaise and chilli flakes.
Fill them with the egg mixture, cucumber, and lettuce.
pack5-beef-enchilada-wraps: Cook the beef mince with the taco seasoning until brown, then stir in the black beans.
Fill the tortillas, roll them up, and put them in an oven dish.
Pour the tomato passata over them and sprinkle cheese on top.
Bake for 12 minutes and serve with sour cream.
pack5-chilli-prawn-tacos: Cook the prawns until pink, about 4 minutes.
Mix the mayonnaise with the chilli flakes and a squeeze of lime.
Fill them with lettuce, tomato, prawns, and cheese.
Drizzle the chilli mayo over them and serve.
pack5-chicken-pesto-sandwich: Cook the chicken breast until cooked through, then slice it.
Spread the pesto on the bread.
Lightly toast the sandwiches so the mozzarella melts.
Fill them with chicken, tomato, and spinach.
pack5-red-lentil-soup: Warm the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook the onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the lentils, carrot, and cumin, then stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and vegetable stock, then simmer for 25 minutes.
Stir in the greek yogurt and cook for 2 more minutes.
pack5-blat-wrap: Cook the egg the way you like it.
Fill it with lettuce, tomato, and avocado.
pack5-greek-chicken-wrap: Cook the chicken breast until it is done.
Fill it with cucumber, tomato, lettuce, greek yogurt, and feta.
Add oregano and lemon, then fold or roll it up.
pack5-bbq-chicken-tray: Mix tomato passata, honey, smoked paprika, and garlic to make a sauce.
Put chicken thigh and potato on a tray with olive oil. Pour the sauce over them.
Bake for 30 minutes, until sticky and cooked through.
Serve with boiled corn on the side.
pack5-meatball-subs-cheese: Mix beef mince, breadcrumbs, beaten egg, garlic, and oregano. Shape the mixture into balls.
Fry the meatballs until they are browned all over.
Pour in tomato passata. Simmer for 10 minutes.
Fill the bread with meatballs and sauce, add cheese on top, and serve.
pack5-lemon-herb-chicken-pasta: Cook the pasta in salty water, following the pack instructions.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Add chicken breast and spinach. Cook for 13 minutes.
Drain the pasta and mix everything together.
Top with butter, parmesan, lemon, and parsley. Serve hot.
pack5-smoky-beef-burritos: Cook the rice, following the pack instructions.
Fry beef strips, capsicum, and onion with smoked paprika until browned.
Fill them with rice, the beef mix, and cheese.
Add sour cream, roll them up tightly, and serve.
pack5-beef-enchiladas: Fry beef mince and onion with cumin until browned.
Fill the tortillas, roll them up, and put them in an oven dish.
Pour tomato passata over them and sprinkle on cheese.
Bake for 15 minutes. Serve with sour cream.
pack5-pork-carnitas-tacos: Fry the pork mince over high heat until crisp and browned at the edges.
Fill them with pork, cabbage, and onion.
Top with sour cream and salsa. Serve with a lime wedge.
pack5-white-fish-burgers: Break the white fish into flakes. Mix it with breadcrumbs and beaten egg, then shape it into patties.
Fry the patties for 4 minutes each side, until golden.
Bake or fry the potato to make chunky chips.
Fill the bread with patties, lettuce, and mayonnaise. Add a squeeze of lemon, then serve with the chips.
pack5-country-fried-beef: Dip beef strips in flour, then in beaten egg, then in breadcrumbs.
Fry for 4 minutes each side, until crisp and golden.
Whisk a spoon of flour into the milk. Heat it with butter until thick to make gravy.
Boil the potato and green beans.
Serve the beef with potato, green beans, and gravy.
pack5-prawn-po-boy: Toss the prawns in flour. Fry them until crisp and pink.
Fill the bread with lettuce, tomato, and prawns.
Mix mayonnaise with chilli flakes and a squeeze of lemon. Drizzle it over the filling.
pack5-honey-bbq-pork: Cook the rice, following the pack instructions.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the garlic and spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add pork mince and corn. Cook for 13 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in honey, smoked paprika, and tomato passata. Cook 2 more minutes.
pack5-honey-soy-chicken-tray: Cook the rice, following the pack instructions.
Mix honey, soy sauce, garlic, and ginger. Pour the mixture over the chicken thigh on a tray.
Bake for 28 minutes, until sticky and cooked through.
Serve over rice with spring onion.
pack5-beef-pot-roast: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook onion and celery in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add beef strips, carrot, and potato. Stir well.
Pour in the vegetable stock and tomato passata. Simmer for 50 minutes.
Stir in butter. Cook 2 more minutes.
Serve with the flour and add parsley on top.
pack5-chicken-stuffing-bake: Mix breadcrumbs with melted butter, chopped onion, celery, and parsley to make stuffing.
Put chicken thigh in an oven dish and cover it with the stuffing.
Bake for 35 minutes with potato wedges. Add the green beans for the last 12 minutes.
Let it rest for 5 minutes, then serve.
pack5-cajun-chicken: Cook the rice, following the pack instructions.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the garlic and onion for 3 minutes.
Add chicken breast, capsicum, and corn. Cook for 13 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in smoked paprika and chilli flakes. Cook 2 more minutes.
pack5-seafood-gumbo: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook celery and onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add prawns, white fish, capsicum, and smoked paprika. Stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and vegetable stock. Simmer for 30 minutes.
Serve with the flour and rice.
pack5-prawn-creole: Cook the rice, following the pack instructions.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the onion, celery, garlic, and spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add prawns and capsicum. Cook for 18 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in smoked paprika and crushed tomato. Cook 2 more minutes.
pack5-crispy-chicken-tenders: Dip chicken breast strips in flour, then in beaten egg, then in breadcrumbs.
Fry for 4 minutes each side, until crisp and golden.
Bake or fry the potato to make chunky chips, and boil the corn.
Mix honey into the mayonnaise to make a dip.
Serve the tenders with chips, corn, and the dip.
pack5-beef-chilli-mac: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add beef mince, kidney beans, and cumin. Stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato. Simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in cheese. Cook 2 more minutes.
pack5-pork-stroganoff: Cook the pasta, following the pack instructions.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Add pork mince and mushroom. Cook for 18 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in smoked paprika. Cook 2 more minutes.
Top with sour cream, butter, and parsley. Serve over the pasta.
pack5-fish-chips-bake: Cut the potato into chips and bake for 25 minutes.
Dip the white fish in beaten egg, then in breadcrumbs. Add it to the tray for the last 15 minutes.
pack5-chicken-divan-bake: Cook the rice, following the pack instructions.
Whisk flour into the milk. Heat it with the butter until thick, then stir in half the cheese.
Put chicken breast and broccoli in an oven dish. Pour the sauce over them.
Top with breadcrumbs and the rest of the cheese. Bake for 22 minutes.
pack5-beef-goulash: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add beef strips, capsicum, carrot, potato, and smoked paprika. Stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato. Simmer for 35 minutes.
Stir in sour cream. Cook 2 more minutes.
pack5-salmon-parcels: Rub butter into the flour. Add cold water and roll out the pastry.
Mix flaked salmon with spinach and cream.
Fill the pastry parcels with the salmon mix. Pinch the edges closed.
Brush with beaten egg. Bake for 22 minutes.
Serve with a wedge of lemon.
pack5-chicken-kiev: Mix butter with garlic and parsley. Chill until firm.
Cut a pocket in each chicken breast. Fill it with the garlic butter.
Dip in flour, then in beaten egg, then in breadcrumbs.
Fry for 6 minutes each side, until golden and cooked through.
Serve with potato, green beans, and a wedge of lemon.
pack5-nacho-pie: Fry beef mince until browned. Stir in black beans and corn.
Layer torn tortilla and the beef mix in a pie dish.
Bake for 15 minutes. Serve with sour cream and avocado.
pack5-pork-al-pastor: Fry pork mince, onion, and capsicum with chilli flakes until crisp at the edges.
Fill them with the pork mix and cheese.
Serve with a wedge of lime.
pack5-chicken-taco-soup: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add chicken breast, black beans, corn, and taco seasoning. Stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and vegetable stock. Simmer for 25 minutes.
Stir in cheese. Cook 2 more minutes.
pack5-beef-fajitas: Fry beef strips, capsicum, and onion with taco seasoning until browned.
Fill them with the beef mix and cheese.
Serve with a wedge of lime.
pack5-pork-chile-verde: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add pork mince, capsicum, spinach, and cumin. Stir well.
Pour in the vegetable stock. Simmer for 30 minutes.
Serve with the rice and a squeeze of lime.
pack5-pork-pozole-stew: Warm the olive oil in a large pot.
Cook the onion and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the pork mince, corn, cabbage and cumin. Stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and vegetable stock. Let it simmer for 30 minutes.
Serve it hot with a squeeze of lime.
pack5-chicken-tinga: Simmer the chicken thigh in water for 15 minutes. Then shred it.
Fry the onion and garlic. Add the crushed tomato and chilli flakes, then simmer for 8 minutes.
Stir the chicken into the sauce.
Warm the tortillas and fill them with chicken and cheese.
Top with sour cream and serve with a wedge of lime.
pack5-beef-picadillo: Warm the olive oil in a large pot.
Cook the onion and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the beef mince, carrot, frozen peas, olives and potato. Stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and let it simmer for 25 minutes.
pack5-fish-veracruz: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Warm the olive oil in a large pan.
Fry the onion and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add the white fish, capsicum and olives. Cook for 13 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in the crushed tomato and cook for 2 more minutes.
Top with lime and serve over the rice.
pack5-prawn-diabla: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Warm the olive oil in a large pan.
Fry the onion and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add the prawns and cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in the chilli flakes and crushed tomato. Cook for 2 more minutes.
Top with lime and parsley. Serve over the rice.
pack5-mexican-chicken-rice: Warm the olive oil in a large pot.
Fry the chicken thigh and onion for 6 minutes.
Add the rice, capsicum, corn, crushed tomato, cumin and vegetable stock. Stir well.
Cover the pot and simmer for 18 minutes, until the rice is soft.
Let it rest for 5 minutes. Serve with a squeeze of lime.
pack5-cornbread-beef-pie: Fry the beef mince with taco seasoning until browned. Stir in the black beans.
Mix the flour, corn, melted butter and milk into a thick batter.
Put the beef mix in a pie dish. Spread the batter over it.
Scatter the cheese on top. Bake for 22 minutes, until golden.
pack5-salmon-tacos: Fry the salmon until just cooked. Then flake it.
Mix the mayonnaise with the chilli flakes and a squeeze of lime.
Fill them with cabbage, cucumber and salmon.
Drizzle the chilli mayo over the top and serve.
pack5-white-chicken-chilli: Warm the olive oil in a large pot.
Cook the onion and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the chicken breast, black beans, corn and cumin. Stir well.
Pour in the vegetable stock and let it simmer for 25 minutes.
Stir in the cream and cook for 2 more minutes.
Serve it hot with a squeeze of lime.
pack5-beef-quesadillas: Fry the beef mince, capsicum and onion until browned.
Lay the beef and cheese over one half of each tortilla.
Cook in a dry, hot pan for 3 minutes each side, until the cheese melts.
pack5-bbq-chicken-pizza: Spread the salsa over the pizza base.
Top the pizza with chicken breast, corn, red onion and smoked paprika.
Bake for 21 minutes, until golden and bubbling.
pack5-beef-capsicum-pizza: Spread the salsa over the pizza base.
Top the pizza with beef mince, capsicum, onion and oregano.
Bake for 21 minutes, until golden and bubbling.
pack5-tuna-corn-rice-bake: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Mix the rice with tuna, corn, frozen peas and cream in an oven dish.
pack5-herb-roast-chicken-dinner: Chop the onion, garlic, green beans, potato and pumpkin into chunks.
Add the chicken thigh to the tray.
Bake for 42 minutes, until golden and cooked through.
Top with butter, parsley and lemon. Serve hot.
pack6-poha-rice: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Warm the olive oil in a large pan.
Add the egg and frozen peas. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in the cumin and cook for 2 more minutes.
Top with lemon and serve over the rice.
pack6-upma-couscous: Cook the couscous as the pack says.
Warm the olive oil in a large pan.
Fry the onion and ginger for 3 minutes.
Add the carrot and frozen peas. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in the cumin and cook for 2 more minutes.
Top with lemon and serve over the couscous.
pack6-aloo-paratha: Boil the potato until soft. Mash it with cumin and chilli flakes.
Mix the flour with warm water to make a dough. Roll it into small circles.
Fill each circle with potato mix. Fold it, then roll it flat again.
Fry them in a hot, dry pan for 2 minutes each side.
Brush them with butter and serve with greek yogurt.
pack6-egg-curry-toast: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes. Peel and halve them.
Melt the butter and fry the onion until soft.
Add the chopped tomato and curry paste. Cook for 5 minutes to make a sauce.
Add the eggs and warm them through.
Toast the bread and serve the eggs in sauce on top.
pack6-greek-breakfast-plate: Boil or fry the eggs to your liking.
Toast the bread and drizzle it with olive oil.
Arrange the tomato, cucumber, olives and feta on two plates.
Scatter oregano over the top and serve.
pack6-strapatsada: Warm the olive oil in a pan.
Cook the chopped tomato for 6 minutes, until it thickens.
Whisk the eggs. Stir them into the tomato until just set.
Scatter the feta and oregano over the top.
pack6-italian-breakfast-toast: Fry the eggs to your liking.
Top the toast with sliced tomato and mozzarella.
Add a fried egg to each plate.
pack6-farmhouse-frittata: Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Warm the olive oil in a pan.
Cook the onion, zucchini and capsicum for 4 minutes.
Pour in the eggs and cook gently until just set.
Top with cheese and parsley and serve.
pack6-masala-beans-toast: Melt the butter and fry the onion with cumin and garam masala for 3 minutes.
Add kidney beans and a splash of water. Simmer for 5 minutes, mashing a few beans.
Pile the beans on the toast.
pack6-spanish-tomato-toast-eggs: Toast the bread and rub it with the cut garlic.
Grate or finely chop the tomato. Pile it on the toast with a drizzle of olive oil.
Fry the eggs and the ham.
Put the eggs on the toast.
pack6-honey-yogurt-bowl: Spoon greek yogurt into two bowls.
Top with sliced banana and mixed berries.
Drizzle with honey and dust with cinnamon.
pack6-cilbir-eggs: Spread greek yogurt mixed with crushed garlic on two plates.
Poach the eggs in simmering water for 3 minutes.
Put the eggs on the yogurt.
Melt the butter with chilli flakes and pour it over.
Scatter parsley and serve with the bread.
pack6-indian-spiced-oats: Put the rolled oats and vegetable stock in a pot.
Add frozen peas, grated carrot, cumin and ginger.
Cook on low heat for 5 to 6 minutes. Stir often, until thick.
Serve with a squeeze of lemon.
pack6-breakfast-bread-pudding: Tear the bread into an oven dish with ham and chopped tomato.
Whisk the eggs and milk. Pour the mix over.
Bake for 22 minutes, until puffed and golden.
pack6-lemon-ricotta-crepes: Whisk the flour, eggs and milk into a thin batter.
Fry thin crepes in butter for 1 minute each side.
Add a squeeze of lemon and roll them up.
pack6-green-shakshuka: Wilt the spinach with garlic in an oven safe pan.
Make little wells and crack the eggs into them. Then scatter feta.
Bake for 10 minutes and serve with the bread.
pack6-greek-rice-pudding: Put the rice and milk in a pot.
Cook it over low heat for 20 minutes. Stir often, until the rice is soft and creamy.
Stir in the sugar and a little lemon zest.
Sprinkle cinnamon on top and serve it warm or cold.
pack6-johnny-cakes: Mix the flour, baking powder, beaten egg, and milk to make a batter. Stir in the corn.
Fry spoonfuls in butter for 3 minutes on each side, until golden.
pack6-mushroom-egg-tartine: Fry the mushroom and garlic in butter until golden.
Place the mushrooms and egg on the toast.
Sprinkle cheese on top and serve.
pack6-chai-oats: Put the rolled oats and milk in a pot with a little water.
Cook over low heat for 8 minutes. Stir often.
Stir in the cinnamon, sugar, and ginger.
Top with banana and serve warm.
pack6-breakfast-enchiladas: Fill the tortillas with egg, black beans, and half the cheese. Roll them up and place them in an oven dish.
Pour salsa over them and scatter the rest of the cheese on top.
Bake for 12 minutes. Serve with sour cream.
pack6-avgolemono: Pour the vegetable stock into a big pot and bring it to a simmer.
Add the chicken thigh and carrot. Cook for 15 minutes, then shred the chicken.
Add the pasta and cook for 8 minutes.
Whisk the egg with lemon juice. Stir in a ladle of hot stock, then stir the mixture back into the pot.
Top with spring onion and serve hot, once it is off the boil.
pack6-gemista: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Cut the tops off the tomato and capsicum. Scoop out the middles.
Mix the rice with chopped onion, parsley, olive oil, and the scooped tomato flesh.
Fill the vegetables, top with feta, and bake for 25 minutes.
pack6-briam: Put the onion, garlic, zucchini, tomato, capsicum, and potato in a big oven dish.
Pour the oregano and olive oil over them.
Top with feta and serve hot.
pack6-keftedes-pita: Mix the beef mince, breadcrumbs, beaten egg, and oregano. Shape the mixture into small balls.
Fry the keftedes for 10 minutes, turning them until browned and cooked through.
Chop the cucumber and tomato into a salad.
Serve the keftedes in pita with salad and greek yogurt.
pack6-spinach-ricotta-hand-pies: Cook the spinach until it wilts. Mix it with feta, ricotta, and beaten egg.
Mix the flour, olive oil, and warm water into a dough. Roll it out into circles.
Fill each circle, fold it, and pinch the edges.
Bake for 20 minutes until crisp and golden.
pack6-italian-wedding-soup: Mix the pork mince with beaten egg and roll it into tiny meatballs.
Pour the vegetable stock into a big pot and bring it to a simmer.
Add the meatballs, carrot, onion, and pasta. Cook for 10 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until it wilts.
pack6-panzanella: Chop the tomato, cucumber, olives, and red onion.
Put the bread and mozzarella in a big bowl.
Add the olive oil and basil. Toss well.
pack6-pasta-fagioli: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook the onion, garlic, carrot, and celery in the pot for 5 minutes.
Pour in the crushed tomato and vegetable stock. Add the kidney beans.
Add the pasta and simmer for 10 minutes, until the pasta is soft.
pack6-italian-rice-salad: Cook the rice as the pack says, then let it cool.
Chop the corn, frozen peas, capsicum, and olives.
Put the tuna in a big bowl.
Add the olive oil and lemon. Toss well.
pack6-chana-masala-rice: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook the onion, garlic, and ginger in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the chickpeas, spinach, and garam masala. Stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and simmer for 20 minutes.
pack6-aloo-gobi-wrap: Fry the potato and cauliflower with cumin and garam masala until soft and golden at the edges.
Fill them with the potato mix and spinach.
Add greek yogurt, roll them up, and serve.
pack6-sambar-lentils: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook the onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the lentils, carrot, potato, and cumin. Stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and coconut milk. Simmer for 25 minutes.
Serve with the rice and a squeeze of lime.
pack6-vegetable-pakora: Mix the sliced onion, capsicum, and zucchini with flour, beaten egg, cumin, and garam masala to make a thick batter.
Fry spoonfuls in olive oil for 3 minutes on each side until crisp.
pack6-raita-rice-bowl: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Mix the greek yogurt with grated cucumber, cumin, and a squeeze of lemon to make a raita.
Serve the rice topped with chickpeas, chopped tomato, and the raita.
pack6-masala-fries: Cut the potato into fries. Toss them with olive oil, garam masala, and chilli flakes.
Serve with greek yogurt and a squeeze of lemon.
pack6-greek-fries: Put the potato in a big oven dish.
Pour the oregano and olive oil over the potato.
Top with feta and lemon, then serve hot.
pack6-village-salad-bread: Chop the tomato, cucumber, olives, capsicum, and red onion.
Put the bread and feta in a big bowl.
Add the oregano and olive oil. Toss well.
pack6-greek-chicken-lemon-potatoes: Chop the garlic and potato into chunks.
Add the chicken breast and oregano to the tray with the olive oil.
Pour the vegetable stock over everything.
Bake for 27 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Top with lemon and serve hot.
pack6-zucchini-parmigiana: Fry the zucchini slices in olive oil until golden.
Layer the zucchini, crushed tomato, mozzarella, and breadcrumbs in an oven dish.
Bake for 20 minutes, then scatter basil.
pack6-frittata-sandwich: Cook a spinach, egg, and cheese frittata in a pan until set.
Toast the bread and spread it with mayonnaise.
Cut the frittata to fit and fill the sandwiches.
pack6-couscous-mozzarella-salad: Cook the couscous as the pack says, then let it cool.
Chop the cucumber, cherry tomato, and capsicum.
Put the mozzarella in a big bowl.
Add the olive oil, lemon, and basil. Toss well.
pack6-crispy-rice-cakes: Cook the rice as the pack says and let it cool a little.
Mix the rice with beaten egg, cheese, spring onion, and flour. Shape it into cakes.
Fry for 4 minutes on each side until crisp and golden.
pack6-greek-bean-plaki: Mix the kidney beans, crushed tomato, onion, garlic, oregano, and olive oil in an oven dish.
pack6-chicken-stifado: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook the onion, red onion, and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the chicken thigh and cinnamon. Stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and simmer for 35 minutes.
Stir in feta and cook for 2 more minutes.
pack6-beef-pastitsio: Cook the pasta as the pack says, then drain it.
Fry the beef mince and onion with cinnamon. Stir in crushed tomato and simmer for 8 minutes.
Whisk flour into the milk. Heat it with the butter until thick. Stir in beaten egg and half the cheese.
Layer pasta and beef in an oven dish. Pour the sauce over them, top with the rest of the cheese, and bake for 30 minutes.
pack6-greek-lamb-potato-tray: Cut the garlic, onion, and potato into chunks.
Put the lamb mince, oregano, and olive oil in the tray.
Bake it for 32 minutes, until it looks golden and is cooked through.
Add the feta and lemon on top, then serve it hot.
pack6-chicken-lemonato: Warm the olive oil in a large pot.
Fry the chicken thigh and garlic until golden.
Add the potato, oregano, and vegetable stock. Stir well.
Cover the pot and simmer for 25 minutes.
Add the green beans for the last 8 minutes, then finish with plenty of lemon.
pack6-greek-pork-tray: Cut the garlic, red onion, capsicum, and potato into chunks.
Put the pork mince, oregano, and olive oil in the tray.
Bake it for 27 minutes, until it looks golden and is cooked through.
Add the greek yogurt and lemon on top, then serve it hot.
pack6-vegetable-moussaka: Cook the lentils in water until they are soft, about 20 minutes. Drain them.
Fry the onion in olive oil. Stir in the lentils, crushed tomato, and cinnamon, then simmer for 8 minutes.
Whisk the flour into the milk. Heat it until thick, then stir in half the cheese.
Layer potato and zucchini slices with the lentil mix in an oven dish. Pour the sauce over them.
Add the rest of the cheese on top. Bake at 180 degrees for 30 minutes.
pack6-greek-meatball-pasta-bake: Cook the pasta as the pack says, then drain it.
Mix the beef mince, breadcrumbs, beaten egg, and oregano. Roll the mix into balls, then fry them until browned.
Mix the pasta, meatballs, tomato passata, and spinach together in an oven dish.
Add mozzarella on top and bake for 20 minutes.
pack6-chicken-saltimbocca: Put ham and mozzarella on each chicken breast. Hold them with a toothpick if you have one.
Fry them in butter for 6 minutes each side, until golden and cooked through.
Boil the potato and green beans.
Serve it with a wedge of lemon.
pack6-beef-pizzaiola: Cook the pasta as the pack says.
Warm the olive oil in a large pan.
Fry the onion and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add the beef strips and capsicum. Cook for 18 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in the oregano and crushed tomato. Cook for 2 more minutes.
Add mozzarella on top and serve over the pasta.
pack6-pork-piccata: Shape the pork mince into thin patties. Dip them in flour, then in beaten egg.
Fry them in butter for 4 minutes each side, until golden.
Cook the pasta as the pack says. Add the green beans for the last 3 minutes, then drain.
Add a squeeze of lemon and the parsley to the pan. Swirl the pan.
Serve the pork over the pasta and beans.
pack6-chicken-mushroom-sauce: Cook the pasta as the pack says.
Heat a large pan over medium heat.
Add the chicken breast and mushroom. Cook for 13 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in the cream. Cook for 2 more minutes.
Add butter and parsley on top, then serve over the pasta.
pack6-tuna-puttanesca: Cook the spaghetti in salty water as the pack says.
Warm the olive oil in a large pan.
Add the tuna and olives. Cook for 8 minutes.
Stir in the chilli flakes and crushed tomato. Warm them through.
Drain the spaghetti and toss everything together.
Add parsley on top and serve hot.
pack6-amatriciana: Cook the spaghetti in salty water as the pack says.
Warm the olive oil in a large pan.
Add the bacon. Cook for 8 minutes.
Stir in the chilli flakes and crushed tomato. Warm them through.
Drain the spaghetti and toss everything together.
Add parmesan on top and serve hot.
pack6-carbonara-peas: Cook the pasta in salty water as the pack says.
Heat a large pan over medium heat.
Add the bacon, egg, and frozen peas. Cook for 8 minutes.
Stir in the cream and warm it through.
Drain the pasta and toss everything together.
Add parmesan on top and serve hot.
pack6-pumpkin-rice: Melt the butter in a large pot. Fry the onion, garlic, and pumpkin for 5 minutes.
Add the rice and stir for 1 minute.
Pour in the vegetable stock one ladle at a time, stirring, until the rice is soft, about 20 minutes.
Stir in the spinach and parmesan.
Let it rest for 2 minutes, then serve.
pack6-italian-beef-stew: Warm the olive oil in a large pot.
Cook the onion and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the beef strips, carrot, frozen peas, and potato. Stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and vegetable stock. Simmer for 40 minutes.
Serve hot with parsley on top.
pack6-chicken-vindaloo: Heat a large pot over medium heat.
Cook the onion and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the chicken thigh, capsicum, potato, garam masala, chilli flakes, and cumin. Stir well.
Add water to cover everything and simmer for 30 minutes.
Serve with the rice and a squeeze of lemon.
pack6-lamb-bhuna: Warm the olive oil in a large pot.
Cook the onion, garlic, and ginger in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the lamb mince, tomato, capsicum, and garam masala. Stir well.
Add water to cover everything and simmer for 30 minutes.
Serve with the rice and a squeeze of lemon.
pack6-beef-jalfrezi: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Warm the olive oil in a large pan.
Fry the onion, garlic, and ginger for 3 minutes.
Add the beef strips, capsicum, and tomato. Cook for 18 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in the garam masala and chilli flakes. Cook for 2 more minutes.
pack6-chicken-karahi: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a large pan over medium heat.
Fry the ginger and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add the chicken thigh and tomato. Cook for 18 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in the chilli flakes and cumin. Cook for 2 more minutes.
Add butter and parsley on top, then serve over the rice.
pack6-chettinad-prawn-curry: Heat a large pot over medium heat.
Cook the onion, garlic, and ginger in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the prawns, tomato, garam masala, and chilli flakes. Stir well.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer for 15 minutes.
Serve with the rice and a squeeze of lemon.
pack6-goan-fish-curry: Heat a large pot over medium heat.
Cook the onion and ginger in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the white fish, tomato, garam masala, and cumin. Stir well.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer for 15 minutes.
Serve with the rice and a squeeze of lime.
pack6-saag-chicken: Warm the olive oil in a large pot.
Cook the onion, garlic, and ginger in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the chicken breast, spinach, and garam masala. Stir well.
Add water to cover everything and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the cream. Cook for 2 more minutes.
pack6-saag-halloumi: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Fry the halloumi until golden, then set it aside.
Fry the onion, garlic, and ginger. Add the spinach and garam masala, then cook until the spinach wilts.
Serve the spinach over rice, with halloumi on top.
pack6-aloo-matar: Warm the olive oil in a large pot.
Cook the onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the frozen peas, potato, cumin, and garam masala. Stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the greek yogurt. Cook for 2 more minutes.
pack6-vegetable-sabzi: Warm the olive oil in a large pot.
Cook the onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the cauliflower, carrot, frozen peas, potato, cumin, and garam masala. Stir well.
Add water to cover everything and simmer for 20 minutes.
pack6-khichdi: Melt the butter in a large pot. Fry the cumin and ginger for 1 minute.
Add the rice, lentils, carrot, and frozen peas with 900 ml water.
Cover the pot and simmer for 25 minutes, until soft like porridge.
Serve with a squeeze of lemon.
pack6-chicken-pulao: Warm the olive oil in a large pot.
Fry the chicken thigh and onion until golden.
Add the rice, potato, frozen peas, cumin, and garam masala with 600 ml water. Stir well.
Cover the pot and simmer for 18 minutes, until the rice is soft.
Serve with greek yogurt and a squeeze of lemon.
pack6-seekh-lamb: Mix the lamb mince with grated onion, garlic, ginger, garam masala, and chilli flakes. Shape the mix into long kebabs.
Fry the kebabs for 10 minutes, turning them until browned and cooked through.
Cook the rice as the pack says.
Serve the kebabs over rice with cucumber.
Add greek yogurt and a squeeze of lemon.
pack6-chicken-handi: Warm the olive oil in a large pot.
Cook the onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the chicken breast, capsicum, spinach, and garam masala. Stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the cream. Cook for 2 more minutes.
pack6-pork-balti: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Warm the olive oil in a large pan.
Fry the onion and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add the pork mince, capsicum, and tomato. Cook for 13 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in the garam masala. Cook for 2 more minutes.
Add greek yogurt on top and serve over the rice.
pack6-tofu-makhani: Heat a large pot over medium heat.
Cook the garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the tofu, frozen peas, and garam masala. Stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in the cream and butter. Cook for 2 more minutes.
pack6-dal-makhani: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook the garlic and ginger in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the lentils, kidney beans, and garam masala. Stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and let it simmer for 30 minutes.
Stir in the butter and cream. Cook for 2 more minutes.
pack6-chana-pulao: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Fry the onion with the cumin and garam masala for 3 minutes.
Add the rice, chickpeas, frozen peas, and 600 ml water. Stir well.
Cover the pot and let it simmer for 16 minutes, until the rice is soft.
Serve it with greek yogurt and a squeeze of lemon.
pack6-kerala-fish-curry: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook the ginger and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the white fish, capsicum, and curry paste. Stir well.
Pour in the coconut milk and let it simmer for 15 minutes.
Serve it with the rice and a squeeze of lime.
pack6-pork-meatball-spaghetti: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook the garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the pork mince, egg, breadcrumbs, and oregano. Stir well.
Pour in the tomato passata and let it simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the parmesan. Cook for 2 more minutes.
pack6-chicken-arrabbiata: Cook the pasta in salty water as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Add the chicken breast and cook it for 13 minutes.
Stir in the chilli flakes and crushed tomato. Heat them through.
Drain the pasta and mix everything together.
Add the parmesan and basil on top. Serve hot.
pack6-tuna-pea-rice: Melt the butter in a big pot and fry the onion for 4 minutes.
Add the rice and vegetable stock. Stir well.
Cover the pot and let it simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in the tuna, frozen peas, and parmesan.
Serve it with a squeeze of lemon.
pack6-lamb-ragu-pasta: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook the onion and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the lamb mince, carrot, and spinach. Stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and let it simmer for 30 minutes.
Stir in the parmesan. Cook for 2 more minutes.
pack6-greek-chicken-pasta-pot: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Fry the chicken thigh, onion, and garlic until golden.
Pour in the crushed tomato and 500 ml water. Add the oregano.
Add the pasta and let it simmer for 12 minutes, until the pasta is soft.
Scatter the feta on top and serve.
pack6-italian-herb-chicken-tray: Chop the garlic, cherry tomato, zucchini, and potato into chunks.
Put the chicken thigh and oregano on the tray with the olive oil.
Bake for 32 minutes, until golden and cooked through.
Add the feta and lemon on top. Serve hot.
pack7-chicken-congee: Pour the vegetable stock into a pot with the rice, ginger, and garlic. Bring it to a simmer.
Cook for 25 minutes. Stir now and then, until the rice breaks down and turns creamy.
Shred the chicken breast into the pot during the last 8 minutes.
Stir in the spinach and soy sauce.
Add the spring onion on top and serve hot.
pack7-tamago-egg-sandwich: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes. Peel and mash them.
Mix the egg with the mayonnaise, milk, and sugar.
Pile the egg mix onto the bread.
Put the other bread slices on top. Press lightly and cut.
pack7-kaya-toast: Heat the coconut milk and sugar in a small pot. Whisk in 2 beaten eggs, then cook gently until thick like jam.
Toast the bread. Spread it with the butter and coconut jam.
Soft boil the other eggs for 6 minutes.
Serve the toast with the soft eggs for dipping.
pack7-roti-flatbread-eggs: Mix the flour with warm water to make a dough. Roll it into flatbreads. Fry them in a dry pan until puffed and spotted.
Scramble the eggs with the curry paste and spinach.
Brush the butter onto the flatbreads.
Serve the eggs on the flatbreads with greek yogurt.
pack7-nasi-lemak-plate: Cook the rice in coconut milk and water until soft.
Fry the chicken thigh until golden and cooked through.
Serve the rice with the chicken, egg, and cucumber slices.
Scatter the chilli flakes on top and add a wedge of lime.
pack7-okayu-porridge: Pour the vegetable stock into a pot with the rice and ginger. Bring it to a simmer.
Cook for 22 minutes. Stir now and then, until soft and porridge like.
Beat the eggs and stir them in after you turn off the heat.
Add the spring onion on top and serve hot.
pack7-pikelets: Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Add the egg and flour. Cook for 6 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in the baking powder, sugar, honey, and milk. Cook for 2 more minutes.
Add the butter and banana on top. Serve hot.
pack7-rissoles-eggs: Mix the beef mince with the breadcrumbs, 1 beaten egg, and grated onion. Shape the mix into rissoles.
Fry the rissoles for 5 minutes each side, until cooked through.
Fry the tomato and the other eggs in the butter.
Serve the rissoles and eggs on the toast with the tomato.
pack7-salmon-potato-cakes: Boil the potato until soft and mash it roughly.
Mix the potato with the flaked salmon, beaten egg, flour, and spring onion. Shape the mix into cakes.
Fry for 4 minutes each side, until crisp and golden.
Serve with greek yogurt and a squeeze of lemon.
pack7-soy-greens-eggs: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Add the egg and spinach. Cook for 6 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in the soy sauce and chilli flakes. Cook for 2 more minutes.
pack7-soy-marinated-eggs: Boil the eggs for 7 minutes. Cool and peel them.
Warm the soy sauce, sugar, ginger, and a splash of water. Pour it over the eggs.
Leave the eggs in the mix for at least 10 minutes. Turn them once.
Cook the rice as the pack says.
Serve the eggs cut in half over the rice with the spring onion.
pack7-berry-milk-toast: Toast the bread until golden and spread it lightly with the butter.
Spread a thick layer of greek yogurt on each slice.
Add the mixed berries on top.
Drizzle with the honey and serve.
pack7-thai-omelette-rice: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add the egg and cook for 5 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in the soy sauce and chilli flakes. Cook for 2 more minutes.
Add the lime on top and serve over the rice.
pack7-breakfast-banh-mi: Fry the eggs and warm the ham.
Spread the mayonnaise mixed with the chilli flakes on the bread.
Fill the bread with the egg, ham, grated carrot, and cucumber.
pack7-japanese-breakfast-plate: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Grill or fry the salmon until it is just cooked.
Roll a thin omelette from the eggs and slice it.
Serve the rice with the salmon, egg slices, and spinach, with the soy sauce and spring onion.
pack7-smashed-pea-toast: Cook the frozen peas for 3 minutes. Roughly mash them with a squeeze of lemon.
Pile the peas on the toast and add an egg on top.
Scatter the feta and chilli flakes on top and serve.
pack7-potato-scones: Boil the potato until soft and mash it smooth.
Mix the potato with the flour, melted butter, cheese, and spring onion to make a dough.
Roll out the dough and cut it into rounds.
Fry for 3 minutes each side, until golden.
Fry the eggs and serve them on top.
pack7-breakfast-mie-goreng: Cook the noodles as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the spring onion and ginger for 3 minutes.
Add the egg, ham, and capsicum. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in the soy sauce. Cook for 2 more minutes.
pack7-sweet-potato-breakfast-pan: Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Add the egg, ham, capsicum, and sweet potato. Cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Add the feta on top and serve hot.
pack7-prawn-toast: Chop the prawns finely. Mix them with the beaten egg, spring onion, ginger, and soy sauce.
Spread the mix thickly on the bread.
Fry it prawn side down in olive oil for 3 minutes, until crisp and pink.
Turn it over and fry for 1 more minute.
Cut it into triangles and serve.
pack7-bacon-egg-roll: Fry the eggs as you like them.
Fill them with the bacon, egg, cheese, and lettuce.
pack7-dim-sim-dumplings: Mix flour with warm water to make dough. Let it rest 15 minutes, then roll it into circles.
Mix pork mince with finely chopped cabbage, ginger and spring onion.
Fill each circle. Fold it and pinch the edges together.
Put the dumplings in a steamer or in a pan with a little water and a lid. Steam for 10 minutes.
pack7-san-choy-bow: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Fry pork mince with ginger until brown and crisp at the edges.
Mix in grated carrot, spring onion, soy sauce and chilli flakes.
Spoon the pork and rice into lettuce leaves.
Roll them up and eat with your hands.
pack7-gado-gado: Boil the potato, green beans and cabbage until they are just soft.
Boil the eggs for 9 minutes. Peel and cut them in half.
Mix peanut butter and soy sauce with a squeeze of lime and a little warm water to make a sauce.
Put the potato, beans, cabbage, carrot, tofu and egg on plates.
Pour the peanut sauce over the food and serve.
pack7-soto-ayam-soup: Pour the vegetable stock into a large pot and bring it to a simmer.
Add chicken breast, ginger, garlic and curry paste. Cook for 12 minutes, then shred the chicken.
Add the noodles and cabbage. Cook for 4 more minutes.
Boil the eggs for 9 minutes. Peel and cut them in half.
Serve the soup with egg, spring onion and a squeeze of lime.
pack7-bakso-meatball-soup: Mix beef mince with half the garlic and ginger. Roll it into small meatballs.
Pour the vegetable stock into a large pot and bring it to a simmer.
Add the meatballs and the rest of the garlic and ginger. Cook for 8 minutes.
Add the noodles and spinach. Cook for 4 more minutes.
Serve with boiled egg halves, spring onion and soy sauce.
pack7-tom-kha-soup: Heat a large pot over medium heat.
Cook the ginger, garlic and spring onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add chicken breast and mushroom. Stir well.
Pour in the coconut milk and vegetable stock. Let the soup simmer for 20 minutes.
Serve with rice and a squeeze of lime.
pack7-larb-pork-salad: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Fry the pork mince until brown and just cooked.
Take the pan off the heat. Mix in red onion, spring onion, chilli flakes and plenty of lime juice.
Put lettuce and cucumber in bowls.
Add the pork on top and serve with the rice.
pack7-pad-see-ew: Cook the noodles as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a large pan.
Add beef strips, egg and spinach. Cook for 8 minutes and stir now and then.
Mix in soy sauce and sugar. Cook for 2 more minutes.
pack7-krapow-basil-chicken: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a large pan over medium heat.
Add chicken breast and egg. Cook for 8 minutes and stir now and then.
Mix in chilli flakes, soy sauce and sugar. Cook for 2 more minutes.
Put basil on top and serve over the rice.
pack7-hainanese-chicken-rice: Gently poach the chicken thigh in water with ginger and garlic for 20 minutes.
Cook the rice in some of the chicken water.
Slice the chicken and place it over the rice.
Add spring onion and cucumber on top.
Mix soy sauce and chilli flakes for dipping. Serve with the chicken and rice.
pack7-char-siu-pork: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a large pan over medium heat.
Fry the garlic, ginger and spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add pork mince and cucumber. Cook for 13 minutes and stir now and then.
Mix in honey and soy sauce. Cook for 2 more minutes.
pack7-okonomiyaki: Mix shredded cabbage with flour, beaten eggs and spring onion to make a thick batter.
Put large spoonfuls in a pan and fry for 4 minutes on each side until golden, with bacon on top.
Flip it once more so the bacon gets crisp.
Drizzle mayonnaise and soy sauce over it.
pack7-gyoza-dumplings: Mix flour with warm water to make dough. Let it rest 15 minutes, then roll it into small circles.
Mix pork mince with ginger, garlic and spring onion.
Fill each circle. Fold it and pinch the edges together.
Fry in olive oil for 3 minutes. Add a splash of water, cover the pan and steam for 5 minutes.
pack7-karaage-chicken: Heat a large pan over medium heat.
Add chicken thigh, egg, cabbage and flour. Cook for 13 minutes and stir now and then.
Mix in soy sauce and mayonnaise. Cook for 2 more minutes.
Put lemon on top and serve hot.
pack7-yakitori-skewers: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Thread chicken thigh pieces, capsicum and spring onion pieces onto skewers.
Mix soy sauce and honey to make a glaze.
Fry or grill the skewers for 10 minutes. Brush them with glaze until they look shiny and are cooked through.
pack7-oyako-chicken-bowl: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Simmer chicken thigh and onion in soy sauce, sugar and a little water for 8 minutes.
Pour beaten egg over the chicken. Cook gently until the egg is just set.
pack7-rissoles-gravy-mash: Mix beef mince with breadcrumbs, beaten egg and grated onion. Shape the mix into rissoles.
Fry the rissoles for 6 minutes on each side until cooked through.
Boil the potato until soft. Mash it with milk and butter.
Whisk flour into the vegetable stock. Heat it until thick to make gravy.
Serve the rissoles with mash, boiled frozen peas and the gravy.
pack7-sausage-sizzle-sandwich: Shape the pork mince into two long sausage patties. Fry them until cooked through.
Fry the onion in butter until soft and sweet.
Fill the bread with patties, onion and cheese.
pack7-seafood-basket: Dip white fish pieces and prawns in flour, then beaten egg, then breadcrumbs.
Fry for 4 minutes until crisp and golden.
Fry the potato into chunky chips.
Serve the seafood with chips, lettuce and mayonnaise.
pack7-salt-pepper-prawns: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a large pan over medium heat.
Fry the spring onion and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add prawns, capsicum and flour. Cook for 8 minutes and stir now and then.
Mix in chilli flakes. Cook for 2 more minutes.
Put lemon on top and serve over the rice.
pack7-garlic-prawns: Heat a large pan over medium heat.
Add prawns, cherry tomato and bread. Cook for 6 minutes and stir now and then.
Add butter, lemon and parsley on top. Serve hot.
pack7-fishermans-pie: Boil the potato until soft. Mash it with half the milk and half the butter.
Whisk flour into the rest of the milk. Heat it with the rest of the butter until thick.
Flake white fish and prawns into the sauce with frozen peas and corn.
Put the mixture in an oven dish and cover it with mash. Make the top rough, then brush beaten egg over it.
Bake at 180 degrees for 20 minutes until golden.
pack7-tuna-sweet-potato-bake: Slice the sweet potato thinly. Layer it in an oven dish with tuna and corn.
Add cheese and breadcrumbs on top.
Bake for 22 minutes until golden and soft.
pack7-impossible-pie: Whisk flour, eggs and milk together to make a batter.
Mix in cheese, chopped bacon, spinach and onion.
Pour the batter into a greased pie dish. It will make its own base as it bakes.
Bake for 30 minutes until set and golden.
pack7-jam-tarts: Cook mixed berries with sugar and a squeeze of lemon for 6 minutes to make quick jam.
Rub butter into the flour. Add cold water and roll the pastry out in a muffin tray.
Bake at 180 degrees for 15 minutes until the pastry is golden.
Let them cool a little and serve.
pack7-beef-rendang: Heat the olive oil in a large pot.
Cook onion, garlic and ginger in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add beef strips, potato and curry paste. Stir well.
Pour in the coconut milk and let it simmer for 40 minutes.
Serve with rice and a squeeze of lime.
pack7-nasi-goreng: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a large pan over medium heat.
Fry the garlic and spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add chicken breast, egg, capsicum, carrot and cucumber. Cook for 13 minutes and stir now and then.
Mix in soy sauce and chilli flakes. Cook for 2 more minutes.
pack7-mee-goreng: Cook the noodles as the pack says.
Heat a large pan over medium heat.
Fry the spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add prawns, egg, cabbage and capsicum. Cook for 13 minutes and stir now and then.
Mix in soy sauce, honey and chilli flakes. Cook for 2 more minutes.
Put lime on top and serve over the noodles.
pack7-beef-coconut-soup: Heat a large pot over medium heat.
Cook ginger, garlic and spring onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add beef strips, tomato and potato. Stir well.
Pour in the coconut milk and let it simmer for 30 minutes.
Serve with rice and a squeeze of lime.
pack7-ayam-goreng-chicken: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a large pan.
Fry the garlic and ginger for 3 minutes.
Add chicken thigh, egg, cucumber and flour. Cook for 18 minutes and stir now and then.
Mix in cumin and chilli flakes. Cook for 2 more minutes.
pack7-thai-green-fish-curry: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Add the white fish, green beans, capsicum and curry paste. Stir well.
Pour in the coconut milk. Let it simmer for 15 minutes.
Serve it with the rice. Top it with basil and squeeze lime over it.
pack7-beef-massaman: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook the onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the beef strips, potato, curry paste, peanut butter and cinnamon. Stir well.
Pour in the coconut milk. Let it simmer for 40 minutes.
Serve it with the rice and squeeze lime over it.
pack7-tom-yum-fried-rice: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add the prawns, egg, mushroom and tomato. Cook for 8 minutes and stir now and then.
Stir in the chilli flakes and soy sauce. Cook for 2 more minutes.
Top it with lime and serve it over the rice.
pack7-chilli-cabbage-fried-rice: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the spring onion and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add the bacon, egg and cabbage. Cook for 8 minutes and stir now and then.
Stir in the chilli flakes and soy sauce. Cook for 2 more minutes.
pack7-japchae-noodles: Cook the noodles as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the garlic and spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add the beef strips, spinach, carrot and capsicum. Cook for 13 minutes and stir now and then.
Stir in the soy sauce and sugar. Cook for 2 more minutes.
pack7-bulgogi-beef: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the garlic, ginger and spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add the beef strips, lettuce and capsicum. Cook for 13 minutes and stir now and then.
Stir in the soy sauce and honey. Cook for 2 more minutes.
pack7-spicy-pork-tofu-stew: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook the onion, garlic and spring onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the pork mince, tofu, zucchini, mushroom and chilli flakes. Stir well.
Pour in the vegetable stock. Let it simmer for 20 minutes.
pack7-mapo-tofu: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the garlic, ginger and spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add the tofu and pork mince. Cook for 13 minutes and stir now and then.
Stir in the chilli flakes and soy sauce. Cook for 2 more minutes.
pack7-dan-dan-noodles: Cook the noodles as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the spring onion and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add the pork mince and spinach. Cook for 8 minutes and stir now and then.
Stir in the peanut butter, soy sauce and chilli flakes. Cook for 2 more minutes.
Top it with lime and serve it over the noodles.
pack7-sukiyaki-beef-pot: Pour the vegetable stock into a wide pot. Bring it to a simmer.
Add the soy sauce and sugar.
Place the beef strips, tofu, mushroom, cabbage and spring onion in sections.
Cook for 8 minutes. Add the noodles and cook for 4 more minutes.
Serve with the beaten egg for dipping.
pack7-teriyaki-chicken: Cook the noodles as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the ginger, garlic and spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add the chicken thigh and capsicum. Cook for 13 minutes and stir now and then.
Stir in the soy sauce and honey. Cook for 2 more minutes.
pack7-katsu-curry: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Dip the chicken breast in flour, then in beaten egg, then in breadcrumbs.
Fry for 5 minutes each side, until crisp and golden.
Simmer the onion with curry paste and coconut milk for 8 minutes to make a sauce.
Serve the chicken over rice with the sauce and shredded cabbage.
pack7-beef-donburi-bowl: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Simmer the beef strips and onion in soy sauce, sugar, ginger and a little water for 8 minutes.
Pour the beaten eggs over the beef. Cook gently until just set.
pack7-tempura-prawns: Whisk flour, beaten egg and cold water to make a thin batter.
Dip the prawns in batter. Fry for 3 minutes, until crisp and pale gold.
Fry the potato to make chunky chips.
Serve the prawns with chips, lettuce and mayonnaise.
pack7-reef-and-beef: Fry the beef strips until browned. Set them aside.
Melt the butter and fry the garlic and prawns until pink. Then stir in the cream for 2 minutes.
Boil the potato and green beans.
Serve the beef over potato, with the prawns and sauce on top.
pack7-pub-chicken-gravy: Dip the chicken breast in flour, then in beaten egg, then in breadcrumbs.
Fry for 5 minutes each side, until crisp and golden.
Whisk a spoon of the flour into the milk. Heat it with butter until thick to make a gravy.
Boil the potato, frozen peas and corn.
Serve the chicken with potato and veg. Pour the gravy over it.
pack7-lamb-loaf-dinner: Mix the lamb mince, breadcrumbs, beaten egg, onion, garlic and oregano. Shape the mix into a loaf.
Put the loaf in an oven dish with potato and pumpkin pieces and dots of butter.
Bake for 40 minutes. Add the green beans for the last 12 minutes.
Let it rest for 5 minutes. Slice and serve.
pack7-silverside-beef: Put the beef strips, potato, carrot, cabbage and onion in a big pot. Cover with water and simmer for 40 minutes.
Take out the beef and vegetables. Keep them warm.
Whisk the flour into the milk. Heat it with butter and some pot water until thick. Stir in parsley to make a sauce.
Serve it with the vegetables and parsley sauce.
pack7-tuna-mornay-rice: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Whisk the flour into the milk. Heat until thick, then stir in half the cheese.
Mix the rice, tuna, corn, frozen peas and sauce in an oven dish.
Top with breadcrumbs and the rest of the cheese. Bake for 18 minutes.
pack7-seafood-chowder: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook the onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the white fish, prawns, salmon, corn and potato. Stir well.
Pour in the milk. Let it simmer for 25 minutes.
Stir in the cream. Cook for 2 more minutes.
Serve it with the bread and top it with parsley.
pack7-chilli-prawn-pasta: Cook the pasta in salty water as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Add the prawns and spinach. Cook for 8 minutes.
Stir in the chilli flakes and warm everything through.
Drain the pasta and toss everything together.
Top it with butter, lemon and parsley. Serve hot.
pack7-roast-chicken-gravy: Put the chicken thigh, potato, carrot, pumpkin and onion on a tray with dots of butter.
Bake for 40 minutes. Add the green beans for the last 12 minutes.
Pour the tray juices into a pot. Whisk in the flour and vegetable stock. Heat until thick to make a gravy.
Serve the chicken and veg with the gravy and parsley.
pack7-pork-roast-tray: Shape the pork mince into a firm loaf. Put it on a tray with potato, sweet potato, onion, carrot and dots of butter.
Bake for 40 minutes. Add the green beans for the last 12 minutes.
Pour the tray juices into a pot. Whisk in the flour and vegetable stock. Heat until thick to make a gravy.
Slice the pork. Serve it with veg and gravy.
pack7-lamb-patties-peas: Mix the lamb mince with breadcrumbs, beaten egg, garlic and oregano. Shape it into patties.
Fry the patties for 5 minutes each side, until cooked through.
Boil the potato and frozen peas.
Serve the patties with potato and peas.
Scatter parsley and add a squeeze of lemon.
pack7-beef-kidney-bean-pie: Fry the beef strips and onion until browned. Stir in the kidney beans, carrot and vegetable stock. Simmer for 10 minutes.
Rub the butter into the flour. Add cold water and roll out the pastry.
Fill a pie dish with the beef mix and cover it with pastry.
Bake at 180 degrees for 30 minutes, until golden.
pack7-creamy-chicken-pie: Fry the chicken thigh, celery and carrot until golden. Stir in the cream and frozen peas. Simmer for 6 minutes.
Rub the butter into the flour. Add cold water and roll out the pastry.
Fill a pie dish with the chicken mix and cover it with pastry.
Bake at 180 degrees for 28 minutes, until golden.
pack7-salmon-lemon-cream: Cook the pasta in salty water as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Add the salmon and spinach. Cook for 8 minutes.
Stir in the cream and warm everything through.
Drain the pasta and toss everything together.
Top it with parmesan and lemon. Serve hot.
pack7-caramel-pork: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the garlic, ginger and spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add the pork mince and cucumber. Cook for 13 minutes and stir now and then.
Stir in the sugar, soy sauce and chilli flakes. Cook for 2 more minutes.
pack7-thai-basil-beef: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the garlic and onion for 3 minutes.
Add the beef strips and egg. Cook for 8 minutes and stir now and then.
Stir in the chilli flakes, soy sauce and sugar. Cook for 2 more minutes.
Top it with basil and serve it over the rice.
pack7-korean-chilli-chicken: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the garlic, ginger and spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add the chicken thigh and spinach. Cook for 13 minutes and stir now and then.
Stir in the chilli flakes, honey and soy sauce. Cook for 2 more minutes.
pack7-japanese-beef-curry: Warm a big pot over medium heat.
Cook the onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the beef strips, carrot, frozen peas, potato, curry paste and soy sauce. Stir well.
Pour in the coconut milk. Let it simmer for 30 minutes.
pack7-mongolian-beef: Cook the noodles as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the garlic, onion and spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add the beef strips and cook for 8 minutes. Stir now and then.
Stir in the soy sauce, sugar and chilli flakes. Cook for 2 more minutes.
Serve the beef over the noodles.
pack7-szechuan-chicken: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry the onion, garlic and spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add the chicken breast and capsicum. Cook for 8 minutes and stir now and then.
Stir in the chilli flakes, soy sauce and honey. Cook for 2 more minutes.
Serve the chicken over the rice.
pack7-braised-pork-rice: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Fry the pork mince with the garlic and ginger until browned.
Add the soy sauce, sugar and a little water. Simmer for 12 minutes.
Boil the eggs for 9 minutes. Peel and halve them. Wilt the spinach.
Serve the pork over the rice with egg, spinach and spring onion.
pack7-ayam-kecap-chicken: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the garlic and onion for 3 minutes.
Add the chicken thigh, tomato and cucumber. Cook for 18 minutes and stir now and then.
Stir in the soy sauce, honey and chilli flakes. Cook for 2 more minutes.
Serve the chicken over the rice.
pack7-balinese-fish: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook the garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the white fish, capsicum, spinach and curry paste. Stir well.
Pour in the coconut milk. Let it simmer for 15 minutes.
Serve it with the rice and squeeze lime over it.
pack7-malaysian-chicken-curry: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Add the chicken thigh, capsicum, frozen peas, curry paste and peanut butter. Stir well.
Pour in the coconut milk. Let it simmer for 25 minutes.
Serve it with the rice and squeeze lime over it.
pack7-aussie-bbq-plate: Shape the beef mince into rissoles. Put them on a tray with chicken thigh pieces, capsicum and onion.
Bake for 25 minutes. Add the bacon for the last 10 minutes.
Serve everything with bread and salsa.
pack8-breakfast-poutine: Heat the oven to 200 degrees and bake the potato wedges until crisp.
Whisk the flour into the vegetable stock. Heat it with butter until thick to make gravy.
Fry the eggs the way you like them.
Put the wedges in bowls. Add cheese and hot gravy on top so the cheese melts.
Add the eggs and parsley on top. Serve.
pack8-huevos-divorciados: Warm the crushed tomato with chopped onion in a pan to make a red sauce.
Fry the eggs the way you like them.
Crisp the tortillas in a dry pan.
Put an egg on each tortilla. Add salsa to one side and red sauce to the other.
Top with cheese and avocado. Serve.
pack8-migas-eggs: Cut the tortillas into strips. Fry them until crisp.
Add the onion and tomato. Cook for 3 minutes.
Whisk the eggs and pour them over. Stir until just set.
pack8-molletes: Roughly mash the kidney beans. Warm them through.
Spread a thick layer of beans on the toast.
Top with cheese. Grill or cover it until the cheese melts.
Add chopped tomato, onion and chilli flakes. Serve.
pack8-southwest-skillet: Fry the potato, capsicum and onion in an oven safe pan until golden.
Stir in the corn and black beans.
Make wells in the mix. Crack the eggs into them and scatter cheese over the top.
Bake for 10 minutes. Serve with salsa.
pack8-egg-in-the-hole: Cut a hole in the middle of each bread slice.
Fry the bacon until crisp. Set it aside.
Melt the butter in the pan and put the bread in.
Crack an egg into each hole. Cook for 3 minutes until set.
Top with cheese, bacon and tomato. Serve.
pack8-cheesy-grits-bowl: Cook the couscous as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add the egg and bacon. Cook for 5 minutes and stir now and then.
Top with cheese and butter. Serve over the couscous.
