pack8-pancake-tacos: Whisk the flour, beaten egg, milk and baking powder into a batter.
Fry small pancakes for 2 minutes on each side until golden.
Fold each pancake into a taco shape.
Fill them with greek yogurt and mixed berries.
pack8-berry-bread-pudding: Tear the bread into an oven dish with the mixed berries.
Whisk the eggs, milk, cinnamon and honey. Pour the mix over the bread.
Add small bits of butter and spoonfuls of ricotta.
Bake for 22 minutes until puffed and golden.
pack8-savoury-french-toast: Whisk the eggs in a wide dish.
Dip the bread in the egg. Top two slices with ham and cheese to make sandwiches.
Fry in butter for 3 minutes on each side until golden and melty.
Top with tomato and spring onion. Serve.
pack8-oat-waffle-cakes: Whisk the rolled oats, flour, beaten egg, milk and baking powder into a batter.
Let the batter rest for 5 minutes.
Fry thick cakes in butter for 3 minutes on each side until crisp and golden.
Serve with mixed berries and maple syrup.
pack8-beetroot-berry-smoothie: Put the mixed berries, banana and greek yogurt in a blender.
pack8-chia-oat-breakfast-pot: Mix the chia seeds, rolled oats, coconut milk, honey and cinnamon in a jar or bowl.
Leave it in the fridge for at least 2 hours, or overnight.
pack8-egg-bread-bowls: Cut the tops off the bread rolls. Scoop out some middle to make bowls.
Fill with spinach, chopped tomato and cheese. Crack an egg into each bowl.
Bake for 14 minutes until the egg is just set.
pack8-idli-steamed-cakes: Cook the rice until very soft. Mash it roughly.
Mix the rice with flour, baking powder, greek yogurt and cumin to make a thick batter.
Spoon the batter into greased muffin cups. Steam them over a pan of water for 12 minutes.
Warm the coconut milk with chilli flakes to make a quick chutney.
Serve the cakes with the chutney.
pack8-masala-french-toast: Whisk the eggs with finely chopped onion, chilli flakes and cumin.
Dip the bread slices in the mix.
Fry in butter for 2 minutes on each side until golden.
pack8-crispy-rice-crepes: Cook the rice until soft. Blend or mash it smooth with a little water.
Mix the rice with flour, beaten egg, cumin, onion and chilli flakes to make a thin batter.
Fry thin crepes for 2 minutes on each side until crisp at the edges.
pack8-churro-oats: Put the rolled oats and milk in a pot with a little water.
Cook on low for 8 minutes and stir often.
Stir in the cinnamon and sugar.
Top with mixed berries and cream. Serve warm.
pack8-chicken-cemita: Fry the chicken breast until cooked through. Slice it.
Fill with chicken, avocado, cheese, onion and tomato.
pack8-pambazo-sandwich: Boil the potato until soft. Dice it.
Fry the pork mince and potato until golden. Stir in half the salsa.
Fill with the pork mix, lettuce and cheese.
Top with sour cream and the rest of the salsa.
pack8-tlacoyo-cakes: Mix the flour, corn and warm water into a dough. Shape thick oval cakes.
Fry the cakes for 4 minutes on each side until cooked through.
Mash the black beans. Warm them through.
Top the cakes with beans, cheese, lettuce and salsa.
pack8-sope-flatbreads: Mix the flour, corn and warm water into a dough. Shape thick flatbreads and fry for 4 minutes on each side.
Fry the chicken breast until cooked. Shred it.
Mash the kidney beans. Spread them on the flatbreads.
Top with chicken, lettuce and cheese.
Add salsa and sour cream. Serve.
pack8-esquites-corn-cups: Boil the potato until soft, then cut it into cubes. Boil the corn for 3 minutes.
Boil the eggs for 9 minutes. Peel and chop them.
Mix the corn and potato with the mayonnaise and chilli flakes.
Spoon the mix into cups. Add the egg and feta on top.
Add a squeeze of lime and serve.
pack8-aztec-soup: Heat a large pot over medium heat.
Cook the onion and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the black beans, corn and cumin. Stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and vegetable stock. Let the soup simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the cheese and cook for 2 more minutes.
Serve with the tortilla and add avocado on top.
pack8-calabacitas: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a large pan.
Add the zucchini, corn and tomato. Cook for 8 minutes and stir now and then.
Add cheese on top and serve over the rice.
pack8-rajas-crema: Fry the capsicum strips and onion until they are soft and sweet.
Add the corn and cream. Let them simmer for 4 minutes.
Stir in the cheese until it melts.
Serve the rajas with the tortillas.
pack8-papas-chorizo: Heat a large pan over medium heat.
Add the pork mince, egg, potato and tortilla. Cook for 13 minutes and stir now and then.
Stir in the smoked paprika and chilli flakes. Cook for 2 more minutes.
pack8-frijoles-bean-bowl: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Fry the onion and garlic with the cumin. Add the kidney beans and a splash of water. Mash them roughly as they warm.
Serve the beans over the rice with cheese.
Add salsa and eat with pieces of tortilla.
pack8-gorditas: Mix the flour, corn and warm water into a dough. Shape it into thick, round cakes.
Fry the cakes for 4 minutes on each side until they puff up and cook through.
Fry the beef mince until it is brown.
Cut partway through the cakes. Fill them with beef, lettuce and cheese.
Add salsa and sour cream on top.
pack8-tomato-soup-grilled-cheese: Cook the onion and garlic in the butter in a pot for 4 minutes.
Add the crushed tomato and vegetable stock. Let them simmer for 12 minutes.
Stir in the cream and basil.
Make a grilled cheese sandwich with the bread and cheese in a hot pan.
Serve the soup with the sandwich for dipping.
pack8-chicken-philly-sandwich: Fry the chicken breast strips, capsicum and onion in butter until they turn golden.
Toast the bread rolls and spread mayonnaise on them.
Fill the rolls with the chicken mix.
Add cheese on top and let it melt for 1 minute.
pack8-reuben-sandwich: Fry the beef strips until they turn brown.
Mix the cabbage with the mayonnaise and salsa to make a slaw.
Spread butter on the bread and toast it in a pan.
Fill the bread with beef, slaw and cheese.
Grill until the cheese melts, then serve.
pack8-monte-cristo: Make ham and cheese sandwiches with the bread.
Whisk the egg and milk in a wide dish. Dip the sandwiches in it.
Fry the sandwiches in butter for 3 minutes on each side until golden and melty.
pack8-curried-chicken-salad: Cook the chicken breast until done. Let it cool a little.
Put the bread and greek yogurt in a large bowl.
Add the mayonnaise, curry paste and lemon. Toss well.
pack8-corn-dog-bites: Shape the pork mince into small sausages. Fry them until cooked through.
Mix the flour, corn, beaten egg and milk into a thick batter.
Dip each sausage in the batter.
Fry for 3 minutes, turning them, until they are golden all over.
Serve with honey and salsa for dipping.
pack8-bbq-chicken-slaw-bowl: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Rub the smoked paprika over the chicken thigh. Fry it until cooked through, then slice it.
Mix the cabbage and carrot with the mayonnaise to make a slaw. Boil the corn.
Serve the rice with chicken, slaw and corn on top.
pack8-buffalo-cauliflower: Dip the cauliflower pieces in flour, then in beaten egg. Bake for 18 minutes until crisp.
Melt the butter with the chilli flakes and garlic. Toss the cauliflower in it.
Serve with greek yogurt and celery sticks.
pack8-loaded-fries: Heat the oven to 200 degrees. Bake the potato fries until crisp.
Fry the beef mince and bacon until they turn brown.
Put the fries on a tray. Add the beef, bacon and cheese on top.
Bake for 5 minutes until the cheese melts.
Add sour cream, salsa and spring onion on top.
pack8-mac-cheese-bites: Cook the pasta as the pack says, then drain it.
Whisk a spoon of the flour into the milk. Heat it until thick, then stir in the cheese and pasta.
Chill the mix until firm, then shape it into balls.
Dip the balls in the rest of the flour, then in beaten egg, then in breadcrumbs.
Fry for 3 minutes until crisp and golden.
pack8-greek-chicken-skewers-pita: Marinate the chicken breast pieces in lemon, oregano, garlic and olive oil for 10 minutes.
Put the chicken on skewers. Fry or grill for 10 minutes until cooked through.
Chop the cucumber and tomato to make a salad.
Serve the skewers with pita, salad and greek yogurt.
pack8-eggs-spiced-tomato: Fry the onion and capsicum in olive oil. Add the crushed tomato and cumin. Let them simmer for 6 minutes.
Pour the mix into an oven dish and make wells in it.
Crack the eggs into the wells and scatter feta over them.
Bake for 10 minutes. Serve with warm pita bread.
pack8-italian-sub: Toast the bread until it turns golden.
Fill the bread with salami, ham, lettuce, tomato and mozzarella.
Add mayonnaise and pesto, then fold or roll the bread up.
pack8-tomato-ricotta-crostini: Toast the bread and rub it with the cut garlic.
Spread a thick layer of ricotta on each slice.
Add the cherry tomato halves on top.
Pour olive oil over them and scatter basil on top.
pack8-chicken-tortilla-casserole: Fry the chicken thigh and onion until golden, then shred the chicken.
Layer the tortillas, chicken, black beans, corn and salsa in an oven dish.
Bake for 20 minutes and serve with sour cream.
pack8-tamale-beef-bake: Fry the beef mince with taco seasoning until brown. Stir in the black beans and corn.
Layer the torn tortilla and beef mix in an oven dish.
Pour the tomato passata over it.
Add cheese on top and bake for 18 minutes.
pack8-pork-tinga-tacos: Fry the pork mince, onion and garlic until brown.
Add the crushed tomato and chilli flakes. Let them simmer for 12 minutes.
Fill them with pork, cabbage and avocado.
Add sour cream on top and serve.
pack8-fish-mexicana: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a large pan.
Add the white fish, zucchini, capsicum and corn. Cook for 13 minutes and stir now and then.
Stir in the crushed tomato and cook for 2 more minutes.
Add parsley on top and serve over the rice.
pack8-chicken-rojas: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a large pan.
Fry the onion and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add the chicken thigh and capsicum. Cook for 18 minutes and stir now and then.
Stir in the chilli flakes and tomato passata. Cook for 2 more minutes.
Add sour cream on top and serve over the rice.
pack8-beef-colorado: Heat the olive oil in a large pot.
Cook the onion and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the beef strips, cumin and chilli flakes. Stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and vegetable stock. Let them simmer for 35 minutes.
pack8-pork-pibil-tacos: Fry the pork mince with smoked paprika, garlic and onion until brown and a little crisp.
Add the lime juice and stir it in.
Fill them with pork and cabbage.
Add sour cream on top and serve.
pack8-birria-beef-tacos: Simmer the beef strips in crushed tomato, onion, garlic, cumin, chilli flakes and vegetable stock for 35 minutes until tender.
Shred the beef and keep the sauce for dipping.
Fill warm tortillas with beef and cheese. Fry them until crisp.
Serve with the sauce for dipping and a wedge of lime.
pack8-pozole-verde-soup: Heat a large pot over medium heat.
Cook the onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the chicken thigh, spinach, corn, capsicum, cabbage and cumin. Stir well.
Pour in the vegetable stock. Let it simmer for 30 minutes.
Serve with the rice and squeeze some lime over it.
pack8-prawn-zarandeado: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a large pan over medium heat.
Cook the garlic in the pan for 3 minutes.
Add prawns, cucumber and tomato. Cook for 8 minutes, and stir now and then.
Mix in mayonnaise and chilli flakes. Cook for 2 more minutes.
Add lime on top. Serve it over the rice.
pack8-lamb-salsa-verde: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a large pan over medium heat.
Cook the onion and garlic in the pan for 3 minutes.
Add lamb mince, spinach and capsicum. Cook for 18 minutes, and stir now and then.
Mix in cumin. Cook for 2 more minutes.
Add sour cream and lime on top. Serve it over the rice.
pack8-veggie-tamale-bake: Cook capsicum and zucchini for 5 minutes. Stir in black beans.
Mix flour, corn and milk into a thick batter.
Put the bean mix in an oven dish. Spread the batter over it.
Add salsa and cheese on top. Bake for 22 minutes.
pack8-smoky-chicken-beans: Heat the olive oil in a large pot.
Cook onion and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add chicken thigh, kidney beans and smoked paprika. Stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato. Let it simmer for 25 minutes.
pack8-brisket-beef: Put beef strips, tomato passata, honey, smoked paprika, garlic and onion in a large pot with 300 ml water.
Put the lid on. Let it simmer very gently for 40 minutes, until tender.
Boil the potato and corn. Mash the potato with butter.
Serve the beef and sauce over the mash, with corn.
pack8-sticky-pork-bites: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a large pan over medium heat.
Cook the garlic, ginger and spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add pork mince and capsicum. Cook for 13 minutes, and stir now and then.
Mix in honey and soy sauce. Cook for 2 more minutes.
pack8-herb-chicken-tray-lemon: Cut garlic, carrot, green beans and potato into chunks.
Put chicken thigh and oregano on the tray with the olive oil.
Bake for 37 minutes, until golden and cooked through.
Add lemon on top. Serve hot.
pack8-bbq-glazed-meatloaf: Mix beef mince, breadcrumbs, beaten egg, onion and smoked paprika. Shape the mix into a loaf.
Mix tomato passata and honey. Spread it over the loaf.
Bake for 40 minutes with potato wedges. Boil the corn near the end.
Leave it to rest for 5 minutes. Slice and serve.
pack8-chicken-pot-roast: Heat a large pot over medium heat.
Cook onion and celery in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add chicken thigh, carrot, green beans and potato. Stir well.
Pour in the vegetable stock. Let it simmer for 40 minutes.
Mix in butter. Cook for 2 more minutes.
Serve hot with parsley on top.
pack8-beef-stew-dumplings: Melt half the butter in a large pot. Cook beef strips, celery, carrot and onion for 6 minutes.
Pour in crushed tomato and vegetable stock. Add frozen peas and let it simmer for 30 minutes.
Rub the rest of the butter into the flour. Add water to make a soft dough, then drop spoonfuls on top of the stew.
Put the lid on and cook for 12 more minutes, until the dumplings puff up.
Add parsley on top. Serve hot.
pack8-smothered-pork-patties: Shape the pork mince into patties. Fry them until browned, then set them aside.
Cook onion and garlic in butter until soft and sweet.
Whisk flour into the vegetable stock and milk. Add it to the pan and heat until thick.
Put the patties back in the pan. Let them simmer for 8 minutes.
Serve with boiled potato and green beans.
pack8-smoky-chicken-rice: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a large pan.
Cook the spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add chicken thigh, bacon, egg, frozen peas and capsicum. Cook for 13 minutes, and stir now and then.
Mix in smoked paprika. Cook for 2 more minutes.
pack8-beef-egg-fried-rice: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a large pan.
Cook the spring onion and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add beef strips, egg, frozen peas and cabbage. Cook for 8 minutes, and stir now and then.
Mix in soy sauce. Cook for 2 more minutes.
pack8-prawn-ginger-fried-rice: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a large pan.
Add prawns, egg, capsicum and spinach. Cook for 8 minutes, and stir now and then.
Mix in soy sauce. Cook for 2 more minutes.
Add lime on top. Serve it over the rice.
pack8-vegetable-fried-rice: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a large pan.
Cook the spring onion and ginger for 3 minutes.
Add egg, capsicum, carrot, frozen peas and corn. Cook for 6 minutes, and stir now and then.
Mix in soy sauce. Cook for 2 more minutes.
pack8-chicken-lo-mein: Cook the noodles as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a large pan.
Cook the garlic and spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add chicken breast, mushroom, spinach and carrot. Cook for 8 minutes, and stir now and then.
Mix in soy sauce and sugar. Cook for 2 more minutes.
pack8-beef-lo-mein-mushroom: Cook the noodles as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a large pan.
Cook the ginger and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add beef strips, mushroom and spinach. Cook for 8 minutes, and stir now and then.
Mix in soy sauce and honey. Cook for 2 more minutes.
pack8-pork-chow-fun: Cook the noodles as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a large pan.
Cook the onion and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add pork mince, capsicum and cabbage. Cook for 8 minutes, and stir now and then.
Mix in soy sauce and chilli flakes. Cook for 2 more minutes.
pack8-singapore-noodles: Cook the noodles as the pack says.
Heat a large pan over medium heat.
Cook the spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add prawns, chicken breast, egg and capsicum. Cook for 13 minutes, and stir now and then.
Mix in curry paste and soy sauce. Cook for 2 more minutes.
Add lime on top. Serve it over the noodles.
pack8-hokkien-noodles: Cook the noodles as the pack says.
Heat a large pan over medium heat.
Cook the garlic and spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add chicken thigh, prawns, cabbage and carrot. Cook for 13 minutes, and stir now and then.
Mix in soy sauce and honey. Cook for 2 more minutes.
pack8-char-kway-teow: Cook the noodles as the pack says.
Heat a large pan over medium heat.
Cook the garlic and spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add prawns, egg and spinach. Cook for 8 minutes, and stir now and then.
Mix in soy sauce and chilli flakes. Cook for 2 more minutes.
Add lime on top. Serve it over the noodles.
pack8-prawn-laksa: Pour the vegetable stock and coconut milk into a large pot. Bring it to a simmer.
Mix in curry paste and garlic. Add carrot and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the noodles and prawns. Cook for 4 minutes, until the prawns are pink.
Stir in the spinach until it wilts.
Add spring onion and a squeeze of lime on top.
pack8-curry-noodle-soup-chicken: Pour the vegetable stock and coconut milk into a large pot. Bring it to a simmer.
Mix in curry paste. Add chicken breast and carrot, then cook for 10 minutes.
Take the chicken out. Shred it and put it back in.
Add the noodles and spinach. Cook for 4 more minutes.
Add spring onion and a squeeze of lime on top.
pack8-wonton-soup: Mix flour with warm water to make dough. Let it rest for 15 minutes, then roll it into small squares.
Put a little pork mince mixed with ginger and garlic on each square. Fold and pinch the edges.
Pour the vegetable stock into a large pot. Bring it to a simmer.
Add the wontons and spinach. Cook for 5 minutes, until they float.
Serve with spring onion and soy sauce.
pack8-hot-pot-dinner: Pour the vegetable stock into a wide pot. Bring it to a simmer with soy sauce and chilli flakes.
Place beef strips, prawns, tofu, mushroom and cabbage in separate sections of the pot.
Cook for 6 minutes. Add the noodles and cook for 4 more minutes.
Add spring onion on top. Serve straight from the pot.
pack8-beef-bibimbap-bowl: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a large pan.
Add beef strips, egg, carrot, cucumber and mushroom. Cook for 13 minutes, and stir now and then.
Mix in soy sauce and chilli flakes. Cook for 2 more minutes.
pack8-korean-bbq-chicken: Fry chicken thigh pieces until browned. Add soy sauce, honey, garlic and ginger, then cook until sticky.
Cook the noodles as the pack says. Drain them.
Stir the spinach through the hot noodles until it wilts.
Serve the chicken over the noodles.
pack8-hamburg-steak: Mix beef mince with breadcrumbs, beaten egg and onion. Shape it into thick steaks.
Fry for 6 minutes on each side, until cooked through.
Add soy sauce and honey to the pan. Cook until sticky and glazed.
Cook the rice as the pack says.
Serve the steaks over rice and shredded cabbage, with spring onion.
pack8-tonkatsu-pork: Shape the pork mince into flat cutlets.
Dip each cutlet in flour, then beaten egg, then breadcrumbs.
Fry for 5 minutes on each side, until crisp and golden.
Cook the rice as the pack says.
Serve sliced pork over cabbage and rice, with mayonnaise and a wedge of lemon.
pack8-oyakodon: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Simmer chicken thigh and onion in soy sauce, sugar and a little water for 10 minutes.
Add spinach and cook until it wilts.
Pour beaten eggs over the top. Cook gently until just set.
Serve over rice with spring onion.
pack8-chicken-nanban: Coat chicken thigh pieces in flour, then dip them in beaten egg. Fry them until crisp and golden.
Mix mayonnaise with a squeeze of lemon and chopped cucumber to make a tartare style sauce.
Cook the rice as the pack says.
Serve the chicken over rice and cabbage with the sauce and a splash of soy sauce.
pack8-beef-negimaki: Wrap beef strips around bundles of spring onion.
Fry them in olive oil for 6 minutes. Turn them as they cook until browned.
Add soy sauce, honey and ginger. Cook until sticky.
Cook the rice as the pack says and cook the spinach until it wilts.
Serve the beef rolls over rice and spinach.
pack8-glazed-salmon-rice: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the ginger and spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add the salmon and green beans. Cook for 8 minutes and stir now and then.
Stir in honey and soy sauce. Cook for 2 more minutes.
Top with lemon and serve with the rice.
pack8-dengaku-fish: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the ginger and spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add the white fish and spinach. Cook for 8 minutes and stir now and then.
Stir in honey and soy sauce. Cook for 2 more minutes.
pack8-salmon-rice-soup: Pour the vegetable stock into a big pot and bring it to a simmer.
Add rice and ginger. Cook for 12 minutes.
Add salmon pieces and spinach. Cook for 4 more minutes.
Top with spring onion and serve hot.
pack8-curry-rice-egg: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook the onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add chicken breast, egg, carrot, frozen peas, potato and curry paste. Stir well.
Pour in the coconut milk and let it simmer for 25 minutes.
pack8-chicken-piccata: Coat chicken breast in flour. Fry it in butter for 5 minutes each side until golden.
Cook the pasta as the pack says. Add green beans for the last 3 minutes, then drain.
Add garlic and a squeeze of lemon to the chicken pan. Swirl for 1 minute.
Serve the chicken over the pasta and beans.
pack9-masala-dosa: Cook the rice until soft. Blend it or mash it smooth with the flour and water to make a thin batter.
Boil the potato until soft. Mash it with fried onion, cumin, garam masala and chilli flakes.
Fry thin crepes for 2 minutes each side until crisp at the edges.
Fill the crepes with the potato mix and fold them.
pack9-uttapam-pancakes: Cook the rice until soft. Mash it smooth with the flour, beaten egg and water to make a thick batter.
Fry thick pancakes for 3 minutes until bubbles show.
Scatter tomato, onion, capsicum and chilli flakes on top.
Flip the pancakes and fry them for 2 more minutes.
pack9-pongal: Put rice, lentils, ginger and cumin in a pot with 600 ml water.
Simmer for 25 minutes. Stir now and then until soft and porridge like.
Stir in frozen peas and butter for the last 3 minutes.
Serve with a squeeze of lemon.
pack9-dhokla-cakes: Whisk flour, greek yogurt, beaten egg, baking powder and coconut milk into a batter.
Pour the batter into greased muffin cups.
Steam it over a pan of water for 12 minutes until spongy.
Fry cumin and chilli flakes in a dry pan. Scatter them over the cakes.
Serve with a squeeze of lemon.
pack9-thepla-flatbreads: Chop the spinach finely. Mix it into the flour with cumin and garam masala.
Add greek yogurt and a little water. Mix them into a soft dough.
Fry them in a dry pan for 2 minutes each side, brushing them with butter.
pack9-vada-lentil-fritters: Cook the lentils until very soft, then drain them well.
Mash the lentils with onion, ginger, cumin, chilli flakes and flour.
Shape them into small flat fritters.
Fry them in olive oil for 3 minutes each side until crisp.
pack9-tiganites: Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Add egg and flour. Cook for 6 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in honey, cinnamon and milk. Cook for 2 more minutes.
Top with greek yogurt and lemon, then serve hot.
pack9-loukoumades: Whisk flour, baking powder, milk and beaten egg into a thick batter.
Let the batter rest for 10 minutes.
Fry spoonfuls for 3 minutes, turning them until puffed and golden.
Drizzle with honey and dust with cinnamon.
pack9-sweet-honey-banana-toast: Spread ricotta thickly on each slice.
Drizzle with honey and dust with cinnamon.
pack9-banana-frittelle: Mash the banana. Whisk it with flour, beaten egg, greek yogurt and sugar to make a batter.
Fry spoonfuls in butter for 2 minutes each side until golden.
Drizzle with maple syrup and serve warm.
pack9-panna-cotta-pots: Warm cream, milk, sugar and honey in a pot until the sugar melts. Do not boil.
Take the pot off the heat. Whisk in the greek yogurt.
Pour the mixture into two glasses or pots.
Chill for at least 2 hours until just set.
Top with mixed berries and serve.
pack9-tramezzino-sandwiches: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes. Peel and slice them.
Top with egg slices, lettuce and tomato.
Cut the sandwiches into triangles and serve.
pack9-breakfast-piadina: Mix flour with olive oil and warm water into a dough. Roll out two flatbreads.
Fry the flatbreads in a dry pan for 2 minutes each side.
Fill the flatbreads with egg, cheese and tomato.
pack9-veggie-egg-cups: Stir in chopped capsicum, corn, spring onion and cheese.
Pour the mixture into a greased muffin tray.
Bake for 14 minutes until just set.
pack9-avocado-egg-boats: Cut the avocado in half. Remove a little flesh to make room.
Crack an egg into each half.
Top with chopped bacon. Bake for 14 minutes until the egg is just set.
Scatter spring onion and chilli flakes on top. Serve with toasted bread.
pack9-yogurt-bark: Spread greek yogurt thickly on a lined tray.
Scatter mixed berries, chia seeds and granola over it.
Break it into pieces and serve.
pack9-quick-breakfast-wrap: Scramble the eggs gently with the spinach.
Fill them with egg and cheese.
Add salsa, roll them up and serve.
pack9-peanut-banana-oats-jar: Layer rolled oats, peanut butter and sliced banana in a jar or bowl.
Let them rest for 10 minutes, or overnight in the fridge, and serve.
pack9-farinata-flatbread: Mash the chickpeas with flour, olive oil and warm water into a thick batter. Stir in oregano.
Let the batter rest for 10 minutes.
Pour the batter into a hot, oiled oven tray. Top with sliced onion and tomato.
Bake at 200 degrees for 18 minutes until crisp at the edges.
pack9-socca-roast-veg: Mash the chickpeas with flour, olive oil and warm water into a thick batter.
Pour the batter into a hot, oiled oven tray.
Top with zucchini, capsicum and red onion.
Bake at 200 degrees for 20 minutes until crisp at the edges.
Scatter feta over it and serve.
pack9-piadina-ham-cheese: Mix flour with olive oil and warm water into a dough. Roll out two flatbreads.
Fry the flatbreads in a dry pan for 2 minutes each side.
Fill them with ham, mozzarella, tomato and spinach.
Fold them and put them back in the pan for 2 minutes until the mozzarella melts.
pack9-taralli-dip-plate: Mix flour, olive oil, beaten egg and warm water into a dough. Shape it into small rings.
Bake at 180 degrees for 18 minutes until crisp.
Mix greek yogurt with grated cucumber and a squeeze of lemon to make a dip.
Serve the crackers with the dip.
pack9-pesto-pancake-bites: Whisk flour, beaten egg and milk into a thin batter.
Fry thin pancakes for 1 minute each side.
Cut the pancakes into diamonds. Warm them in a pan with a splash of water.
Toss them with pesto and spinach until the spinach wilts.
pack9-lagane-pasta-chickpeas: Warm the olive oil in a large pot.
Cook the garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add chickpeas and chilli flakes. Stir well.
Pour in the tomato passata. Let it simmer for 20 minutes.
Serve it with the pasta and top it with parsley.
pack9-orecchiette-broccoli-pasta: Cook the pasta in salted water, as the pack says.
Warm the olive oil in a large pan.
Add broccoli and cook for 8 minutes.
Stir in chilli flakes and warm everything through.
Drain the pasta and toss it with everything else.
Top with parmesan and lemon. Serve hot.
pack9-culurgiones-dumplings: Boil the potato until it is soft. Mash it with cheese and beaten egg.
Mix flour and warm water to make dough. Roll the dough into circles.
Fill each circle. Fold it and pinch the edges into a rope pattern if you can.
Boil the dumplings for 4 minutes, until they float.
Serve with warm tomato passata and melted butter with garlic.
pack9-seadas-pastries: Mix flour, melted butter, beaten egg, and warm water to make dough. Roll it into circles.
Fill the circles with cheese. Fold them and pinch the edges.
Fry for 3 minutes each side, until crisp and golden.
Drizzle with honey and squeeze lemon over them.
pack9-dakos-salad: Chop the tomato, olives, and cucumber.
Put the bread and feta in a large bowl.
Add oregano and olive oil. Toss well.
pack9-horta-greens-egg: Cook the spinach with garlic in a pan until it is just soft.
Boil the eggs for 7 minutes. Peel and halve them.
Put the warm spinach on plates.
Top it with eggs and feta.
Add olive oil and a squeeze of lemon. Serve with the bread.
pack9-gigantes-beans: Fry onion, carrot, celery, and garlic in olive oil for 5 minutes.
Stir in crushed tomato and black beans.
Tip everything into an oven dish and bake for 22 minutes.
Top with parsley and serve with the bread.
pack9-kolokithokeftedes: Warm the olive oil in a large pan.
Fry the spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add egg, zucchini, and flour. Cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Top with feta, greek yogurt, and parsley. Serve hot.
pack9-tomatokeftedes: Warm the olive oil in a large pan.
Add egg, tomato, and flour. Cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in oregano and cook for 2 more minutes.
Top with feta and greek yogurt. Serve hot.
pack9-boureki-bake: Heat the oven to 180 degrees. Grease a dish with butter.
Layer sliced potato and zucchini in the dish.
Whisk eggs, milk, and flour. Pour the mix over the vegetables.
Bake for 32 minutes, until set and golden.
pack9-aloo-tikki: Heat a large pan over medium heat.
Add egg, frozen peas, potato, and flour. Cook for 13 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in cumin and garam masala. Cook for 2 more minutes.
Top with greek yogurt and serve hot.
pack9-halloumi-tikka-wrap: Rub the halloumi with curry paste. Fry it for 2 minutes each side, until golden.
Mix greek yogurt with grated cucumber.
Fill them with halloumi, spinach, tomato, and the yogurt mix.
pack9-chole-fried-bread: Fry onion, tomato, and garam masala for 5 minutes. Add chickpeas and simmer for 10 minutes.
Mix flour, baking powder, and greek yogurt to make dough. Roll it into small rounds.
Fry the rounds for 2 minutes each side, until puffed and golden.
Serve the chickpeas with the fried rounds.
pack9-coconut-lentil-soup: Heat a large pot over medium heat.
Cook onion, garlic, and ginger in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add lentils, spinach, and cumin. Stir well.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer for 20 minutes.
Serve hot with a squeeze of lime.
pack9-egg-curry-bowl: Heat a large pot over medium heat.
Cook onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add egg, tomato, frozen peas, spinach, and curry paste. Stir well.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer for 15 minutes.
pack9-vegetable-pilau: Fry onion, cauliflower, and carrot in olive oil with garam masala for 5 minutes.
Stir in the rice and 500 ml water. Cover and cook on low for 12 minutes.
Stir in frozen peas for the last 4 minutes.
Leave the lid on and let it rest for 5 minutes. Then fluff the rice.
Serve with greek yogurt and a squeeze of lemon.
pack9-quick-tuna-rice-bowl: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Mix tuna with mayonnaise and soy sauce.
Put rice in bowls. Top it with tuna, cucumber, and carrot.
Scatter spring onion and chilli flakes on top.
pack9-quick-chicken-noodle-pot: Pour the vegetable stock into a deep pan and bring it to a simmer.
Add chicken breast strips and ginger. Cook for 5 minutes.
Add the noodles and corn. Cook for 4 more minutes.
Top with spring onion and serve.
pack9-quick-bean-cheese-toast: Warm the black beans and corn in a small pan.
Top the toast with beans and corn.
pack9-quick-egg-fried-rice: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a large pan over medium heat.
Fry the spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add egg, ham, and frozen peas. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in soy sauce. Cook for 2 more minutes.
pack9-quick-egg-mozzarella-toast: Top it with mozzarella and tomato. Grill or warm it until the mozzarella softens.
Fry the eggs in olive oil.
Put an egg on each toast and serve.
pack9-hummus-plate: Blend chickpeas with lemon, garlic, and olive oil until smooth. Add cold water if you need it.
Spoon the mix onto a plate and dust it with smoked paprika.
Serve with cucumber and tomato for scooping.
pack9-chicken-dopiaza: Warm the olive oil in a large pot.
Cook onion, garlic, and ginger in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add chicken thigh, tomato, capsicum, and garam masala. Stir well.
Add enough water to cover everything. Simmer for 25 minutes.
pack9-beef-madras: Heat a large pot over medium heat.
Cook onion, garlic, and ginger in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add beef strips, capsicum, potato, garam masala, and chilli flakes. Stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and simmer for 30 minutes.
pack9-lamb-pasanda: Warm the olive oil in a large pot.
Cook garlic, ginger, and onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add lamb mince, spinach, and garam masala. Stir well.
Add enough water to cover everything. Simmer for 25 minutes.
Stir in greek yogurt and cream. Cook for 2 more minutes.
pack9-prawn-patia: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Warm the olive oil in a large pan.
Fry the onion and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add prawns, tomato, and spinach. Cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in sugar and garam masala. Cook for 2 more minutes.
Top with lime and serve over the rice.
pack9-fish-dopiaza: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Warm the olive oil in a large pan.
Fry the onion, garlic, and ginger for 3 minutes.
Add white fish and tomato. Cook for 13 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in cumin and garam masala. Cook for 2 more minutes.
Top with lemon and serve over the rice.
pack9-pork-methi: Warm the olive oil in a large pot.
Cook onion, garlic, and ginger in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add pork mince, spinach, and garam masala. Stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in greek yogurt. Cook for 2 more minutes.
pack9-tofu-jalfrezi: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Warm the olive oil in a large pan.
Fry the onion and ginger for 3 minutes.
Add tofu, capsicum, and spinach. Cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in garam masala and chilli flakes. Cook for 2 more minutes.
pack9-vegetable-kolhapuri: Warm the olive oil in a large pot.
Cook onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add cauliflower, capsicum, potato, garam masala, and chilli flakes. Stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and coconut milk. Simmer for 20 minutes.
pack9-spinach-dal: Set a large pot over medium heat.
Cook the onion and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the lentils, spinach, tomato and cumin. Stir well.
Pour in the coconut milk. Let it simmer for 20 minutes.
Serve it with the rice and a squeeze of lemon.
pack9-rajma: Set a large pot over medium heat.
Cook the onion, garlic and ginger in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the kidney beans, capsicum, spinach and garam masala. Stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato. Let it simmer for 25 minutes.
Serve it with the rice and a squeeze of lemon.
pack9-lobia-black-beans: Heat the olive oil in a large pot.
Cook the onion and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the black beans, tomato, spinach, cumin and garam masala. Stir well.
Add water until it covers the food. Let it simmer for 20 minutes.
Serve it with the rice and a squeeze of lemon.
pack9-chicken-giouvetsi: Cook the pasta in the same pot after cooking the chicken, as described below.
Fry the chicken thigh and onion in olive oil until golden.
Add the crushed tomato, garlic, cinnamon and 500 ml water. Let it simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the pasta. Cook it for 10 more minutes, until the pasta is soft and the sauce is thick.
pack9-beef-kokkinisto: Heat the olive oil in a large pot.
Cook the onion and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the beef strips and cinnamon. Stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato. Let it simmer for 35 minutes.
Stir in the feta. Cook for 2 more minutes.
pack9-lamb-frikasee: Fry the lamb mince and onion in olive oil until browned.
Add 500 ml water and the spinach. Let it simmer for 15 minutes.
Whisk the eggs with a squeeze of lemon and a ladle of the hot liquid.
Gently stir the egg mix back in for 2 minutes, until the sauce thickens a little. Do not let it boil.
Serve it over the rice with spring onion.
pack9-pork-lemonato: Heat the olive oil in a large pot.
Cook the garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the pork mince, spinach, potato and oregano. Stir well.
Pour in the vegetable stock. Let it simmer for 25 minutes.
Serve it hot with a squeeze of lemon.
pack9-prawn-giouvetsi: Fry the onion and garlic in olive oil. Add the crushed tomato and oregano, then let it simmer for 6 minutes.
Stir in the pasta and 400 ml water. Tip the mix into an oven dish.
Add the prawns and feta on top.
Bake for 18 minutes, until the pasta is soft and the prawns are pink.
pack9-chicken-kapama: Set a large pot over medium heat.
Cook the onion and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the chicken thigh, capsicum and cinnamon. Stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato. Let it simmer for 30 minutes.
Stir in the feta. Cook for 2 more minutes.
Serve it with the rice and a squeeze of lemon.
pack9-chicken-romana: Heat the olive oil in a large pan.
Fry the onion and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add the chicken thigh, capsicum and potato. Cook for 23 minutes and stir now and then.
Stir in the oregano and crushed tomato. Cook for 2 more minutes.
pack9-beef-braciole: Mix the breadcrumbs, parmesan, garlic and parsley.
Spread the mix over the beef strips. Roll them up and tie them or secure them with toothpicks.
Fry the rolls in olive oil until browned all over.
Add the crushed tomato. Let it simmer gently for 25 minutes.
Cook the pasta as the pack says. Serve the rolls and sauce over it.
pack9-pork-scaloppine: Shape the pork mince into thin patties. Dip them in flour.
Fry them in butter for 4 minutes each side, until golden.
Cook the pasta as the pack says. Add the green beans for the last 3 minutes, then drain it.
Add the garlic and a squeeze of lemon to the pork pan. Swirl for 1 minute.
Scatter parsley over the pork. Serve it over the pasta and beans.
pack9-tuna-siciliana: Cook the couscous as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a large pan.
Fry the onion and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add the tuna, olives and capsicum. Cook for 13 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in the oregano and crushed tomato. Cook for 2 more minutes.
pack9-lamb-scottadito: Mix the lamb mince with the breadcrumbs, garlic and oregano. Shape it into small, thick patties.
Fry them for 5 minutes each side, until browned and cooked through.
Boil the potato and green beans.
Serve the patties with potato, beans and a squeeze of lemon. Drizzle olive oil over them.
pack9-chicken-diavola: Chop the garlic, spinach and potato into chunks.
Put the chicken thigh, chilli flakes and honey on the tray with the olive oil.
Bake for 32 minutes, until golden and cooked through.
Add lemon on top and serve it hot.
pack9-aglio-olio: Cook the spaghetti in salty water as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a large pan.
Add the spinach and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the chilli flakes and warm the mix through.
Drain the spaghetti and toss it with everything else.
Add the parmesan, parsley and lemon on top. Serve it hot.
pack9-pasta-limone: Cook the pasta in salty water as the pack says.
Heat a large pan over medium heat.
Add the spinach and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the cream and warm it through.
Drain the pasta and toss it with everything else.
Add the parmesan, butter and lemon on top. Serve it hot.
pack9-arrabbiata-pasta: Cook the pasta in salty water as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a large pan.
Stir in the chilli flakes and crushed tomato. Warm them through.
Drain the pasta and toss it with everything else.
Add the mozzarella and basil on top. Serve it hot.
pack9-quick-peanut-noodles: Cook the noodles as the pack says, then drain them. Keep a little of the water.
Mix the peanut butter, soy sauce, a squeeze of lime and chilli flakes with the hot noodle water to make a sauce.
Toss the noodles in the sauce.
Add the cucumber, carrot and spring onion on top. Serve.
pack9-quick-chicken-quesadillas: Fry the chicken breast strips until cooked through. Slice them.
Place one tortilla at a time in a dry pan.
Fill them with chicken, cheese, corn and spinach.
Fold them. Fry for 2 minutes each side, until crisp and melted.
pack9-quick-tuna-tacos: Mix the tuna with mayonnaise, chilli flakes and a squeeze of lime.
Warm the corn in a small pan.
Fill them with tuna, cabbage and corn.
pack9-quick-egg-rice-bowls: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a large pan over medium heat.
Fry the spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add the egg and spinach. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in the soy sauce and chilli flakes. Cook for 2 more minutes.
Add the avocado on top. Serve it over the rice.
pack9-quick-bean-rice-bowls: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Warm the black beans and corn in a pot.
Put the rice in bowls. Add the beans and corn on top.
Add the cheese, salsa and avocado.
Finish with a squeeze of lime and serve.
pack9-salmon-poke-bowls: Cook the rice as the pack says and let it cool a little.
Fry the salmon until just cooked and flake it, or serve it in pieces.
Mix the mayonnaise with the soy sauce and a squeeze of lime.
Put the rice in bowls. Add the salmon, cucumber and avocado on top.
Drizzle the sauce over it and scatter the spring onion.
pack9-quick-teriyaki-chicken-bowls: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a large pan over medium heat.
Fry the spring onion and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add the chicken breast and broccoli. Cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in the soy sauce and honey. Cook for 2 more minutes.
pack9-quick-prawn-rice-bowls: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a large pan over medium heat.
Fry the spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add the prawns, capsicum and cucumber. Cook for 6 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in the soy sauce and chilli flakes. Cook for 2 more minutes.
Add lime on top. Serve it over the rice.
pack9-quick-tofu-rice-bowls: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a large pan over medium heat.
Fry the ginger and spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add the tofu, broccoli and carrot. Cook for 6 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in the soy sauce and honey. Cook for 2 more minutes.
pack9-quick-pork-rice-bowls: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a large pan over medium heat.
Fry the garlic and spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add the pork mince, cabbage and carrot. Cook for 6 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in the soy sauce and chilli flakes. Cook for 2 more minutes.
pack9-quick-beef-rice-bowls: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a large pan over medium heat.
Add the beef mince and capsicum. Cook for 6 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in the taco seasoning. Cook for 2 more minutes.
Add the cheese and lime on top. Serve it over the rice.
pack9-lamb-zucchini-bake: Fry the lamb mince and onion in olive oil with cinnamon until browned. Stir in the crushed tomato.
Whisk the ricotta with the beaten egg to make a sauce.
Layer the zucchini slices and lamb mix in an oven dish.
Add the ricotta sauce and cheese on top. Bake for 30 minutes.
pack9-lamb-biryani: Fry the lamb mince and onion in olive oil with garam masala and garlic until brown.
Stir in the rice and 700 ml water. Cover and cook on low for 15 minutes.
Stir in the frozen peas during the last 5 minutes.
Leave the pot covered for 5 minutes, then fluff the rice.
Serve with greek yogurt and a squeeze of lemon.
pack9-fish-pilau: Fry the onion and ginger in butter with cumin and garam masala for 3 minutes.
Stir in the rice and 700 ml water. Cover and cook on low for 12 minutes.
Place the white fish pieces on top with frozen peas and spinach. Cook for 6 more minutes, until the fish is just done.
Leave the pot covered for 5 minutes.
Serve with a squeeze of lemon.
pack9-seafood-orzo: Fry the onion and garlic in olive oil. Add crushed tomato and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in the pasta and 600 ml water. Cook for 10 minutes, stirring now and then.
Add the prawns and white fish pieces. Cook for 5 more minutes, until just done.
Top with feta and a squeeze of lemon, then serve.
pack9-kheema-pav: Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the onion, garlic, and ginger for 3 minutes.
Add the beef mince, tomato, frozen peas, and bread. Cook for 18 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in garam masala and cook for 2 more minutes.
Top with butter and lemon, then serve hot.
pack10-brekkie-bowl: Soak the rolled oats and chia seeds in the milk for 10 minutes.
Spoon the mixture into bowls with greek yogurt.
Drizzle with maple syrup and serve.
pack10-eggs-soldiers: Boil the eggs for 6 minutes so the yolks stay runny.
Toast the bread and spread it with butter.
Place the eggs in cups, take off the tops, and serve with the toast fingers for dipping.
pack10-brekkie-jaffle: Gently scramble the eggs with the spinach.
Put the cheese, egg, and ham between the bread slices.
Toast in a hot dry pan, pressing down, for 3 minutes each side until golden and melted.
pack10-potato-scallops: Slice the potato into thick rounds and boil for 5 minutes, then drain.
Whisk the flour, beaten egg, baking powder, and a little water into a batter.
Dip the potato slices in the batter.
Fry in butter for 3 minutes each side until crisp and golden.
pack10-pavlova-breakfast-bowl: Whisk the egg whites with sugar and a squeeze of lemon until stiff and glossy.
Spoon small mounds onto a lined tray. Bake for 30 minutes until crisp.
Let them cool, then break them into bowls.
Top with cream, mixed berries, and sliced banana.
pack10-breakfast-sanga: Shape the pork mince into two flat patties and fry for 4 minutes each side.
Fry the eggs the way you like them.
Make the sangas with pork, egg, cheese, and tomato.
pack10-peanut-oat-pancakes: Blend the rolled oats into a rough flour. Mix them with flour and baking powder.
Whisk the beaten egg, milk, and peanut butter into a batter.
Fry small pancakes in butter for 2 minutes each side.
pack10-spoonbread: Whisk the milk, eggs, flour, and baking powder into a batter.
Stir in the corn, cheese, and melted butter.
Pour the batter into a greased oven dish.
Bake for 28 minutes until puffed and golden. Spoon it out to serve.
pack10-hush-puppies-eggs: Mix the corn, flour, one beaten egg, baking powder, onion, and milk into a thick batter.
Fry spoonfuls in butter for 3 minutes, turning them until crisp.
Fry the bacon and the other eggs.
Serve the hush puppies with bacon and eggs.
pack10-western-omelette: Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Heat a pan over medium heat.
Cook the onion, spring onion, capsicum, mushroom, and ham for 4 minutes.
Pour in the eggs and cook gently until just set.
pack10-hoppin-john-breakfast: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Fry the bacon, capsicum, and onion with smoked paprika for 5 minutes.
Stir in the black beans and rice, then warm them through.
Fry the eggs and place one on each plate.
pack10-prawn-grits-bowl: Simmer the corn in the milk for 10 minutes, then mash it roughly into a thick porridge.
Stir in the cheese and butter.
Fry the prawns with garlic and chilli flakes for 3 minutes until pink.
Spoon the corn porridge into bowls and top with the prawns.
Scatter spring onion over the top and serve.
pack10-sweet-potato-pie-oats: Boil the sweet potato until soft, then mash it.
Cook the rolled oats in the milk as the pack says.
Stir the sweet potato mash through the porridge with cinnamon and sugar.
Top with butter and maple syrup, then serve.
pack10-banana-pudding-pots: Whisk the flour and sugar into the milk in a pot. Heat it, stirring, until thick like custard.
Let the custard cool a little, then stir in the cream.
Tear the bread into two pots. Layer it with banana slices and custard.
Chill for 30 minutes if you can, then serve.
pack10-veggie-snack-rolls: Whisk flour, beaten egg, and water into a thin batter. Fry thin crepes.
Stir fry the cabbage, carrot, and corn in olive oil with soy sauce for 4 minutes.
Fill each crepe with the vegetables and roll it up tightly.
Fry the rolls for 2 minutes each side until crisp.
pack10-potato-cakes: Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add the egg, potato, and flour. Cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Top with cheese and butter, then serve hot.
pack10-zucchini-bacon-slice: Grate the zucchini and squeeze out the water.
Whisk the eggs and flour, then stir in the zucchini, cheese, bacon, onion, and olive oil.
Pour the mixture into a lined tin.
Bake for 28 minutes until set and golden, then slice.
pack10-curried-egg-sandwiches: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, then peel and mash them.
Mix the eggs with curry paste and mayonnaise.
Spread the mixture on the bread.
pack10-aussie-burger-beetroot: Shape the beef mince into patties and fry for 4 minutes each side.
Fry the eggs and warm the bread rolls.
Build the burgers with beef, cheese, beetroot, egg, lettuce, tomato, and onion.
pack10-snack-pack-fries: Heat the oven to 200 degrees and bake the potato fries until crisp.
Fry the chicken thigh pieces until cooked through, then slice them.
Mix the greek yogurt with garlic and mayonnaise to make a sauce.
Put the fries in a tray and top with chicken and cheese.
Warm until the cheese melts. Add the sauce and salsa, then serve.
pack10-succotash: Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Add the kidney beans, corn, capsicum, and tomato. Cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Top with butter and parsley, then serve hot.
pack10-brunswick-stew: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook the onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the chicken thigh, kidney beans, corn, and potato. Stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and simmer for 25 minutes.
Stir in the butter and cook for 2 more minutes.
pack10-burgoo-stew: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook the onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add the beef strips, chicken thigh, carrot, corn, and potato. Stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and simmer for 35 minutes.
pack10-frogmore-stew: Melt the butter in a big pot. Add smoked paprika and capsicum.
Add the potato pieces and 500 ml water. Simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the corn and cook for 5 more minutes.
Add the prawns and cook for 3 minutes until pink.
Serve in bowls with a wedge of lemon.
pack10-lowcountry-rice: Cook the rice as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Fry the onion, celery, and spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add the prawns, bacon, and capsicum. Cook for 13 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in the smoked paprika and cook for 2 more minutes.
pack10-prawn-etouffee: Melt the butter and whisk in the flour. Cook for 2 minutes until golden.
Add the capsicum, onion, and celery. Cook for 4 minutes.
Pour in the vegetable stock with smoked paprika and simmer for 6 minutes.
Add the prawns and cook for 3 minutes until pink.
Serve over rice that you cooked as the pack says.
pack10-salisbury-patties: Mix beef mince, breadcrumbs, beaten egg, and onion. Shape the mixture into patties.
Fry the patties for 5 minutes each side, then set them aside.
Fry mushroom in the pan. Whisk flour into the vegetable stock and milk. Add it to the pan and heat until thick.
Put the patties back in the sauce and cook for 3 minutes.
pack10-tater-bites: Grate the potato. Squeeze it dry, then mix it with flour, beaten egg, cheese, and smoked paprika.
Shape the mixture into small cylinders on a lined tray.
Bake at 200 degrees for 22 minutes, until crisp and golden.
pack10-hobo-packets: Shape the beef mince into patties.
Put a patty on foil with sliced potato, carrot, onion, capsicum, and a knob of butter.
Bake for 28 minutes. Open the parcels, top them with cheese, and serve.
pack10-campfire-chilli: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook the onion in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add beef mince, kidney beans, capsicum, and cumin. Stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and simmer for 30 minutes.
Stir in cheese and cook for 2 more minutes.
pack10-berry-dump-cake: Put the mixed berries in an oven dish.
Mix flour, sugar, and cinnamon. Rub in the butter until the mix looks like crumbs.
Whisk the egg and milk. Stir them roughly into the crumbs.
Drop spoonfuls of the mix over the berries.
Bake at 180 degrees for 26 minutes, until golden.
pack10-berry-brown-betty: Tear the bread into crumbs. Mix the crumbs with melted butter, sugar, and cinnamon.
Layer crumbs and mixed berries in an oven dish. Finish with crumbs.
Bake at 180 degrees for 22 minutes, until crisp on top.
pack10-fish-chowder-lunch: Heat a big pot over medium heat.
Cook the onion and celery in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add white fish, corn, and potato. Stir well.
Pour in the milk and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in butter and cook for 2 more minutes.
pack10-mississippi-beef: Melt the butter in a big pot. Fry beef strips, onion, garlic, and capsicum for 6 minutes.
Pour in the vegetable stock. Cover the pot and simmer very gently for 35 minutes, until tender.
Boil the potato and carrot until soft.
Serve the beef and its juices over the potato and carrot.
pack10-alabama-chicken: Chop garlic, corn, and potato into chunks.
Put chicken thigh, mayonnaise, and smoked paprika on the tray with the olive oil.
Bake for 32 minutes, until golden and cooked through.
Top with lemon and serve hot.
pack10-texas-chilli: Heat the olive oil in a big pot.
Cook onion and garlic in the pot for 5 minutes.
Add beef strips, kidney beans, cumin, chilli flakes, and smoked paprika. Stir well.
Pour in the crushed tomato and simmer for 35 minutes.
pack10-country-fried-chicken: Dip chicken thigh pieces in flour, then in beaten egg, then in breadcrumbs.
Fry them in butter for 5 minutes each side, until crisp and golden.
Whisk a spoon of the flour into the milk in the pan. Heat it until thick to make a gravy.
Boil the corn and green beans.
Serve chicken with gravy, corn, and beans.
pack10-chicken-stew-dumplings: Melt half the butter in a big pot. Fry chicken thigh, potato, carrot, and onion for 6 minutes.
Pour in crushed tomato and vegetable stock. Add frozen peas and corn, then simmer for 30 minutes.
Rub the rest of the butter into the flour. Add water to make a soft dough. Drop spoonfuls on top of the stew.
Cover the pot and cook for 12 more minutes, until the dumplings puff up.
pack10-sunday-roast-chicken: Put chicken thigh, potato, carrot, and onion on a tray with lemon halves, oregano, and knobs of butter. Roast for 40 minutes, adding green beans for the last 10.
Pour the tray juices into a pan with the vegetable stock. Simmer for 3 minutes to make a light gravy.
Serve the chicken and veg with the gravy.
pack10-roast-beef-dinner: Put potato, pumpkin, carrot, and onion on a tray with knobs of butter. Roast for 40 minutes.
Fry beef strips over high heat for 5 minutes, then let them rest. Add green beans to the tray for the last 10 minutes of roasting.
Whisk flour into the pan juices with vegetable stock to make a gravy.
Serve beef and roast veg with gravy.
pack10-roast-pork-dinner: Shape pork mince and oregano into a loaf. Put it on a tray with potato, pumpkin, onion, and knobs of butter.
Roast for 35 minutes, adding frozen peas for the last 5.
Let the loaf rest. Whisk flour into the tray juices with vegetable stock to make a gravy.
Slice the loaf and serve it with veg and gravy.
pack10-pub-sausages-mash: Shape pork mince into sausages. Fry them for 10 minutes, until browned all over.
Boil the potato until soft. Mash it with butter and milk.
Fry onion until soft and sweet. Whisk flour into the vegetable stock and add it to the pan. Heat until thick to make an onion gravy.
Serve sausages on mash with gravy and peas.
pack10-lamb-shepherds-pie: Fry lamb mince, onion, and carrot in olive oil until browned. Stir in crushed tomato and frozen peas, then simmer for 8 minutes.
Boil the sweet potato until soft. Mash it.
Put the lamb mix in an oven dish. Top it with mash and cheese.
pack10-seafood-pie: Boil the potato until soft. Mash it with a splash of the milk, half the butter, and the beaten egg.
Melt the rest of the butter. Whisk in flour and the rest of the milk. Heat until thick.
Stir white fish, prawns, corn, and celery into the sauce. Tip it into an oven dish.
Top with mash and bake for 22 minutes.
pack10-chicken-corn-pie: Fry chicken thigh, celery, onion, and garlic until golden.
Stir in a spoon of the flour, then add the cream and corn. Simmer until thick.
Rub butter into the rest of the flour. Add cold water and roll out pastry.
Put the chicken mix in a pie dish. Cover it with pastry and bake for 25 minutes.
pack10-steak-diane: Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Add beef strips, mushroom, green beans, and potato. Cook for 18 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in cream and cook for 2 more minutes.
Top with butter and parsley. Serve hot.
pack10-pepper-steak: Cook the noodles as the pack says.
Heat the olive oil in a big pan.
Fry onion, garlic, and ginger for 3 minutes.
Add beef strips and capsicum. Cook for 13 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in soy sauce, sugar, and chilli flakes. Cook for 2 more minutes.
pack10-creamy-mushroom-chicken: Cook the pasta as the pack says.
Heat a big pan over medium heat.
Add chicken thigh, mushroom, and spinach. Cook for 18 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in cream and cook for 2 more minutes.
Top with butter and parmesan. Serve over the pasta.
pack10-vegetable-pot-pie: Fry onion, potato, and carrot in a knob of the butter for 6 minutes.
Stir in a spoon of the flour, then add the milk, frozen peas, and corn. Simmer until thick.
